title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow

AI.title_translation: 更多基因，更快推理：基于组织学的高效大Panel空间转录组预测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合流匹配与多模态融合的高效框架GeneFlow，大幅提升了从组织图像预测千级基因空间表达的精度并显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的从组织学图像预测空间转录组的方法模型结构复杂、训练繁琐且依赖额外输入，且多局限于小规模固定基因集，亟需一种能够用于大Panel空间基因表达预测的高效方法。
AI.method: 提出GeneFlow框架，将基于速度的流匹配目标与结构化多模态融合相结合。利用组织学和基因分词器对组织形态和位点内跨基因相互作用进行编码；模型采用流匹配目标进行训练，但直接预测空间基因表达量而非中间速度场，从而省去沉重的生成采样管线。
AI.result: 在多个空间转录组基准上取得SOTA性能，在1000个基因的大Panel预测任务中提升高达56.8%；在生成具有生物学意义图谱的同时，将计算成本降低了数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: GeneFlow显著提升了大Panel空间转录组预测的效率与可扩展性，在临床场景与利用海量组织学图像进行下游生物学发现方面展现出巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 基于组织学预测空间转录组（ST）旨在直接从组织图像推断具有空间分辨率的基因表达谱。这是一项极具挑战性的任务，目前通常需要复杂的模型架构、额外的输入以及繁琐的训练过程，且预测范围往往局限于固定的、小规模基因集合。这自然引出一个问题：是否存在一种用于大Panel空间转录组预测的高效方法？在此，我们提出了GeneFlow，一个更简洁但高效的大规模空间基因表达预测框架，它将流匹配（flow-matching）生成模型与结构化多模态融合结合在一起。具体而言，GeneFlow首先通过组织学和基因分词器对空间位点中的组织形态学以及基因间相互作用进行编码。该模型利用基于速度的流匹配目标进行训练，同时直接预测空间基因表达，而不是中间速度场。我们表明，即使不依赖繁重的生成管线，GeneFlow在多个ST基准测试中也取得了最先进的性能，在1,000个基因预测任务中提升高达56.8%。大量实验进一步表明，GeneFlow不仅能生成具有生物学意义的位点图谱，还将计算成本降低了数个数量级，从而提高了效率和可扩展性，尤其是在临床环境中。我们相信GeneFlow为利用广泛可用的组织图像进行下游生物学发现提供了良机。代码公开在：https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow。
AI.summary: 本文提出了用于大规模空间转录组预测的高效框架GeneFlow，利用组织学与基因分词器提取多模态特征，并结合改进的流匹配目标直接预测基因表达。该方法在千级基因Panel预测上实现了显著精度跃升，同时大幅降低计算成本，适用于临床应用与大规模生物学发现。
AI.keywords: 空间转录组学, 组织学图像, 流匹配, 基因表达预测, 多模态融合
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将流匹配生成目标与直接回归表达量相结合，克服了传统生成模型迭代采样推理慢的缺陷；同时解决了大基因Panel难以建模与高计算成本的问题，兼顾了高精度、生物学可解释性与临床落地实用性。

title: AmbiSteer: Selectively Eliciting Ambiguity-Aware Responses in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often exhibit overconfidence, providing firm answers even when visual evidence is insufficient. A prominent case is referential ambiguity in Visual Question Answering (VQA), where multiple entities in an image are plausible referents of a question. Addressing such cases requires recognizing when ambiguity is present: ambiguous questions can be handled by asking for clarification or enumerating plausible referents, while unambiguous questions should receive a direct answer. Current VLMs struggle with this distinction, often defaulting to a single interpretation. To investigate whether activation steering can serve as an inference-time mechanism to elicit such behaviors, we introduce AmbiSteer, a lightweight framework to selectively elicit ambiguity-aware behavior. Across three VLMs, we find that steering alone has limited and model-dependent effects, while prompting is generally more effective. Combining prompting and steering substantially increases clarification and enumeration behaviors, but also elicits them on unambiguous cases. AmbiSteer addresses this using a linear classifier to predict input ambiguity and condition the steering direction accordingly, increasing the proportion of inputs handled appropriately from 59.0% to 77.0% on average across models. Our work sets the ground for lightweight approaches to reduce model overconfidence in uncertain multimodal settings.

AI.title_translation: AmbiSteer：选择性诱导视觉语言模型中的歧义感知响应
AI.tldr: AmbiSteer 结合提示与线性分类器条件化的激活引导，能够选择性地让视觉语言模型对歧义问题进行澄清或列举，将正确应对歧义的比例从 59.0% 提升至 77.0%。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）存在过度自信问题，尤其在视觉问答遇到指称歧义（图像中存在多个可能实体）时，难以区分有歧义与无歧义问题，往往默认给出单一确定答案而非请求澄清或列举。
AI.method: 提出轻量级框架 AmbiSteer，将提示与激活引导相结合，并利用线性分类器预测输入是否具有歧义，从而条件化地调整激活引导方向，以选择性诱导澄清或枚举等歧义感知行为。
AI.result: 在三种 VLM 上的测试表明，单独使用激活引导效果有限，结合提示和引导可大幅增加澄清和枚举行为但会波及无歧义案例；AmbiSteer 通过条件化引导，使跨模型恰当处理输入的平均比例从 59.0% 提升至 77.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在不确定的多模态场景下，采用轻量级推理期方法减少视觉语言模型的过度自信奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）通常表现出过度自信，即使在视觉证据不足时也会给出确定的回答。一个突出的情况是视觉问答（VQA）中的指称歧义，即图像中的多个实体都是问题的合理指称对象。处理此类情况需要识别何时存在歧义：对于歧义问题，可以通过请求澄清或列举合理的指称对象来处理，而无歧义问题则应获得直接回答。当前的 VLM 难以做出这种区分，往往默认采用单一解释。为了探究激活引导（activation steering）是否可以作为一种推理时机制来引出此类行为，我们提出了 AmbiSteer，这是一个用于选择性诱导歧义感知行为的轻量级框架。在三个 VLM 上的实验发现，单独引导的效果有限且依赖于具体模型，而提示通常更有效。将提示与引导相结合可大幅增加澄清和枚举行为，但也会在无歧义样本上诱发这些行为。AmbiSteer 通过使用线性分类器预测输入歧义性并相应地对引导方向进行条件调节解决了这一问题，使跨模型恰当处理输入的平均比例从 59.0% 提高到 77.0%。我们的工作为在不确定多模态设置下减少模型过度自信的轻量级方法奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对视觉语言模型在面临指称歧义时过度自信且难以自适应区分歧义的问题，提出了轻量级推理期干预框架 AmbiSteer。该框架结合提示与激活引导，并通过线性分类器识别输入歧义性来选择性调节引导方向，显著提升了模型恰当应对歧义与非歧义输入的能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 指称歧义, 激活引导, 过度自信, 视觉问答
AI.comments: 该研究具有很强的实用价值和创新性，首次探索了激活引导（activation steering）在缓解视觉语言模型歧义过度自信上的机制，并敏锐地发现了提示与引导结合时容易对非歧义样本“过度修正”的副作用，创新性地引入线性分类器进行条件引导。局限性在于分类器的判断准确率可能直接制约引导效果，且摘要显示仅在三种模型上进行了验证。

title: Zoom In, Scale Out: Metric Depth Models Mistake Digital Zoom for Moving Closer
summary: Many new AI models estimate how far away things are, in metres, from a single photo. To do this they must also work out what camera took the photo. We check whether they really do with a simple test: digital zoom, that is, cropping a photo and enlarging the crop back to full size. Zooming moves nothing in the scene, so a correct model should give the same distance for every point still in the picture. The test is free, exact and needs no labels. Two numbers describe a model's reaction: its depth changes like $s^{-α}$ (ideal $α=0$) and its focal-length estimate like $s^β$ (ideal $β=1$), for zoom factor $s$. On 800 images from KITTI, NYUv2 and DIODE, the widely used Depth Anything V2 has $α=0.95$: it treats a zoomed photo almost as if the camera had moved closer, because it judges distance mainly from how large things look. Models that also predict the camera remove only part of this error ($α\approx0.31$-$0.36$), because their focal estimate grows too little. Given the true camera, Depth Pro and DA3-Nested keep their depth ($α\approx0$), so the error lies in their camera estimate. The reason: a zoomed photo is, pixel for pixel, a normal photo of a scene squashed in depth, so size alone cannot tell the two apart, and a focal estimator trained by regression stays close to the cameras it saw in training. Undoing this needs no labels or training and makes Depth Pro pass the test ($α=0.04$) at almost no cost on normal photos. Controls, including a real optical zoom lens, rule out blur and resizing artefacts. Finally, label-free fine-tuning for self-consistency lowers $α$ to 0.05 on KITTI and 0.07 on NYUv2 once a "blurry means zoomed" shortcut is removed; we report what this costs on normal and unseen photos.

AI.title_translation: 放大与缩小：度量深度模型将数码变焦误认为是相机靠近
AI.tldr: 单目度量深度模型普遍严重依赖物体表观尺寸，会将数码变焦误判为相机拉近；本文定位出相机焦距估计是其瓶颈，并提出了无需标注的高效修复方案。
AI.motivation: 度量深度估计模型需要从单张照片中推算真实物理距离和相机参数。作者旨在验证现有模型是否真正理解相机与场景距离关系，还是仅仅依赖“物体看起来有多大”这一视觉捷径，将数码变焦错误地当成相机拉近。
AI.method: 设计了基于数码变焦（裁剪并放大）的零成本测试协议，用指数参数 $\alpha$（深度缩放系数）和 $\beta$（焦距缩放系数）量化模型误差；提出了针对 Depth Pro 的免训练修正方法，以及消除“模糊即变焦”捷径后的无标签自一致性微调（label-free fine-tuning）方法。
AI.result: Depth Anything V2 在变焦下 $\alpha=0.95$（近乎等同于相机前移）；带相机预测的模型 $\alpha \approx 0.31\sim0.36$；若直接提供真实相机内参，Depth Pro 等模型 $\alpha \approx 0$；采用提出的免训练方法可将 Depth Pro 的 $\alpha$ 降至 0.04；无标签微调进一步将 KITTI 和 NYUv2 上的 $\alpha$ 分别降至 0.05 和 0.07。
AI.conclusion: 当前单目度量深度模型普遍缺乏对变焦与物理移动的有效区分能力，根源在于相机焦距估计偏向训练集均值；通过无需标注的修正与自一致性微调，可以使模型在几乎不损失常规图像性能的前提下克服这一几何缺陷。
AI.translation: 许多新型人工智能模型能根据单张照片以米为单位估算物体的距离。为此，它们还必须推断出是用何种相机拍摄的照片。我们通过一个简单的测试来验证它们是否真正做到了这一点：数码变焦，即裁剪照片并将裁剪部分放大回完整尺寸。变焦并没有移动场景中的任何物体，因此正确的模型对于画面中保留的每个点都应给出相同的距离。该测试成本为零、结果精确且无需标签。我们用两个数字来描述模型的反应：对于变焦因子 $s$，其深度变化表现为 $s^{-\alpha}$（理想值为 $\alpha=0$），焦距估计变化表现为 $s^\beta$（理想值为 $\beta=1$）。在来自 KITTI、NYUv2 和 DIODE 的 800 张图像上，被广泛使用的 Depth Anything V2 的 $\alpha=0.95$：它几乎将放大的照片当成相机移动得更近，因为它主要根据物体看起来有多大来判断距离。能够同时预测相机的模型也仅能消除部分误差（$\alpha \approx 0.31\sim0.36$），因为它们的焦距估计增幅太小。在给定真实相机参数的情况下，Depth Pro 和 DA3-Nested 能够保持其深度（$\alpha \approx 0$），因此误差出在它们的相机估计上。其原因在于：放大的照片在像素级别上就是一张场景在深度方向被压扁的普通照片，仅凭尺寸无法将两者区分，而通过回归训练的焦距估计器往往局限于训练中见过的相机。纠正这一点无需标签或训练，即可让 Depth Pro 在对普通照片几乎无代价的情况下通过测试（$\alpha=0.04$）。包括真实光学变焦镜头在内的对照实验排除了模糊和尺寸调整伪影的影响。最后，在消除了“模糊即变焦”的捷径后，用于自一致性的无标签微调将 KITTI 上的 $\alpha$ 降至 0.05，NYUv2 上降至 0.07；我们还报告了这在常规及未见照片上所带来的代价。
AI.summary: 本文揭示了当前单目度量深度估计模型普遍存在的一个严重几何缺陷：将数码变焦误判为相机物理靠近。作者设计了无标注的变焦测试指标，证明误差主要来自相机焦距估计器的不足。进而提出了免训练的校正方案及无标签自一致性微调方法，成功解决了变焦引起的尺度漂移问题。
AI.keywords: 度量深度估计 (Metric Depth Estimation), 数码变焦 (Digital Zoom), 相机内参估计 (Camera Intrinsics), 尺度自一致性 (Scale Self-Consistency), 几何捷径 (Geometric Shortcut)
AI.comments: 该论文切入点极其巧妙且极具启发性。它通过“数码变焦”这一完全零标注成本的几何变换，直击当前单目绝对度量深度估计大模型依赖“表观物体尺寸”而非真正理解三维相机几何的痛点。揭示了相机参数回归泛化能力差是导致深度尺度崩溃的主因，并给出了实用且开销极小的免训练及无监督微调修复方案。

title: Cracks in Embeddings: Robustness and Stability of JEPA-Based Chest X-Ray Representations
summary: Self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models are increasingly used for medical imaging, however there is a limited understanding about robustness of these models toward real-world image changes. We test four JEPA-based chest X-ray encoders, trained on 78,468 NIH ChestX-ray14 images, under six tests: two black-box adversarial attacks (SPSA, Boundary Attack), three image corruptions (Gaussian noise, brightness shift, contrast shift), and a label-scarcity test, measuring embedding change and classification AUROC. These perturbations cause severe, model-dependent damage: encoder-level Cosine Similarity drops as low as 0.33, and AUROC falls by as much as 0.12 in the worst case (I-JEPA under the Boundary Test). We test two ways of training the small predictor on top of each frozen encoder to address this. Adversarial fine-tuning, trained on clean and perturbed images together, raises embedding consistency above 0.97 in nearly every case and improves AUROC, relative to the same perturbed baseline, for most models, with the largest gain of $+0.10$ on I-JEPA. A Vector-Quantized codebook method, trained only on clean images and evaluated on perturbed test images for the first time, instead degrades under distortion for all four models, most noticeably for I-JEPA ($-0.15$ AUROC on average), showing that its discrete bottleneck alone does not provide the robustness that comes from training on perturbed data directly.

AI.title_translation: 嵌入中的裂缝：基于JEPA的胸部X射线表示的鲁棒性与稳定性
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了基于JEPA的胸部X射线模型在对抗攻击和图像扰动下的脆弱性，并证明对抗微调能有效提升其鲁棒性，而离散VQ瓶颈则无法单独提供保护。
AI.motivation: 自监督联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）模型在医学影像中日益普及，但目前对其在应对真实世界图像变化时的鲁棒性与表征稳定性了解非常有限。
AI.method: 在78,468张NIH ChestX-ray14图像上训练4个JEPA胸部X射线编码器；设计6项测试（SPSA和Boundary黑盒对抗攻击、高斯噪声/亮度偏移/对比度偏移图像损坏、标签稀缺测试）；评估在冻结编码器上采用对抗微调与矢量量化（VQ）码本训练小型预测器的防御效果。
AI.result: 测试扰动导致严重且因模型而异的性能受损，余弦相似度降至0.33，AUROC最多下降0.12（I-JEPA在Boundary测试中）；对抗微调将嵌入一致性恢复至0.97以上并有效提升AUROC（I-JEPA提升达+0.10）；而仅在干净数据上训练的VQ码本方法在扰动下性能进一步退化（I-JEPA的AUROC平均下降0.15）。
AI.conclusion: 基于JEPA的医学影像表示在面对输入扰动和对抗攻击时表现出明显的脆弱性；仅凭矢量量化（离散瓶颈）无法抵御扰动，而结合干净与扰动样本的对抗微调是恢复模型表征稳定性和分类性能的有效途径。
AI.translation: 自监督联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）模型在医学影像中的应用日益广泛，然而关于这些模型应对真实世界图像变化的鲁棒性了解仍十分有限。我们在78,468张NIH ChestX-ray14图像上训练了四个基于JEPA的胸部X射线编码器，并在六种测试下进行评估：两种黑盒对抗攻击（SPSA、边界攻击）、三种图像损坏（高斯噪声、亮度偏移、对比度偏移）以及一项标签稀缺测试，用于测量嵌入变化和分类AUROC。这些扰动引起了严重的、依赖于模型的损害：编码器级别的余弦相似度最低降至0.33，在最坏情况下AUROC下降高达0.12（边界测试下的I-JEPA）。为了解决这一问题，我们在每个冻结的编码器上测试了两种训练小型预测器的方法。在干净和扰动图像上联合训练的对抗微调在几乎所有情况下都将嵌入一致性提高到0.97以上，并改善了大多数模型相对于相同扰动基线的AUROC，其中I-JEPA的增益最大（+0.10）。相比之下，首次在仅干净图像上训练并在扰动测试图像上评估的矢量量化（VQ）码本方法，在所有四个模型中遇到失真时性能均发生退化，其中I-JEPA最为显著（AUROC平均下降0.15），这表明仅依靠其离散瓶颈并不能提供直接在扰动数据上训练所获得的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本研究系统评估了基于JEPA的胸部X射线自监督编码器在面对对抗攻击和图像损坏时的鲁棒性。实验表明扰动会导致模型特征表示严重偏移和分类性能明显下降；通过对比发现，基于干净与扰动图像联合训练的对抗微调能显著恢复鲁棒性，而离散VQ码本机制则无法单纯依靠离散瓶颈提供抗扰动能力。
AI.keywords: 联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA), 胸部X射线, 模型鲁棒性, 对抗攻击, 矢量量化
AI.comments: 该研究针对JEPA自监督模型在医学影像关键场景下的安全与鲁棒性进行了系统检验，具有重要的现实意义；实验揭示了即使是先进的自监督架构也对扰动和攻击十分敏感，且证伪了“离散VQ瓶颈天然具备抗扰动能力”的假设，为后续构建高可靠医疗AI模型提供了明确指导。

title: Game-Theoretic Analysis of RIS-Assisted Challenge-Response PLA - Part II: Partial Channel Knowledge
comments: Part II of arXiv:2611.16557. Submitted to IEEE TIFS
summary: We consider a physical layer authentication scenario in which a legitimate user (Alice) communicates with an authenticator (Bob) through a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS), controlled by Bob. An attacker (Trudy) aims to impersonate Alice by suitably precoding her messages and still transmitting them through the RIS. This two-part study analyzes this attack-defense interaction between Bob and Trudy under perfect (Part I) and partial (Part II) channel knowledge by all the agents. Part I formulates the joint RIS selection and precoder design under perfect channel knowledge as a finite zero-sum game, establishing exact channel subspace conditions for attack indistinguishability alongside equilibrium mixed strategies. Part II extends the defense to incomplete channel information, where each agent observes only its own channel, by formulating a finite-action Bayesian game and characterizing the resulting Bayesian Nash equilibrium. Simulations in geometric and 3GPP TR 38.901 UMi-NLOS channels reveal that authentication performance is governed by available spatial degrees of freedom, channel correlation, and operating signal-to-noise ratio. The proposed equilibrium strategies effectively balance communication rate and security, outperforming conventional benchmark policies.
comment: Part II of arXiv:2611.16557. Submitted to IEEE TIFS

AI.title_translation: RIS辅助挑战-应答物理层认证的博弈论分析——第二部分：部分信道知识
AI.tldr: 本文通过构建有限动作贝叶斯博弈，分析了部分信道知识下RIS辅助物理层认证的攻防交互，给出了优于传统方案的均衡策略。
AI.motivation: 在RIS辅助的挑战-应答物理层认证系统中，攻击者企图通过预编码伪造合法用户身份，且在实际场景中各方通常仅能获取局部/不完全信道信息，因此需要研究非完美信道知识下攻防双方的博弈行为与防御策略。
AI.method: 将各节点仅能获取自身信道状态的不完全信息防御交互建模为有限动作贝叶斯博弈（finite-action Bayesian game），并求解分析其贝叶斯纳什均衡（Bayesian Nash equilibrium）；在几何信道与3GPP TR 38.901 UMi-NLOS信道下进行了仿真验证。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，认证性能主要取决于可用的空间自由度、信道相关性以及工作信噪比；所提出的贝叶斯均衡策略有效权衡了通信速率与安全性，显著超越了传统基准策略。
AI.conclusion: 在部分信道知识条件下，所提出的贝叶斯纳什均衡策略能够有效权衡通信速率与安全性能，其认证表现受空间自由度、信道相关性及信噪比的综合制约，且性能显著优于传统基准方案。
AI.translation: 我们考虑一个物理层认证场景，其中合法用户（Alice）通过由认证方（Bob）控制的可重构智能表面（RIS）与Bob进行通信。攻击者（Trudy）试图通过适当地对其消息进行预编码并同样通过RIS传输来冒充Alice。该由两部分组成的研究分析了在所有参与者拥有完美信道知识（第一部分）和部分信道知识（第二部分）下Bob与Trudy之间的攻防交互。第一部分将完美信道知识下的RIS联合选择与预编码器设计表述为有限零和博弈，建立了攻击不可区分性的精确信道子空间条件以及混合策略均衡。第二部分通过构建有限动作贝叶斯博弈并表征所得的贝叶斯纳什均衡，将防御拓展到每个参与者仅能观测自身信道的不完全信道信息场景。在几何信道和3GPP TR 38.901 UMi-NLOS信道下的仿真表明，认证性能由可用空间自由度、信道相关性以及工作信噪比决定。所提出的均衡策略有效权衡了通信速率与安全性，优于传统基准策略。
AI.summary: 本文研究了RIS辅助的挑战-应答物理层认证在不完全信道信息下的攻防交互。作者将认证方与攻击者之间的策略博弈建模为有限动作贝叶斯博弈，推导了贝叶斯纳什均衡。在几何信道和3GPP标准信道下的仿真表明，该策略可有效平衡通信速率与安全性能，大幅优于基准方法。
AI.keywords: 智能反射面 (RIS), 物理层认证 (PLA), 贝叶斯博弈, 挑战-应答机制, 部分信道知识
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将RIS辅助的物理层认证建模为不完全信息下的贝叶斯博弈，克服了传统研究中对全局完美信道状态信息（CSI）的严苛假设，更契合实际无线环境。其重要性体现在为RIS赋能的安全通信提供了兼顾速率与认证性能的博弈均衡策略。局限在于该分析基于有限动作博弈，若实际系统动作空间连续或信道估计误差严重，均衡解的复杂度与可行性可能面临挑战。

title: DiffusionSSD: Achieving Extreme Visual Compression with Dual-stage Diffusion and Cross-level Near-Data Processing
summary:
Growing visual data overwhelms storage on resource-constrained edge devices, making compression essential. Traditional codecs offer inadequate rate-distortion performance, motivating the exploration of diffusion codecs. Diffusion codecs face two limitations: (1) At the algorithm level, diffusion decoders preserve perceptual quality under extreme compression, but require substantial computation. (2) At the architecture level, in NPU-centered devices, neural codecs occupy the NPU, interfering with other AI applications. Meanwhile, the complex codec pipeline incurs long I/O paths, leading to additional overhead and energy cost.
  To address these issues, we propose DiffusionSSD, a cross-level near-data processing framework for extreme visual data compression on edge devices, using an algorithm-architecture co-design method. Specifically, (1) at algorithm level, we present Dual-stage Diffusion, a lightweight solution tailored for diffusion codecs that employs patchification and single-step diffusion, reducing computation cost while preserving perceptual quality; (2) at architecture level, we introduce a Cross-level Near Data Processing architecture that integrates the proposed computational universal flash storage (cUFS) and LPDDR-PIM, enabling codecs to be entirely offloaded to data side while reducing visual-data movement and avoiding SoC redesign; (3) at system level, combining both the algorithm and the underlying architecture, we propose a Patch-Workload co-aware scheduling scheme to enable more efficient system-level execution. Experiments show that Dual-stage Diffusion maintains comparable perceptual quality while reducing computation cost by up to 92.7%. Compared with NPU+DRAM and near-data-processing design such as SmartSSD, cUFS+PIM improves coding throughput by 2.32 times and 2.91 times on average, respectively.

AI.title_translation: DiffusionSSD：通过双阶段扩散与跨层级近数据处理实现极限视觉压缩
AI.tldr: DiffusionSSD通过双阶段扩散算法与cUFS+PIM近数据处理架构协同设计，在减少92.7%计算量的同时使吞吐量提升2倍以上，实现了边缘端高效极限视觉压缩。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备存储空间受限，传统编解码器率失真性能不足，而新兴的扩散编解码器存在计算开销过大（算法层面）以及抢占NPU、I/O路径长带来额外能耗开销（架构层面）的两大瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出DiffusionSSD协同设计框架：(1) 算法层面：提出双阶段扩散（Dual-stage Diffusion），利用分块处理（patchification）和单步扩散显著降低计算量并保持感知质量；(2) 架构层面：提出跨层级近数据处理架构，结合计算型通用闪存存储（cUFS）与LPDDR-PIM，将编解码完全卸载至数据端并减少数据迁移；(3) 系统层面：提出分块与工作负载协同感知（Patch-Workload co-aware）调度方案以优化执行效率。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，双阶段扩散在维持相近感知质量的同时，将计算开销降低了高达92.7%；所提出的cUFS+PIM相比NPU+DRAM架构以及SmartSSD等近数据处理设计，编码吞吐量分别平均提升了2.32倍和2.91倍。
AI.conclusion: DiffusionSSD通过算法与硬件协同设计，有效解决了扩散编解码器在边缘设备上的计算和I/O瓶颈，在保证极高感知压缩质量的同时实现了高能效与高吞吐量的视觉数据处理。
AI.translation: 持续增长的视觉数据对资源受限的边缘设备存储造成了巨大压力，使数据压缩变得不可或缺。传统编解码器的率失真性能不足，促使人们开始探索扩散编解码器。扩散编解码器面临两个局限：(1) 算法层面，扩散解码器虽然在极限压缩下能保持感知质量，但需要巨额计算；(2) 架构层面，在以NPU为中心的设备中，神经编解码器会占用NPU，干扰其他AI应用的执行。同时，复杂的编解码流水线带来了冗长的I/O路径，导致额外的系统开销与能耗。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了DiffusionSSD，一种面向边缘设备极限视觉数据压缩的跨层级近数据处理框架，该框架采用了软硬件协同设计方法。具体而言，(1) 在算法层面，我们提出了双阶段扩散（Dual-stage Diffusion），这是一种专为扩散编解码器定制的轻量化方案，采用分块化与单步扩散，在降低计算开销的同时保留感知质量；(2) 在架构层面，我们引入了跨层级近数据处理架构，集成了所提出的计算型通用闪存存储（cUFS）和LPDDR-PIM，使编解码器能够完全卸载到数据侧，从而减少视觉数据移动并避免对SoC的重新设计；(3) 在系统层面，结合算法与底层硬件架构，我们提出了一种分块-工作负载协同感知的调度机制，以实现更高效的系统级执行。实验表明，双阶段扩散在保持相近感知质量的同时，最多可减少92.7%的计算开销。与NPU+DRAM以及SmartSSD等近数据处理设计相比，cUFS+PIM将编解码吞吐量平均分别提升了2.32倍和2.91倍。
AI.summary: 针对边缘端极限视觉压缩场景中扩散编解码器计算负荷大、抢占NPU及I/O开销高的问题，本文提出了DiffusionSSD软硬件协同设计框架。算法上采用轻量化的双阶段扩散降低92.7%计算量，硬件架构上结合cUFS和LPDDR-PIM实现跨层级近数据处理与全编解码卸载，并辅以系统级协同感知调度，大幅提升了编解码吞吐量并保证了感知质量。
AI.keywords: 视觉压缩, 扩散编解码器, 近数据处理, 软硬件协同设计, 存内计算
AI.comments: 该论文通过软硬件协同设计的方式解决扩散模型在边缘端极限视觉压缩中的高计算负载与I/O开销瓶颈，创新性地提出了两阶段扩散算法以及结合cUFS与LPDDR-PIM的跨层级近数据处理架构，在显著降低计算量与数据搬移的同时避免了复杂的SoC重构，具有很强的实用价值和前瞻性。局限在于该架构依赖定制化的硬件支持（cUFS和PIM），在现有商用边缘硬件上的普及部署仍面临硬件生态成熟度的挑战。

title: CardioTrace: Motion-Aware Cine Synthesis via Coupled Tracing and Segmentation
summary: Cardiac cine MRI provides time-resolved visualization of cardiac motion and is essential for evaluating ventricular function and anatomy. In routine clinical acquisition, however, cine sequences are frequently temporally sparse or degraded by arrhythmia, motion, and scan-time constraints, which can hinder reliable quantification and downstream analysis. We present CardioTrace, a motion-aware cine synthesis framework that generates a full cardiac cine sequence from limited input while explicitly modeling and tracing cardiac motion. CardioTrace couples two complementary pathways: a pixel-translation branch that directly predicts cine frames in a residual formulation, and a flow-field branch that estimates time-resolved deformation fields from a reference phase to provide interpretable motion correspondences across frames. To further preserve anatomical plausibility, a segmentation branch supervises clinically meaningful cardiac structures at key phases, and a cross-branch consistency objective encourages the synthesized appearance dynamics to follow the explicit motion guidance, mitigating temporal drift and unrealistic shape transitions over long sequences. The framework also supports prompt-style conditioning to incorporate auxiliary patient or acquisition information, improving robustness across heterogeneous multi-center data. Experiments on public cardiac cine MRI datasets demonstrate that CardioTrace improves perceptual quality and temporal coherence over representative GAN- and diffusion-based baselines, while better preserving ventricular morphology throughout the cardiac cycle. \textit{Our codes are available after review}.

AI.title_translation: CardioTrace：基于耦合追踪与分割的运动感知电影磁共振合成
AI.tldr: CardioTrace通过耦合像素生成分支、运动流场分支与解剖分割监督，实现了从有限输入中高质量合成具有时间连贯性和解剖保真度的心脏电影MRI序列。
AI.motivation: 临床常规采集的心脏电影MRI常因扫描时间限制、运动或心律失常导致时间分辨率稀疏或图像质量退化，严重阻碍了心室功能与解剖结构的可靠定量分析。
AI.method: CardioTrace耦合了两个互补通路：一是采用残差形式直接预测帧图像的像素平移分支，二是从参考相位估计时间分辨形变场的流场分支；同时引入分割分支在关键相位监督心脏解剖结构，并设计跨分支一致性目标约束外观动态遵循运动引导；此外还支持提示词风格的条件注入以融合辅助临床与采集信息。
AI.result: 在公开心脏电影MRI数据集上的实验结果表明，CardioTrace在感知质量和时间连贯性方面均优于现有的GAN和扩散模型基准，且在整个心动周期内能更好地保持心室形态结构。
AI.conclusion: CardioTrace通过显式运动建模与解剖先验约束，能从受限/退化的输入中鲁棒且高质量地合成具有真实运动连贯性与解剖保真度的心脏电影MRI序列。
AI.translation: 心脏电影磁共振（cine MRI）能够提供心脏运动的时间分辨可视化，对于评估心室功能和解剖结构至关重要。然而在常规临床采集中心动电影序列往往时间稀疏，或因心律失常、运动伪影和扫描时间限制而发生退化，这阻碍了可靠的定量评估和下游分析。我们提出了CardioTrace，一个运动感知的电影合成框架，能够在显式建模和追踪心脏运动的同时，从受限的输入生成完整的心脏电影序列。CardioTrace耦合了两个互补分支：一个以残差形式直接预测电影帧的像素平移分支，以及一个从参考相位估计时间分辨形变场以提供跨帧可解释运动对应关系的流场分支。为了进一步保持解剖结构的合理性，分割分支在关键相位对具有临床意义的心脏结构进行监督，同时跨分支一致性目标促使合成的外观动态遵循显式运动引导，从而减轻长序列中的时间漂移和不切实际的形态过渡。该框架还支持提示风格的条件注入以引入辅助的患者或采集信息，提高了在异构多中心数据中的鲁棒性。在公开心脏电影MRI数据集上的实验表明，相比代表性的基于GAN和扩散模型的基准方法，CardioTrace提升了感知质量与时间连贯性，并在整个心动周期中更好地保留了心室形态。我们的代码将在论文审稿后开源。
AI.summary: 针对心脏电影MRI序列易受退化和时间稀疏影响的问题，本文提出了CardioTrace框架。该方法结合像素平移分支与流场运动追踪分支，并在关键相位施加分割引导和跨分支一致性约束，从受限输入中合成兼具高感知质量、时间连贯性和解剖真实性的全心脏电影序列。
AI.keywords: 心脏电影MRI, 图像合成, 运动追踪, 形变场, 解剖分割
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将显式的运动流场追踪、隐式像素生成网络与关键解剖结构的语义分割进行耦合，并通过跨分支一致性有效解决了生成模型在长时间动态序列中常见的时间漂移和解剖失真问题。此外，引入提示式条件增强了多中心异构数据的适应性。潜在局限在于依赖形变场估计，对极度不规则心律或严重结构病变的合成稳定性仍需进一步验证。

title: Adversarially Attacking Symbolic Vocabulary Vulnerabilities In LLM Planners
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, their abilities in navigating automated planning tasks have become essential. However, despite their strengths, LLMs' planning ability is not robust, particularly when they are not allowed to exploit commonsense cues in the symbolic vocabulary (e.g., names of actions, predicates, and objects) used to define planning tasks. This makes LLMs unreliable compared to symbolic planners. With recent reasoning models showing improved planning performance on tasks with obfuscated symbolic vocabularies, we utilize an adversarial attack framework to reveal to what extent the crucial weaknesses of LLM agents at joint symbolic interpretation and planning remain and whether they can reason properly when presented with severe cases. As such, our main contribution is devising an LLM-based attack model, which we call Symbolic Swapper, to automatically generate obfuscated planning domains with non-standard symbolic vocabularies that systematically break strong reasoning models' ability to plan. In doing so, we reveal how much LLMs' planning abilities can be further degraded under more advanced obfuscation schemes, allowing us to ascertain their success when having to rely on their pure planning ability. We find that attacks can decrease the planning performance of base models and even robust planning frameworks by over 70%. We further analyze the factors behind how LLM planning abilities break down and find that successful obfuscation causes models to appear to significantly degrade in reasoning quality despite them showing some inherent ability to understand the domain, revealing a gap in the perception of a task domain and being able to plan under it.

AI.title_translation: 针对LLM规划器中符号词汇漏洞的对抗攻击
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Symbolic Swapper的对抗攻击方法，通过混淆符号词汇使LLM规划器的性能下降超70%，揭示了其缺乏纯规划能力的本质。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）在规划任务中缺乏鲁棒性，高度依赖符号词汇（如动作、谓词和对象名称）中的常识线索。为探究最新推理模型在面对严重符号混淆时是否真正具备纯粹的规划推理能力，作者构建对抗攻击框架进行深入测试。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于LLM的对抗攻击模型“Symbolic Swapper”，该模型能够自动生成包含非标准符号词汇的混淆规划域，从而系统性地瓦解先进推理模型的规划能力。
AI.result: 对抗攻击使得基础模型乃至更具鲁棒性的规划框架的规划性能下降超过70%；分析表明，成功的混淆导致模型推理质量显著恶化，揭示出模型在任务域感知与在该域下进行实际规划之间存在明显断层。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明LLM规划器对非标准符号词汇高度脆弱，即使展现出一定的领域理解感知能力，也难以在混淆符号下进行有效规划，暴露出LLM在领域感知与纯粹规划执行之间存在显著差距。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为自主智能体，它们在自动化规划任务中的能力变得至关重要。然而，尽管LLM能力强大，但其规划能力并不鲁棒，尤其是在无法利用定义规划任务的符号词汇（例如动作、谓词和对象的名称）中的常识线索时，这使得LLM与符号规划器相比显得不够可靠。尽管近期的推理模型在具有混淆符号词汇的任务上表现出了规划性能的提升，但我们利用对抗攻击框架揭示了LLM智能体在联合符号解释和规划方面的关键缺陷在多大程度上依然存在，以及它们在面对极端情况时是否能够正常推理。因此，我们的主要贡献是设计了一种基于LLM的攻击模型，称为Symbolic Swapper，用于自动生成具有非标准符号词汇的混淆规划域，从而系统性地破坏强大推理模型的规划能力。通过这种方式，我们揭示了在更高级的混淆方案下，LLM的规划能力会被进一步削弱到何种程度，进而检验其在必须依赖纯规划能力时的表现。我们发现，这些攻击可以使基础模型乃至具备鲁棒性的规划框架的规划性能下降超过70%。我们进一步分析了导致LLM规划能力崩溃的深层因素，发现成功的混淆虽然让模型表现出对领域具有一定内在理解能力，但其推理质量却显著恶化，这揭示了任务域感知与在该领域下进行规划之间存在差距。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM规划器对符号词汇常识线索的依赖漏洞，提出了对抗攻击框架Symbolic Swapper，通过自动生成非标准符号词汇混淆规划域来系统测试模型的纯规划能力。实验表明该攻击可导致规划性能下降超70%，揭示了LLM在领域感知与实际规划能力之间的脱节。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型规划器, 对抗攻击, 符号词汇混淆, 规划鲁棒性, 自主智能体
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地从对抗攻击视角评估大语言模型规划器的鲁棒性，揭示了模型看似提升的推理能力很大程度上仍依赖于符号语义常识先验，而非纯粹的形式规划逻辑。这一发现对于评估与改进基于LLM的自主智能体具有重要警示意义。局限性在于攻击方法依赖于符号替换混淆，对真实世界规划场景中更复杂逻辑扰动的泛化性仍有待进一步探讨。

title: DOCKET: A Pluralistic Benchmark for Evaluating AI-Assisted Policy Feedback in U.S. Rulemaking
summary: As AI models advance and impact deliberative democracies, there is a growing need to assess their support of pluralistic viewpoints. Most pluralism benchmarks are insufficient for this: they are not grounded in diversity (i.e., stakeholders across different frames, skills and needs), quality (i.e., rigorous and technical debates), and impact (i.e., invested deliberators and real-world outcomes). To address this, we first (i) curate DOCKET, the most comprehensive dataset of the U.S. Federal Notice & Comment process to date. DOCKET consists of 42.3M public comments on 22,400 regulations across 44 government agencies between 2016 and 2026 and contains millions of policy debates; we link public comments to particular policy items proposed by regulators to track the public's attention and the responsiveness of regulators to public input. (ii) Next, we demonstrate the pluralistic utility of DOCKET - we show that public commenters have a wide breadth of perspectives with significant depth in policy expertise and that regulators are often responsive. (iii) Finally, we present DOCKETBench, the first systematic evaluation of LLMs' ability to represent human policy perspectives in federal rulemaking. Only 18-30% of LLM-generated feedback aligns with real human comments. LLMs critique proposals broadly but generally, lacking the specific grounding, citations, and lived-experience arguments that humans bring to bear; in addition, most models we test systematically agree with government perspectives (overlapping with up to 68% of their claims) and agree least with labor unions (as little as 26% of their claims), demonstrating a fundamental skew in perspectives that even tools like persona modeling do not solve. Taken together, we reveal fundamental gaps in how language models navigate real policy issues, and DOCKETBench serves as a testbed for closing those gaps in a crucial real-world domain.

AI.title_translation: DOCKET：一个评估美国法规制定中AI辅助政策反馈的多元化基准
AI.tldr: 该研究推出了DOCKET数据集和DOCKETBench基准，用于评估LLM在美国法规制定中代表多元化人类政策观点的能力，发现LLM在与人类评论对齐方面表现不佳，并存在偏向政府观点的系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 随着AI模型的发展及其对审议民主的影响，需要评估AI对多元化观点的支持。现有的多元化基准不足，因为它们缺乏多样性（不同背景、技能和需求）、质量（严格和技术性辩论）和影响力（投入的审议者和现实世界结果）。
AI.method: 1. 策展了DOCKET数据集，这是迄今为止最全面的美国联邦公告与评论流程数据集，包含2016年至2026年间来自44个政府机构的22,400项法规的4230万条公众评论。数据集将公众评论与监管机构提出的具体政策项目关联。2. 展示了DOCKET的多元化实用性，表明公众评论者具有广泛且深入的政策专业知识，且监管机构通常会做出回应。3. 提出了DOCKETBench，这是首次系统性评估大型语言模型（LLM）在联邦法规制定中代表人类政策观点的能力。
AI.result: 1. LLM生成的反馈与真实人类评论的对齐度仅为18-30%。2. LLM对提案的批评宽泛且笼统，缺乏人类评论所具有的具体依据、引用和亲身经验论证。3. 大多数测试模型系统性地与政府观点一致（高达68%的声明重叠），而与工会的观点一致性最低（低至26%的声明），这表明存在根本性的视角偏差，即使像角色建模这样的工具也无法解决。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了语言模型在处理真实政策问题方面的根本性差距，DOCKETBench作为一个测试平台，旨在弥补这些在关键现实世界领域中的差距。
AI.translation: 随着人工智能模型的发展并影响审议民主，越来越需要评估它们对多元化观点的支持。大多数多元化基准对此不足：它们没有以多样性（即跨不同框架、技能和需求的利益相关者）、质量（即严谨和技术性辩论）和影响力（即投入的审议者和现实世界结果）为基础。为了解决这个问题，我们首先（i）策划了DOCKET，这是迄今为止最全面的美国联邦公告与评论流程数据集。DOCKET包含2016年至2026年间来自44个政府机构的22,400项法规的4230万条公众评论，并包含数百万次政策辩论；我们将公众评论与监管机构提出的特定政策项目关联起来，以追踪公众的关注度以及监管机构对公众意见的响应程度。（ii）接下来，我们展示了DOCKET的多元化效用——我们表明公众评论者具有广泛的视角和深厚的政策专业知识，并且监管机构通常会做出回应。（iii）最后，我们提出了DOCKETBench，这是首次系统性评估大型语言模型（LLM）在联邦法规制定中代表人类政策观点的能力。只有18-30%的LLM生成反馈与真实人类评论一致。LLM对提案的批评广泛但笼统，缺乏人类所带来的具体依据、引用和亲身经验论证；此外，我们测试的大多数模型系统性地与政府观点一致（与高达68%的声明重叠），而与工会的观点一致性最低（低至26%的声明），这表明存在根本性的视角偏差，即使像角色建模这样的工具也无法解决。总而言之，我们揭示了语言模型在处理真实政策问题方面的根本性差距，DOCKETBench作为一个测试平台，旨在弥补这些在关键现实世界领域中的差距。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了DOCKET，一个包含4230万条美国联邦法规公众评论的综合数据集，旨在解决现有多元化基准的不足。研究利用DOCKET展示了公众评论的多元化和监管机构的响应性。在此基础上，提出了DOCKETBench，首次系统评估了大型语言模型（LLM）在联邦法规制定中代表人类政策观点的能力。评估结果表明，LLM生成的反馈与真实人类评论的对齐度较低（18-30%），且倾向于政府观点，缺乏人类评论的深度和具体性，揭示了LLM在处理真实政策问题方面的局限性和偏差。DOCKETBench为弥补这些差距提供了一个测试平台。
AI.keywords: AI辅助政策反馈, 多元化基准, 大型语言模型（LLM）, 美国法规制定, 政策偏见
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过构建大规模、高质量的DOCKET数据集和DOCKETBench基准，创新性地解决了AI在审议民主中支持多元化观点评估的难题。其重要性在于揭示了当前LLM在理解和代表复杂、多元化政策观点方面的显著不足和系统性偏见，特别是对政府观点的过度认同和对特定群体（如工会）观点的忽视。这对于AI辅助政策制定工具的开发具有重要的指导意义，强调了未来模型需要更好地捕捉人类经验、具体论证和多元化视角，以避免加剧现有偏见或简化复杂的政策辩论。

title: SWIFT: Sample-Wise Instance Fine-Tuning of Time-Series Foundation Models for Forecasting
summary: While current few-shot adaptation strategies for time series forecasting foundation models are predominantly dataset-centric, the necessity of obtaining an additional dataset for the finetuning process poses a significant hurdle for adoption. To address this constraint, we propose Sample-Wise Instance Fine-Tuning (SWIFT), a novel forecasting adaptation framework that achieves fine-grained specialization by leveraging structural priors from the target instance's own history. This shift allows the fine-tuning process to be entirely transparent to the end-user, which significantly enhances the ease of adoption. To implement this framework, SWIFT synergizes Self-Retrieval for historical mining and Frequency-Aware Loss for spectral consistency, while employing Deviation-Aware Dynamic Fusion to balance adaptation with general knowledge preservation. Extensive experiments across four TSFM backbones and three long-history benchmark subsets validate SWIFT, yielding average MASE and WQL reductions of 6.41% and 4.83% across 24 combinations of four backbones and six Chronos Benchmark II datasets. To the best of our knowledge, SWIFT is the first framework to investigate sample-wise instance fine-tuning of time-series foundation models, specializing the model for an individual prediction window using only the corresponding forecasting sample's own observed history.

AI.title_translation: SWIFT: 用于预测的时间序列基础模型的样本级实例微调
AI.tldr: SWIFT是一种新的时间序列预测适应框架，通过利用目标实例自身的历史结构先验进行样本级微调，无需额外数据集，提高了采用便利性，并在多个基准测试中取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 当前时间序列预测基础模型的少样本适应策略主要是数据集中心的，需要额外的微调数据集，这阻碍了其采用。
AI.method: SWIFT通过利用目标实例自身历史的结构先验实现细粒度专业化。它结合了用于历史挖掘的自检索（Self-Retrieval）和用于频谱一致性的频率感知损失（Frequency-Aware Loss），并采用偏差感知动态融合（Deviation-Aware Dynamic Fusion）来平衡适应性与通用知识保留。
AI.result: 在四个TSFM骨干和三个长历史基准子集上进行了广泛实验，SWIFT在24种组合（四个骨干和六个Chronos Benchmark II数据集）中，平均MASE和WQL分别降低了6.41%和4.83%。
AI.conclusion: SWIFT是第一个研究时间序列基础模型样本级实例微调的框架，它仅使用相应预测样本自身的观测历史来针对单个预测窗口对模型进行专业化。
AI.translation: 当前时间序列预测基础模型的少样本适应策略主要是以数据集为中心的，但获取额外的微调数据集的必要性对采用构成了重大障碍。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了样本级实例微调（SWIFT），这是一种新颖的预测适应框架，通过利用目标实例自身历史的结构先验实现细粒度专业化。这种转变使得微调过程对最终用户完全透明，从而显著提高了采用的便利性。为了实现这一框架，SWIFT协同了用于历史挖掘的自检索（Self-Retrieval）和用于频谱一致性的频率感知损失（Frequency-Aware Loss），同时采用偏差感知动态融合（Deviation-Aware Dynamic Fusion）来平衡适应性与通用知识保留。在四个TSFM骨干和三个长历史基准子集上进行了广泛实验，验证了SWIFT，在四个骨干和六个Chronos Benchmark II数据集的24种组合中，平均MASE和WQL分别降低了6.41%和4.83%。据我们所知，SWIFT是第一个研究时间序列基础模型样本级实例微调的框架，它仅使用相应预测样本自身的观测历史来针对单个预测窗口对模型进行专业化。
AI.summary: SWIFT提出了一种新颖的样本级实例微调框架，用于时间序列预测基础模型。它通过利用目标实例自身的历史结构先验进行细粒度专业化，无需额外数据集，解决了现有数据集中心适应策略的局限性。该框架整合了自检索、频率感知损失和偏差感知动态融合。实验证明，SWIFT在多个基准测试中显著提高了预测性能，是首个实现仅基于单个预测样本历史进行模型专业化的框架，极大地简化了基础模型的采用过程。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预测, 基础模型, 实例微调, 样本级适应, SWIFT
AI.comments: SWIFT的创新之处在于其“样本级实例微调”方法，打破了传统依赖额外数据集进行微调的范式，通过利用实例自身的历史数据进行适应，极大地提高了时间序列基础模型的可用性和易用性。这种方法对于实际应用中数据获取受限的场景具有重要意义。

title: When Cooperation Must Change: Semantic Strategy Unlearning in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) supports coordinated decision-making in distributed Web services, multi-robot control, and collaborative games through learned coordination conventions. When deployment requirements change, a previously useful convention may become obsolete or unsafe. For example, revised cache-sharing permissions in Web content delivery may require caches to abandon a learned division of storage and serving roles while maintaining efficient delivery. Teams must therefore remove the specified convention while preserving useful cooperation. This is challenging because the same relational pattern can be reproduced by different agents across different histories. Runtime shielding leaves the underlying coordination preference intact and can impair task progress, while existing reinforcement unlearning and trajectory-deletion methods do not directly target role-invariant conventions. This paper formalizes this problem as semantic coordination-strategy unlearning and proposes CARVE.CARVE uses causal coordination attribution to identify influential interactions and retain-aware subspace updates to limit interference with unrelated behaviors. Counterfactual re-coordination helps agents learn productive alternatives, while adversarial auditing tests whether the target convention can still be recovered. Accepted updates are merged into decentralized actors for direct deployment. Evaluation across five cooperative MARL benchmarks shows that CARVE reduces mean nominal convention-completion and worst-case elicitation rates by 91.4\% and 83.3\%, respectively.The median utility loss is 5.9\%, and measured inference latency matches that of the original policies.

AI.title_translation: 当合作必须改变时：多智能体强化学习中的语义策略遗忘
AI.tldr: 本文提出了CARVE，一种用于多智能体强化学习中语义协调策略遗忘的方法，旨在移除过时或不安全的合作约定，同时保留有用的合作。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体强化学习中，当部署要求改变时，之前有用的合作约定可能会变得过时或不安全。现有的方法无法直接针对角色不变的约定进行遗忘，同时保留有用的合作。
AI.method: 本文将问题形式化为语义协调策略遗忘，并提出了CARVE。CARVE利用因果协调归因来识别有影响力的交互，并使用保留感知子空间更新来限制对无关行为的干扰。反事实再协调帮助智能体学习有成效的替代方案，而对抗性审计则测试目标约定是否仍可恢复。接受的更新会合并到去中心化智能体中进行直接部署。
AI.result: 在五个合作性MARL基准测试中，CARVE将平均名义约定完成率和最坏情况下的引发率分别降低了91.4%和83.3%。中位数效用损失为5.9%，测得的推理延迟与原始策略一致。
AI.conclusion: CARVE能够有效地移除多智能体强化学习中过时或不安全的语义协调策略，同时保持了高效的合作并具有可接受的性能开销。
AI.translation: 合作性多智能体强化学习（MARL）通过学习到的协调约定，支持分布式Web服务、多机器人控制和协作游戏中的协调决策。当部署要求改变时，之前有用的约定可能会变得过时或不安全。例如，Web内容交付中修订的缓存共享权限可能要求缓存放弃学习到的存储和服务角色划分，同时保持高效交付。因此，团队必须移除指定的约定，同时保留有用的合作。这具有挑战性，因为相同的关系模式可以由不同智能体在不同历史中重现。运行时屏蔽保留了潜在的协调偏好，并可能损害任务进展，而现有的强化遗忘和轨迹删除方法不直接针对角色不变的约定。本文将此问题形式化为语义协调策略遗忘，并提出了CARVE。CARVE利用因果协调归因来识别有影响力的交互，并使用保留感知子空间更新来限制对无关行为的干扰。反事实再协调帮助智能体学习有成效的替代方案，而对抗性审计则测试目标约定是否仍可恢复。接受的更新会合并到去中心化智能体中进行直接部署。在五个合作性MARL基准测试中，评估表明CARVE将平均名义约定完成率和最坏情况下的引发率分别降低了91.4%和83.3%。中位数效用损失为5.9%，测得的推理延迟与原始策略一致。
AI.summary: 本文解决了多智能体强化学习中语义协调策略遗忘的挑战，即在部署要求变化时，如何移除过时或不安全的合作约定，同时保留有用的合作。为此，论文提出了CARVE，一个通过因果归因、保留感知更新、反事实再协调和对抗性审计来识别、移除目标约定并学习替代方案的框架。实验结果表明，CARVE在降低约定完成率和引发率方面表现出色，且效用损失和推理延迟可接受。
AI.keywords: 多智能体强化学习, 策略遗忘, 语义协调, CARVE, 合作改变
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法CARVE，用于解决多智能体强化学习中语义协调策略遗忘的挑战，这在现实世界的动态环境中具有重要意义。其创新之处在于将问题形式化为语义遗忘，并结合了因果归因、子空间更新、反事实学习和对抗性审计等多种技术，以确保有效移除目标约定同时最小化对其他有用行为的干扰。该方法在实际应用中具有潜力，尤其是在需要灵活调整智能体合作行为的场景中。一个潜在的局限性可能是其复杂性以及在更大规模或更复杂任务中的可扩展性。

title: Condensing Law of Security Information
summary: Scaling laws indicate that the generalization error of a large language model (LLM) decreases monotonically with model size once data is sufficient, and the corollary that larger models outperform smaller ones is now widely accepted. We argue that this corollary fails in security: decisions there hinge on anomalous inputs, which are long-tailed (e.g., zero-day attacks) and therefore poorly served by likelihood fitting. Worse still, the capability brought about by scale (e.g., inferring the intended whole from a corrupted part) leads a LLM silently \emph{repair} the anomaly before any downstream security head ever sees it. We formalize this as a tradeoff between two quantities: the cognitive capability $K(W)=I(W;P)$ that a model holds about the world distribution, and the security-information retention $R(W)=\frac{I(Z;S)}{I(A;S)}$ that survives in its intermediate representation. We derive three information-theoretic bounds to connect them: an upper bound on restoration accuracy in terms of $K(W)$, an upper bound on $R(W)$ in terms of the restoration error, and a Fano lower bound on security-task error in terms of $R(W)$. These theorems approximately imply that usable security information is a product of how much security information survives and how well it can be extracted, indicating that optimal usable security information can be achieved at a certain model size. We state this as the \emph{condensing law of security information}: usable security information is unimodal in model size, so security generalization error is U-shaped and is minimized at a finite $N^{\star}$ rather than decreasing without bound. The experiments on various real-world LLMs validate the condensing law, indicating that there is an optimal model size to solve security issues.

AI.title_translation: 安全信息凝聚定律
AI.tldr: 针对安全领域的LLM，存在一个最优模型尺寸，使得安全泛化误差最小，而非越大越好，这被称为安全信息凝聚定律。
AI.motivation: 现有观点认为大型语言模型（LLM）越大性能越好，但在安全领域，模型规模的增加可能导致LLM“修复”异常输入，从而损害其识别异常输入的能力，因此需要探究LLM在安全任务中的真实性能与模型规模的关系。
AI.method: 本文通过形式化模型的认知能力$K(W)$和安全信息保留$R(W)$之间的权衡，推导了三个信息论界限（关于恢复准确性的上限、关于$R(W)$的上限以及关于安全任务误差的Fano下限）来连接它们，并在此基础上提出了“安全信息凝聚定律”。
AI.result: 理论推导表明，可用安全信息是安全信息存活量和提取能力的乘积，且在特定模型尺寸下可实现最优。提出了“安全信息凝聚定律”，即可用安全信息在模型尺寸上呈单峰分布，安全泛化误差呈U形，并在有限的$N^{	ext{*}}$处最小化。实验验证了这一凝聚定律。
AI.conclusion: 在解决安全问题时，存在一个最优的模型尺寸，而非模型越大越好。
AI.translation:
标题：安全信息凝聚定律
摘要：缩放定律表明，一旦数据充足，大型语言模型（LLM）的泛化误差会随着模型尺寸的增加而单调下降，并且“模型越大性能越好”的推论已被广泛接受。我们认为这一推论在安全领域是失效的：安全决策依赖于异常输入，这些输入是长尾的（例如，零日攻击），因此通过似然拟合效果不佳。更糟糕的是，规模带来的能力（例如，从损坏的部分推断出完整的意图）导致LLM在任何下游安全头部看到异常之前就默默地“修复”了异常。我们将此形式化为两个量之间的权衡：模型对世界分布的认知能力$K(W)=I(W;P)$，以及在其中间表示中幸存的安全信息保留$R(W)=\frac{I(Z;S)}{I(A;S)}$。我们推导了三个信息论界限来连接它们：关于$K(W)$的恢复准确性上限，关于恢复误差的$R(W)$上限，以及关于$R(W)$的安全任务误差的Fano下限。这些定理近似地暗示，可用安全信息是安全信息存活量和提取能力乘积，表明在特定模型尺寸下可以实现最优的可用安全信息。我们将其表述为“安全信息凝聚定律”：可用安全信息在模型尺寸上呈单峰分布，因此安全泛化误差呈U形，并在有限的$N^{\star}$处最小化，而不是无限制地下降。对各种真实世界LLM的实验验证了这一凝聚定律，表明存在一个最优模型尺寸来解决安全问题。
AI.summary: 本文挑战了大型语言模型（LLM）在安全领域“越大越好”的普遍认知，指出安全任务依赖于异常、长尾输入，而大规模LLM可能在下游安全模块处理前“修复”这些异常。作者通过形式化模型的认知能力与安全信息保留之间的权衡，并推导出信息论界限，提出了“安全信息凝聚定律”。该定律表明，可用安全信息在模型尺寸上呈单峰分布，导致安全泛化误差呈U形，并在一个有限的最优模型尺寸$N^{\star}$处达到最小值。实验结果验证了这一发现，强调了在安全应用中存在最佳LLM模型尺寸的重要性。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 安全信息, 缩放定律, 信息论, 最优模型尺寸
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个反直觉但重要的观点，即在安全领域，LLM并非越大越好。其创新点在于通过信息论的视角，形式化了模型认知能力与安全信息保留之间的权衡，并提出了“安全信息凝聚定律”。这对于指导LLM在安全领域的应用和模型选择具有重要意义，避免盲目追求模型规模。

title: Vessel2Brain: Edge-Aware Multi-Scale Flow Matching for 3D Brain Image Generation from Vessel Masks
summary: Generating realistic 3D brain MRI volumes from sparse anatomical priors is a highly ill-posed yet clinically valuable problem, with important applications in data augmentation, simulation, and downstream neuroimaging analysis. In this work, we investigate the challenging task of synthesising full 3D brain MRI volumes conditioned solely on vascular label maps. While vascular structures provide strong anatomical and topological cues, they occupy only a small fraction of the brain volume and offer no direct information about surrounding tissue appearance. To address this challenge, we propose Vessel2Brain, an edge-aware multi-scale conditional flow matching framework that explicitly incorporates vascular structure information into the generative process. Our approach formulates vessel-guided brain image synthesis as a conditional continuous flow, enabling stable training and flexible generation while preserving structural correspondence. A multi-scale flow matching strategy is introduced to jointly model global anatomical coherence and fine-grained local details, with auxiliary velocity predictions providing additional supervision across spatial resolutions. Furthermore, we design an edge-aware objective that emphasises vascular boundaries during training, encouraging anatomically faithful tissue synthesis around vessel structures. We evaluate Vessel2Brain on two public 3D brain MRI datasets with paired vascular annotations. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative models in terms of reconstruction accuracy, structural consistency, and distributional realism.

AI.title_translation: Vessel2Brain：基于血管掩码的3D脑图像生成的边缘感知多尺度流匹配
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Vessel2Brain，一种能够仅根据稀疏血管掩码高质量生成3D脑部MRI的边缘感知多尺度流匹配方法。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏的血管掩码生成现实的3D脑部MRI体积是一个高度不适定但临床价值很高的问题，因为血管结构仅占脑体积的一小部分且不包含周围组织的直接外观信息，现有方法难以准确捕捉这种复杂的对应关系。
AI.method: 提出Vessel2Brain框架，采用边缘感知、多尺度条件流匹配方法，将血管结构信息显式融入生成过程，利用辅助速度预测和边缘感知目标函数确保全局解剖连贯性和局部细节准确性。
AI.result: 在两个包含配对血管注释的公开3D脑MRI数据集上的实验表明，该方法在重建准确性、结构一致性和分布真实性方面均持续优于最先进的生成模型。
AI.conclusion: Vessel2Brain方法通过结合条件连续流匹配、多尺度建模和边缘感知目标函数，能够从稀疏的血管掩码中高质量地合成真实且结构一致的3D脑部MRI图像，优于现有最先进的生成模型。
AI.translation: 从稀疏解剖先验生成逼真的3D脑部MRI体积是一个高度不适定但临床价值巨大的问题，在数据 augmentation、模拟和下游神经影像分析中具有重要应用。在这项工作中，我们研究了仅以血管标签图为条件的完整3D脑部MRI体积合成这一具有挑战性的任务。虽然血管结构提供了强烈的解剖学和拓扑学线索，但它们仅占脑体积的一小部分，并未直接提供关于周围组织外观的信息。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Vessel2Brain，这是一个边缘感知多尺度条件流匹配框架，它明确将血管结构信息纳入生成过程。我们的方法将血管引导的脑图像合成公式化为条件连续流，实现稳定的训练和灵活的生成，同时保持结构对应关系。引入了多尺度流匹配策略，以联合建模全球解剖相干性和细粒度局部细节，辅助速度预测跨空间分辨率提供额外的监督。此外，我们设计了一个边缘感知目标函数，在训练期间强调血管边界，鼓励围绕血管结构进行解剖学上真实的组织合成。我们在两个带有配对血管注释的公开3D脑MRI数据集上评估了Vessel2Brain。广泛的定量和定性实验表明，我们的方法在重建精度、结构一致性和分布真实性方面 consistently 优于最先进的生成模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Vessel2Brain，一种用于从血管掩码生成3D脑部图像的边缘感知多尺度流匹配框架。该方法通过条件连续流、多尺度建模和边缘感知目标函数，有效解决了从稀疏血管先验生成全脑MRI的难题，并在重建和真实感上取得了优于SOTA的性能。
AI.keywords: 3D脑图像生成, 流匹配, 血管掩码, 多尺度建模, 边缘感知学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于血管掩码生成3D脑部MRI的边缘感知多尺度流匹配框架，有效解决血管结构稀疏与周围组织复杂性之间的信息不对称问题，在医学图像生成和增强方面具有重要应用价值。

title: RecMem: Recurrent Memory Compression for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation benefits from long interaction histories, but the cost of processing them directly grows with history length. We propose RecMem, a recurrent memory compression framework guided by three desiderata: space invariance, semantic fidelity, and lifelong evolvability. RecMem compresses historical segments into a fixed set of memory slots using a bifurcated encoder-decoder with shared lower layers and slot-wise forget-gated updates. Recommendation supervision trains the memory to preserve predictive information, while stream-consistency training aligns predictions from sequential and packed processing. By construction, the memory state and decoder context are independent of history length; under contraction and approximate semigroup consistency, we further derive a horizon-independent bound on the state discrepancy between these two processing orders. On MerRec, RecMem uses 16 memory slots and a 216-token decoder context, compared with 1,200 tokens for HSTU-1200, while retaining 87.9% of HSTU-1200's Recall@10 and 97.0% of its Recall@200. It outperforms PHSTU and the evaluated recent-only and retrieval baselines, and analyses of distant history show that archived interactions contribute predictive signal.

AI.title_translation: 循环记忆：长序列推荐的循环记忆压缩
AI.tldr: RecMem是一种循环记忆压缩框架，通过固定数量的记忆槽和分层编码器-解码器来处理长序列推荐，有效减少了计算成本，同时保持了推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 直接处理长交互历史在生成推荐中成本高昂，需要一种有效的方法来压缩历史信息。
AI.method: RecMem采用分层编码器-解码器，利用共享底层和分槽遗忘门更新来压缩历史片段到固定数量的记忆槽。通过推荐监督和流一致性训练来优化记忆，使其保留预测信息并对齐不同处理顺序的预测。
AI.result: 在MerRec数据集上，RecMem使用16个记忆槽和216个token的解码器上下文，相比HSTU-1200的1200个token，召回率@10保持了87.9%，召回率@200保持了97.0%。优于其他基线方法，并且分析表明存档的交互对预测有贡献。
AI.conclusion: RecMem通过记忆压缩有效解决了长序列推荐的成本问题，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了计算需求。
AI.translation: 生成推荐受益于长交互历史，但直接处理它们的成本随着历史长度的增加而增加。我们提出了RecMem，一个由三个基本要求指导的循环记忆压缩框架：空间不变性、语义保真度和终身可演化性。RecMem使用一个分层的编码器-解码器来压缩历史片段到一个固定的记忆槽集合，该编码器-解码器具有共享的底层和分槽遗忘门更新。推荐监督训练记忆以保留预测信息，而流一致性训练则使顺序处理和打包处理的预测保持一致。根据构造，记忆状态和解码器上下文与历史长度无关；在收缩和近似半群一致性下，我们进一步推导了这两种处理顺序之间状态差异的有界性，该界限与历史长度无关。在MerRec上，RecMem使用16个记忆槽和216个token的解码器上下文，而HSTU-1200使用1200个token，同时保留了HSTU-1200的召回率@10的87.9%和召回率@200的97.0%。它优于PHSTU以及经过评估的仅最近和检索基线，并且对远程历史的分析表明，存档的交互贡献了预测信号。
AI.summary: RecMem是一种新颖的循环记忆压缩框架，旨在解决生成推荐中处理长交互历史的计算成本问题。它通过一种分层的编码器-解码器架构，将历史信息压缩到固定数量的记忆槽中，并利用推荐监督和流一致性训练来确保记忆的预测能力和处理一致性。实验结果表明，RecMem在显著降低内存占用的同时，能够保持与现有先进方法相当的推荐性能。
AI.keywords: 生成推荐, 循环记忆压缩, 长序列处理, 记忆效率, 推荐系统
AI.comments: 该方法在处理长序列推荐方面具有创新性，通过记忆压缩技术有效平衡了性能和效率。空间不变性、语义保真度和终身可演化性的设计原则为后续研究提供了理论指导。然而，对于“终身可演化性”的具体实现机制和长期效果仍需进一步的实验验证。

title: TIDE: Reclaiming Lost Performance In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: Synchronous, colocated RL post-training of large language models (LLMs) today suffers from severe under-utilization due to long-tail rollouts. Inference engines fall idle waiting for long-tail rollouts or decode at low, inefficient batch sizes. To address this, we present TIDE, an RL training system that preserves on-policy training semantics while recovering resource utilization. TIDE does so by two complementary techniques: (1) dynamically repurposing rollout GPUs for training while long-tail rollouts complete and (2) dynamically migrating rollouts between inference engines to boost decoding throughput. TIDE automatically determines the right time to repurpose rollout resources through an adaptive migration policy, obtaining performance improvements that generalize across multiple applications and hardware configurations without requiring bespoke configuration. In our evaluation, TIDE provides end-to-end speedups of up to 1.36x over colocated systems, outperforming all evaluated on-policy baselines and achieving up to 97% of optimal throughput.

title: What Balanced Accuracy Cannot Identify in Neural-Signal Decoding under Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Adaptation for neural-signal classification is usually transductive: each batch is scored after updating on it, and the gain depends on the adapted model [4]. This paper asks what an aggregate change fails to characterise inside the cohort. Full test-time adaptation (full_ttt) was evaluated in 11 dataset-encoder cells (four each on Siena/EEG and PTB-XL/ECG, three on Sleep-EDF/EEG), with splits and source-model evaluation fixed; the subject was the unit, exact sign tests were Holm-corrected and conditional on the shared stream, and bootstrap intervals accompanied a dependence audit. Two results of different kinds follow. In the binary case balanced accuracy gives a one-class decoder the same value as one reporting both classes at 50%, so the aggregate cannot identify a class that stopped being reported; a class covering a tenth of a subject's samples went unpredicted in 26-47 of 112 subject-cells, against 7-9 for the controls, which is a descriptive count. With cohort, split and update rule fixed, the within-subject class contrast follows the encoder, tested directly rather than inferred from tests against zero: two of six Siena encoder pairs survive the dependence readings at their nominal reference and one at a fold-level reference, while two of ten Sleep-EDF stage pairs pass the run-clustered gate at its nominal reference; aggregate and contrast named different encoders in 10 of 11. The protocol bounds both results, since a stream-interleaving effect reverses sign with state sharing (+3.5 to -2.4 pp). An aggregate score can hide individual harm, as [1] showed, but it cannot distinguish a uniform loss from a deleted class; class-level change should therefore be reported alongside the aggregate and subject-level change alongside it, with both results conditional on the cell, the rule and the stream construction.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Scientific Paper Search: Retrieval Success and Inference Latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100
summary: Scientific literature search can benefit from locally deployed LLM assistants, which reduce reliance on hosted model providers while giving research teams greater control over their data and infrastructure. This work investigates whether open-weight models can support web-assisted paper retrieval under practical computing constraints. We first characterize inference latency as the input context grows from 512 to 128k tokens on a Mac Studio and a server equipped with two NVIDIA A100 GPUs. We then evaluate eight models on the retrieval of 70 papers from seven scientific repositories, using queries that represent three levels of domain knowledge. The results show that retrieval success depends strongly on the selected model and the specificity of the query. And that A100 GPUs are generally faster than the Mac Studio, but its unified memory allows larger models that could not be loaded in the tested GPU configuration.

title: Token2Tile: Token-Wise Sparse Attention with Tile Execution through a Low-Rank Space for Video DiTs
summary: Attention is essential for modeling spatio-temporal dependencies in video diffusion transformers, but its quadratic cost makes it a major inference bottleneck. Its high sparsity offers an opportunity to accelerate generation by focusing computation on important interactions. However, accuracy and execution favor different granularities: each query attends to its own key tokens, whereas GPU kernels work on tiles. We present Token2Tile, a training-free sparse attention operator that combines per-query scoring and a per-query residual with tile execution. An online low-rank space, computed directly from queries and keys to preserve attention logits, makes clustering, scoring, and residual approximation efficient. Token2Tile unites query-specific selections to allocate exact work across query clusters, then packs the selected keys into GPU tiles. On MiniMax-H3 and Wan2.1-14B, Token2Tile delivers 1.48-1.54x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention-3 with VBench scores within 0.5 points of dense. At comparable speeds on H3, it improves PSNR over SOL and SubBlock by 5.5-6.8 dB; on Wan, it exceeds SOL by 4.6-4.8 dB while running faster.

title: MineralExp: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Experimental Design in Real-World Mineral Exploration
summary: In mineral exploration, verifying geological hypotheses relies on designing a variety of geochemical experiments. While large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate downstream geoscientific data analysis, a crucial upstream capability remains largely unexplored: automated geochemical experimental design, i.e., deciding which experiments to conduct before committing to costly laboratory work. Evaluating this capability of LLM agents is difficult for two reasons. First, geochemical experiments exhibit high methodological diversity and subjectivity: to test the same hypothesis, different geologists may choose different minerals and instruments, so no single protocol can serve as the reference answer. Second, open-ended experimental plans resist representation as structured labels, which makes objective scoring difficult. To address these challenges, we introduce MineralExp, a benchmark that reformulates geochemical experimental design as a hypothesis-based experiment selection problem, i.e., a multi-label classification problem. We abstract concrete instrument names and procedural details into a shared taxonomy of 19 experimental types across five mineral-system processes: Source, Transport, Deposition, Modification, and Preservation. This taxonomy yields deterministic multi-label targets while accommodating diverse experimental protocols. Constructed from published ore-deposit literature and verified by domain experts, MineralExp comprises 277 cases and 1,572 reference experimental plans. Given a geological hypothesis and initial context, an LLM agent selects the relevant tasks and generates concrete experimental plans, which are scored by multi-label classification metrics and an LLM-as-a-Judge metric. The experimental results show that current agents generally achieve high recall but low precision, tending to propose more experiments than are necessary to test the hypothesis.

title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
summary: In many long-horizon settings, an agent's own choices create future constraints: committing finite capacity establishes future obligations and forecloses later opportunities. Sustaining performance therefore requires both keeping evolving plans feasible and comparing the value of resource allocations with the alternatives they displace. Recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate LLM agents in continuing operations, but give less attention to how agents keep their own commitments feasible while reassessing resource allocations as opportunities change. We introduce OutfitterBench, where agents manage an outdoor-equipment rental business for 200 days, purchasing from a 46-product catalog and handling roughly 1,100 reservation requests. Under a fixed capital ceiling, reservations and uncertain walk-in demand compete for reusable equipment whose availability changes over time. Experiments with seven frontier LLMs show that several agents underperform a simple rule-based baseline, while only the leading agent consistently surpasses it. Trajectory analysis shows that some agents apply known constraints inconsistently and make new decisions that conflict with existing commitments. Agents with more reliable fulfillment can still secure low returns from comparable commitments or delay resource reallocation. The leading agent better connects preparation with economic choices but also misses opportunities for more profitable asset use. These findings highlight limitations in sustaining coherent resource plans and reassessing their value over time. The benchmark code is publicly available at https://github.com/adminblackjack/OutfitterBench.

title: Tracing Actual Causes with Counterfactual Witness Maps
summary: Halpernian actual causation, the formal study of which events in a specific situation caused a specific outcome in acyclic structural causal models, underpins legal responsibility, moral blame, and the assessment of causal harm. Despite the rich logical framework, no prior sound and complete enumeration procedure is known for finding all actual causes in a given setting, blocking downstream tasks such as responsibility attribution, blame assessment, and causal-harm grading that aggregate over the full cause set. We close this gap by introducing witness targets: sets of joint configurations containing every counterfactual witness. In combination with an ancestor intervention grammar we derive a finite directed acyclic witness map. We prove that for every actual cause there exists a contingency set such that the joint intervention set appears as a node of this map, and present an algorithm for Tracing Actual Causes (TrAC) that is sound and complete for enumerating all actual causes of any target event. We compare TrAC empirically with existing single-cause baselines on random Boolean structural causal models, demonstrating practical feasibility for graphs of up to 15 nodes.

title: Measured from the feed: the unsustainable growth of AI video generation
comments: Main paper + Supplementary paper Under submission at a journal
summary: Text-to-video generation runs at commercial scale, but its broader environmental impacts remain, to our knowledge, understudied. Providers rarely disclose video volumes or energy needs; we measured the yearly video output of two commercial platforms and built a prospective model of such services' absolute footprint from training to storage. Our projections suggest that reducing emissions depends on both limiting growth in video generation and achieving substantial efficiency gains. Under continued growth, emissions rise nearly seventy-five-fold by 2030 despite technological improvements. When usage remains at 2026 levels, the same improvements reduce emissions by about two-fifths. These estimates are a conservative lower bound: they cover one AI service among many; other services and uses would push the total higher.

title: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
comments: 9 pages. Accepted as an oral presentation at the AI4F workshop, ICAIF 2026, Milan
summary: Can you trust a finance agent you did not build? We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer. Is the score stable? Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%. When the agent fails, who owns the fix? We classify 20 failed trajectories, from three runs of nine held-out questions, by the layer whose owner would remedy them, under a taxonomy frozen in advance: 13 belong to the agent's instructions, 3 to its tools, 4 to the model, none to its data. Can that diagnosis be trusted? Four blind readers from three model families, given only the traces, name the same fault as our LLM analyzer in 94% of cases, the rate at which they agree with one another (93%). Can a change be trusted? An optimization loop reads the traces, makes one targeted change per round and keeps it only if it clears a fixed threshold. Under a cost objective its final configuration costs 0.34x the baseline on the held-out questions (95% CI [0.22, 0.58]) at accuracy within noise. Under an accuracy objective it gains 14 points on the development questions and 1.5 on the held-out ones (CI [-5.3, +7.2]). Judged against the measured run-to-run noise, under a rule written before the test was opened, the first is a real saving and the second is not. This is a case study of one agent and nine test questions, not a general result.

title: Differentially Private Federated Class-Incremental Learning for EEG Mental State Classification
summary: Federated learning (FL) under differential privacy (DP) is typically evaluated on large client cohorts, where subsampling and cross-client averaging amplify privacy and smooth injected noise. Personal biosignal applications such as wearable EEG instead involve small federations of a handful of subjects, a regime whose interaction with formal client-level DP is largely uncharacterized. We study differentially private federated class-incremental learning in this small-cohort regime, combining a public EEG dataset with a custom four-channel MUSE 2 recording set into a K=5-client federation, and give a masked per-class training protocol that avoids degenerate gradients and missing negative supervision under class-incremental streaming. We propose FedEEG, combining Synaptic-Intelligence consolidation with a lagged adaptive FedProx term, and show it reduces catastrophic forgetting relative to FedAvg, FedProx, and a federated Learning-without-Forgetting baseline; on-device balanced-batch replay reduces mean forgetting by a further 56.7%. A class-scoping diagnosis yields $50.5\%\pm3.6\%$ accuracy with 6 seeds and 2.02 times chance. We also introduce head-scoped client-level DP, which protects the classification head and alone reduces the achievable $\varepsilon$ by 200 times at a matched round budget; combined with fewer communication rounds it reaches $\varepsilon\!\approx\!10.4$ with utility not statistically distinguishable from non-private training.

title: A narrow band method for non-causal discretizations of anisotropic eikonal equations, with adaptive width, sub-and super-solution construction, and quasi-linear complexity
summary: We describe a narrow band method for numerically solving anisotropic eikonal equations, and more generally static first order Hamilton-Jacobi equations with possibly non-convex Hamiltonians, discretized using standard schemes (semi-Lagrangian, upwind-differences, Lax-Friedrichs). The causality property is not needed, in contrast with the fast marching method. The proposed approach simultaneously builds a numerical sub-solution u and super-solution u to the problem, and adapts the width of the narrow band based on their comparison. We prove that (1 + $ε$)u $\ge$ u at termination, where $ε$ > 0 is any given tolerance parameter, and that the worst case complexity is O(N | ln $ε$| ln(N/$ε$)), where N denotes the number of discretization points, and the underlying constant is explicit in terms of those associated with the scheme properties. Numerical experiments illustrate our results.

AI.title_translation: 各向异性程函方程非因果离散化的窄带方法：具有自适应宽度、次解与超解构造及拟线性复杂度
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需因果性假设的自适应窄带算法，用于求解各向异性程函方程的标准离散化问题，具备拟线性复杂度并能同时构建次解与超解。
AI.motivation: 传统的快速步进法高度依赖因果性（causality），难以直接应用于采用非因果离散化或具有非凸哈密顿量的各向异性程函方程及静态一阶Hamilton-Jacobi方程。
AI.method: 提出一种不需要因果性假设的窄带方法，适用于半拉格朗日、迎风差分和Lax-Friedrichs等标准离散格式；同时构造数值次解与超解，并依据两者的对比自适应调整窄带的宽度。
AI.result: 理论证明了算法终止时数值次解与超解满足 (1 + ε)u_sub ≥ u_super（ε > 0为容差参数），最坏情况计算复杂度为 O(N |ln ε| ln(N/ε))（N为离散点数），且相关常数可由离散格式性质显式给出；数值实验验证了所得理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功为各向异性程函方程及静态一阶Hamilton-Jacobi方程的非因果离散化提供了一种高效、可靠且具拟线性复杂度的自适应窄带求解框架。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了一种用于数值求解各向异性程函方程、以及更一般的具有可能非凸哈密顿量的静态一阶Hamilton-Jacobi方程的窄带方法，这些方程采用标准格式（半拉格朗日格式、迎风差分格式、Lax-Friedrichs格式）进行离散化。与快速步进法不同，该方法不需要因果性性质。所提出的方法在求解问题时能够同时构建数值次解与超解，并根据它们的对比来自适应调整窄带的宽度。我们证明了在终止时满足 (1 + ε)u_sub ≥ u_super（其中 ε > 0 为任意给定的容差参数），且最坏情况下的复杂度为 O(N |ln ε| ln(N/ε))，其中 N 表示离散点数，隐藏常数可通过离散格式特性的相关常数显式表示。数值实验验证了我们的结论。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种求解各向异性程函方程及静态一阶Hamilton-Jacobi方程的自适应窄带数值方法。该方法适用于多种标准离散格式且不依赖因果性性质，通过联合构造数值次解与超解来自适应调节窄带宽度，并保证在达到指定容差下具备 O(N |ln ε| ln(N/ε)) 的拟线性最坏情况复杂度。
AI.keywords: 各向异性程函方程, Hamilton-Jacobi方程, 窄带法, 非因果离散化, 拟线性复杂度
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于突破了传统快速步进法（Fast Marching）对因果性性质的依赖，使得算法能够适用于更广泛的标准离散化格式与可能非凸的哈密顿量。同时，通过构造次解与超解实现窄带宽度的自适应控制，并在理论上严格证明了具有准线性（quasi-linear）复杂度界。局限性在于摘要未详述算法常数在极端各向异性条件下的具体表现及高维扩展性能。

title: Toward Interference-Agnostic RF Source Separation
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 tabs. Submitted to ICASSP2027
summary: Separating a radio-frequency signal of interest from a co-channel interference is mostly addressed with specialized separators, each trained for one pair of signal and interference types and therefore relying on a label that a heavily jammed receiver cannot identify. We show that this reliance is not benign: applied to an interference it was not trained on, such a separator usually fails to recover the signal, and in most of the cases we measure it leaves the signal worse than no processing at all. We then train a single separator over every pair, giving it no indication at test time of which one it faces, on two architectures with no component in common: the convolutional WaveNet of the ICASSP 2024 RF Challenge, and a band-split transformer that we adapt from music source separation. Both behave the same way. At the size of one specialized model, the unified separator stays close to the whole models it replaces, keeping the bit error rate close on almost every pair, better on one and worse on another. On an interference absent from every training set, it does as well as the best specialized model, without anyone having to choose which one to deploy.

AI.title_translation: 走向干扰无关的射频源分离
AI.tldr: 现有的射频信号分离器在面对未知干扰时表现不佳。本文提出了一种统一的、干扰无关的分离器，它在各种干扰类型上表现良好，甚至对训练中未见的干扰也有效，且性能与最佳的专用分离器相当。
AI.motivation: 现有的射频信号分离技术依赖于为特定信号和干扰类型训练的专用分离器，但在面对未训练的干扰时会失效，甚至恶化信号，这凸显了对更鲁棒分离器的需求。
AI.method: 本文训练了一个单一的、统一的分离器来处理所有信号和干扰类型，并在测试时无需预先指示干扰类型。研究使用了两种不同的架构进行验证：ICASSP 2024 RF挑战赛的卷积WaveNet和一种从音乐源分离改编而来的频带分割Transformer。
AI.result: 统一分离器在尺寸与单个专用模型相当的情况下，其误码率在几乎所有信号-干扰对上都与专用模型接近，其中一对表现更好，另一对表现稍差。更重要的是，在面对训练集中未出现的干扰时，其性能与最好的专用模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 一个单一的、干扰无关的射频源分离器可以有效替代多个专用模型，即使在面对未知干扰时也能提供鲁棒的性能，而无需预先识别干扰类型。
AI.translation: 从同信道干扰中分离出感兴趣的射频信号主要通过专用分离器来解决，每个分离器都针对一对信号和干扰类型进行训练，因此依赖于重度干扰接收器无法识别的标签。我们发现这种依赖并非良性：当应用于未经训练的干扰时，这种分离器通常无法恢复信号，并且在我们测量的多数情况下，它使信号比不进行任何处理更差。然后，我们对每个信号-干扰对训练一个单一的分离器，在测试时不对其提供任何关于它面临哪种干扰的指示，使用了两种没有共同组件的架构：ICASSP 2024 RF挑战赛的卷积WaveNet，以及我们从音乐源分离中改编的频带分割Transformer。两者表现相同。在单个专用模型的尺寸下，统一分离器与其所替代的整个模型保持接近，在几乎每个信号-干扰对上都保持接近的误码率，其中一对更好，另一对更差。在每个训练集中都不存在的干扰上，它的表现与最好的专用模型一样好，而无需任何人选择部署哪一个。
AI.summary: 现有的射频信号分离技术依赖于为特定信号和干扰类型训练的专用分离器，但在面对未训练的干扰时会失效，甚至恶化信号。本文提出了一种创新的干扰无关射频源分离方法，通过训练一个统一的分离器来处理所有信号和干扰类型，并在测试时无需预先识别干扰。研究使用了卷积WaveNet和频带分割Transformer两种架构进行验证。结果表明，这种统一的分离器在尺寸与单个专用模型相当的情况下，其误码率与专用模型相近，并且在面对训练集中未出现的干扰时，其性能与最好的专用模型相当，无需人工选择部署哪个模型。
AI.keywords: 射频源分离, 干扰无关, 统一分离器, WaveNet, 频带分割Transformer
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种重要的范式转变，从依赖于特定干扰类型的专用分离器转向一个能够处理多种甚至未知干扰的统一模型。这种“干扰无关”的特性对于实际应用中，特别是当干扰类型难以预测或识别时，具有显著的优势。其创新点在于无需在测试时指示干扰类型，并展示了其在未知干扰上的鲁棒性，大大简化了部署和提高了实用性。

title: Parameterized Approximation for Minimizing Uncovered Elements and Unsatisfied Constraints
summary:
Min-UnCoverage asks for at most $k$ sets minimizing uncovered weight. Min-Unsat SAT and Min-Unsat CSP ask for an assignment with at most $k$ true variables minimizing the weight of unsatisfied clauses or constraints.
  For constraints of arity at most $d$, we give a deterministic $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation for weighted Min-Unsat CSP in $(dk/\varepsilon)^{O(k)}N^{O(1)}$ time, where $N$ is the input size. This also gives approximation schemes for bounded-arity SAT and coverage with bounded element frequency. We show that weighted coverage with set size at most $d$ can be solved exactly in $2^{O(kd)}N^{O(1)}$ time by adapting color-coding. For coverage on incidence graphs of bounded semi-ladder index, we give a deterministic parameterized approximation scheme .
  We show that, unless $\mathrm{FPT}=\mathrm{W}[1]$, SAT and CSP have no finite-factor FPT approximation parameterized by $k+d$ when variable frequency is at most $d$, or on $K_{3,3}$-free incidence graphs of semi-ladder index at most four. Known Hitting Set hardness gives the same lower bound for all three problems at VC dimension two.
  Under the same assumption, we show that no computable relaxation $g(k,d)\geq k$ allows an FPT algorithm to preserve a prescribed unsatisfied-weight target for SAT or CSP, already for arity three and, separately, bounded variable frequency. For coverage, known algorithms preserve the target using at most $k+1$ sets on incidence graphs of bounded semi-ladder index.

AI.title_translation: 参数化近似以最小化未覆盖元素和未满足约束
AI.tldr: 本文研究了最小化未覆盖元素和未满足约束的参数化近似问题，提供了多种近似算法和精确算法，并证明了在某些条件下这些问题不存在有限因子FPT近似。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在解决Min-UnCoverage、Min-Unsat SAT和Min-Unsat CSP等问题，这些问题涉及在给定限制（例如最多k个集合或真变量）下最小化未覆盖权重或未满足约束的权重。
AI.method: 对于最大度为d的约束，使用确定性(1+ε)-近似算法解决加权Min-Unsat CSP。通过适配颜色编码，精确解决集合大小最大为d的加权覆盖问题。为有界半梯形索引关联图上的覆盖问题提供确定性参数化近似方案。
AI.result: 在(dk/ε)^O(k)N^O(1)时间内，为最大度为d的约束的加权Min-Unsat CSP提供确定性(1+ε)-近似。为有界度SAT和有界元素频率覆盖问题提供近似方案。在2^O(kd)N^O(1)时间内，通过颜色编码精确解决集合大小最大为d的加权覆盖问题。除非FPT=W[1]，否则当变量频率最大为d或在K_{3,3}-free关联图上时，SAT和CSP不存在参数化为k+d的有限因子FPT近似。在相同假设下，对于度为三或有界变量频率的SAT或CSP，不存在可计算松弛g(k,d) >= k的FPT算法来保持预设的未满足权重目标。对于覆盖问题，已知算法在有界半梯形索引关联图上使用最多k+1个集合来保持目标。
AI.conclusion: 论文为最小化未覆盖元素和未满足约束问题提供了新的参数化近似算法和精确算法，并建立了重要的FPT近似硬度下界，表明在特定条件下，这些问题无法获得有效的FPT近似。
AI.translation:
Min-UnCoverage问题要求最多$k$个集合，以最小化未覆盖的权重。Min-Unsat SAT和Min-Unsat CSP问题要求一个最多有$k$个真变量的赋值，以最小化未满足子句或约束的权重。
对于最大度为$d$的约束，我们为加权Min-Unsat CSP提供了一个确定性的$(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，时间复杂度为$(dk/\varepsilon)^{O(k)}N^{O(1)}$，其中$N$是输入大小。这也为有界度SAT和有界元素频率覆盖问题提供了近似方案。我们展示了通过适配颜色编码，集合大小最大为$d$的加权覆盖问题可以在$2^{O(kd)}N^{O(1)}$时间内精确求解。对于有界半梯形索引关联图上的覆盖问题，我们提供了一个确定性参数化近似方案。
我们证明，除非$\mathrm{FPT}=\mathrm{W}[1]$，否则当变量频率最大为$d$，或在$K_{3,3}$-free关联图上，并且半梯形索引最大为四时，SAT和CSP不存在参数化为$k+d$的有限因子FPT近似。已知的Hitting Set硬度为VC维数为二的所有这三个问题提供了相同的下界。
在相同假设下，我们证明，对于度为三的SAT或CSP，以及单独的有界变量频率情况，不存在可计算松弛$g(k,d)\geq k$的FPT算法来保持预设的未满足权重目标。对于覆盖问题，已知算法在有界半梯形索引关联图上使用最多$k+1$个集合来保持目标。
AI.summary: 本文研究了最小化未覆盖元素和未满足约束的参数化近似问题，包括Min-UnCoverage、Min-Unsat SAT和Min-Unsat CSP。作者为加权Min-Unsat CSP、有界度SAT和有界元素频率覆盖问题提供了新的确定性参数化近似方案。此外，论文还通过颜色编码技术为有界集合大小的加权覆盖问题提供了精确算法。重要的理论贡献在于证明了在FPT=W[1]不成立的假设下，这些问题在特定参数化（如k+d）下不存在有限因子FPT近似，并进一步阐明了在保持未满足权重目标方面的算法限制。
AI.keywords: 参数化近似, 未满足约束, 未覆盖元素, FPT算法, 硬度下界
AI.comments: 这篇论文在参数化近似算法领域做出了重要贡献，不仅提出了新的近似和精确算法，还通过建立FPT硬度下界，深入探讨了这些问题的计算复杂性限制。其对Min-Unsat CSP、SAT和覆盖问题的统一处理以及对不同图结构的考虑，展现了研究的全面性。硬度结果对于理解这些问题的内在困难性具有重要指导意义。

title: Domain Adaptation Based Pipeline for Character Classification and Handwritten Text Recognition
summary: Character classification and handwritten text recognition, particularly in specialized tasks, often suffer from limited labeled data, while a large amount of unlabeled data remains unused. To address this challenge, we propose a novel unsupervised domain adaptation-based pipeline to reduce the distribution gap between source and target domains. Our pipeline follows three main steps. In the first step, we pretrained an expert model on source data, to learn a strong general representation. In the second step, we perform unsupervised domain adaptation to leverage unlabeled target data, adapting the model to the specific characteristics of the target domain. In the third step, we trained the expert model on source data in the target style. By aligning the feature distributions between the source and target, our method enables the model to generalize effectively across diverse datasets. The unsupervised training increases the computation time only during training not in inference. We evaluate the pipeline on both character-level and historical handwritten line recognition tasks, demonstrating its flexibility. We establish a new state-of-the-art on the Safran-MNIST-DLS dataset defined in Track 2 of the DAGECC competition with 76.17% Macro F1-score and achieve competitive results on each of the specific datasets of READ 2018 without using the labels of the target data. Code is available at https://github.com/simon-corbi/DRANet-for-classification-and-htr

AI.title_translation: 基于域适应的字符分类和手写文本识别流程
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于无监督域适应的流程，用于在标记数据有限的情况下，进行字符分类和手写文本识别，并取得了最先进的结果。
AI.motivation: 字符分类和手写文本识别，特别是在专业任务中，常面临标记数据有限而大量未标记数据未被利用的挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新颖的无监督域适应流程，旨在减少源域和目标域之间的分布差距。该流程分为三个主要步骤：首先，在源数据上预训练一个专家模型以学习强大的通用表示；其次，进行无监督域适应以利用未标记的目标数据，使模型适应目标域的特定特征；最后，在目标风格的源数据上训练专家模型。通过对齐源域和目标域之间的特征分布，使模型能够有效地泛化到不同数据集。
AI.result: 该流程在字符级和历史手写线识别任务上进行了评估，并展示了其灵活性。在DAGECC竞赛Track 2定义的Safran-MNIST-DLS数据集上，取得了76.17%的Macro F1分数，建立了新的最先进水平。在不使用目标数据标签的情况下，在READ 2018的各个特定数据集上也取得了有竞争力的结果。无监督训练仅在训练期间增加计算时间，推理时间不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于无监督域适应的流程能够有效解决标记数据有限的问题，通过对齐特征分布，使模型在字符分类和手写文本识别任务中实现跨数据集的有效泛化，并在多个基准测试中取得了优异表现。
AI.translation: 字符分类和手写文本识别，特别是在专业任务中，常常面临标记数据有限而大量未标记数据未被利用的问题。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的基于无监督域适应的流程，以减少源域和目标域之间的分布差距。我们的流程遵循三个主要步骤。在第一步中，我们在源数据上预训练了一个专家模型，以学习强大的通用表示。在第二步中，我们执行无监督域适应，以利用未标记的目标数据，使模型适应目标域的特定特征。在第三步中，我们在目标风格的源数据上训练了专家模型。通过对齐源域和目标域之间的特征分布，我们的方法使模型能够有效地泛化到不同的数据集。无监督训练只在训练期间增加计算时间，而不在推理期间增加。我们在字符级和历史手写线识别任务上评估了该流程，展示了其灵活性。我们在DAGECC竞赛Track 2定义的Safran-MNIST-DLS数据集上建立了新的最先进水平，Macro F1分数为76.17%，并在不使用目标数据标签的情况下，在READ 2018的各个特定数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果。代码可在https://github.com/simon-corbi/DRANet-for-classification-and-htr 获取。
AI.summary: 针对字符分类和手写文本识别中标记数据稀缺的问题，本文提出了一种新颖的基于无监督域适应的流程。该流程通过在源数据上预训练模型、利用无标记目标数据进行域适应，以及在目标风格的源数据上训练，有效缩小了源域和目标域的分布差距，使模型能有效泛化。实验证明，该方法在Safran-MNIST-DLS数据集上达到了新的SOTA，并在READ 2018数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果，展现了其在有限标记数据场景下的强大潜力和灵活性。
AI.keywords: 域适应, 字符分类, 手写文本识别, 无监督学习, 流程
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个三步走的无监督域适应流程，有效解决了专业手写文本识别任务中标记数据不足的挑战。通过利用大量未标记数据进行域适应，显著提升了模型在不同数据集上的泛化能力，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进或有竞争力的结果，证明了其重要性。一个潜在的限制是无监督训练会增加训练时间，尽管推理时间不受影响。

title: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
summary: We argue that the Transformer revolution is not adequately understood as a merely quantitative expansion of deep learning, but as the emergence of a new paradigm based on a different principle of inference. We interpret the Transformer as a system in which token representations are transformed by parameterized transformations, or transforming concepts. During inference, some of these transformations are dynamically constructed from the current input: previously acquired transformations are first adapted and then applied. At the mechanical-structural level, this dynamic processing is realized through output-weight interconnections, whereby outputs of some networks determine the weights of others. The resulting mode of processing, which we call Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing (SIDPP), provides a framework for explaining strong prompt sensitivity and opens research directions concerning interpretability, control, alternative AI architectures, neuromorphic systems, and possible biological realizations of dynamic processing.

AI.title_translation: Transformer范式：动态处理与一种新的推理原则
AI.tldr: Transformer不仅是深度学习的量化扩展，而是一种基于输入动态调整转换的全新推理范式（SIDPP），解释了其强大的提示敏感性并开启了新的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 作者认为Transformer革命不能简单地被视为深度学习的量化扩展，而是基于一种全新推理原则的新范式，需要一种理论框架来解释其动态处理机制及强提示敏感性。
AI.method: 从机械-结构层面解释Transformer的运作机制，指出其通过输出-权重互联（output-weight interconnections）实现动态处理，并将这种模式命名为序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP）。
AI.result: 提出了“序列级交互式动态并行处理”（SIDPP）框架，能够解释Transformer的强提示敏感性，并为可解释性、控制、替代AI架构及神经形态系统指明了新的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: Transformer代表了一种超越传统深度学习的、基于输入动态构建和应用转换的新推理范式，为理解和改进AI架构提供了统一的理论框架。
AI.translation: 我们认为，Transformer的革命不能仅仅理解为深度学习的量化扩展，而是基于一种不同推理原则的新范式的出现。我们将Transformer解释为一个系统，其中标记（token）表示通过参数化转换（或称转换概念）进行变换。在推理过程中，其中一些转换是根据当前输入动态构建的：首先调整先前获取的转换，然后再应用它们。在机械-结构层面上，这种动态处理是通过输出-权重互联实现的，即某些网络的输出决定了其他网络的权重。由此产生的处理模式被称为序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP），它为解释强提示敏感性提供了框架，并开启了关于可解释性、控制、替代AI架构、神经形态系统以及动态处理可能的生物学实现的研究方向。
AI.summary: 本文将Transformer视为一种基于输入动态构建和适应转换的新型推理范式，通过“输出-权重互联”在机械结构上实现动态处理，并提出了序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP）框架，为解释其强提示敏感性及未来AI研究方向提供了新视角。
AI.keywords: Transformer, 动态处理, 推理范式, 输出权重互联, SIDPP
AI.comments: 本文从全新的哲学与计算范式高度审视了Transformer架构，指出其核心在于输入驱动的动态权重生成，并提出了SIDPP概念，对理解当前大模型及未来神经形态计算具有重要启发意义。

title: In the Eye of the Beholder: Human Label Variation in Textual and Visual Entailment
summary: Human Label Variation (HLV) is increasingly recognised as an informative signal that reflects meaningful differences in how people interpret the same input. While HLV has been studied extensively in Natural Language Inference (NLI), much less is known about HLV in Visual Entailment (VE; Xie et al., 2019), where the textual premise is replaced by an image, keeping the hypothesis and label space fixed. We introduce VariNLI-VE, a dataset for studying how HLV changes between paired NLI and VE instances. We re-annotate a subset of originally neutral SNLI (Bowman et al., 2015) instances and their visual counterparts, with the same annotators evaluating both the textual and visual versions. Each annotation includes a label, confidence score, and explanation, yielding 2,250 annotations. Labels and explanations are collected jointly, providing ecologically valid explanations. Because the image may reveal information not stated in the text, one might expect disagreement to decrease in VE. Instead, we find no clear overall reduction: disagreement decreases for some instances while it increases for others. Explanations reveal further variation, as annotators can retain the same label while changing their rationale. When evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) on the paired data, we find lower accuracy, weaker alignment with human label distributions, and generally higher uncertainty in VE than in NLI.

AI.title_translation: 情人眼里出西施：文本与视觉蕴含中的人类标签变异
AI.tldr: 本研究通过构建新数据集 VariNLI-VE，探讨了人类在文本蕴含与视觉蕴含任务中理解分歧的异同，并发现当前视觉语言模型在视觉蕴含上面对人类分歧时的表现明显逊色。
AI.motivation: 尽管人类标签变异（HLV）在自然语言推理（NLI）中得到了广泛研究，但在视觉蕴含（VE）领域仍缺乏了解。本研究旨在探究当文本前提被图像替换时，人类的标签变异如何变化。
AI.method: 引入了 VariNLI-VE 数据集，重新标注了 SNLI 文本实例及其视觉对应实例的子集，由同一批标注者对文本和视觉版本进行评估，收集标签、置信度和解释，并评估了多个视觉语言模型（VLM）在成对数据上的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现，总体 disagreement（分歧）并没有明显减少，某些实例的分歧减少而另一些增加；解释表明标注者可能会在保持标签不变的同时改变理由；视觉语言模型在 VE 上的准确率更低、与人类标签分布的一致性更弱、不确定性更高。
AI.conclusion: 人类在视觉蕴含中的标签分歧并不比文本蕴含少，且当前的视觉语言模型在处理视觉蕴含任务时表现出较低的准确率、较弱的人类偏好对齐度以及更高的不确定性。
AI.translation: 人类标签变异（HLV）日益被认为是一种信息信号，反映了人们对同一输入解释的实质性差异。虽然HLV在自然语言推理（NLI）中得到了广泛研究，但对于视觉蕴含（VE；Xie等，2019）中的HLV知之甚少，VE中将文本前提替换为图像，而假设和标签空间保持不变。我们介绍了VariNLI-VE，这是一个用于研究配对NLI和VE实例之间HLV如何变化的迷数据集。我们重新标注了原本为中性的SNLI（Bowman等，2015）实例及其视觉对应部分的子集，由相同的标注者评估文本和视觉版本。每个标注包括标签、置信度分数和解释，共产生2250个标注。标签和解释是联合收集的，从而提供了生态有效的解释。由于图像可能会透露文本中未说明的信息，人们可能会期望VE中的分歧会减少。然而，我们发现整体分歧并没有明确减少：某些实例的分歧减少，而其他实例的分歧增加。解释揭示了进一步的变异，因为标注者在改变理由的同时可以保留相同的标签。在配对数据上评估视觉语言模型（VLM）时，我们发现与NLI相比，VE中的准确率较低、与人类标签分布的一致性较弱，且总体不确定性更高。
AI.summary: 该论文通过构建 VariNLI-VE 数据集，研究了人类在文本蕴含和视觉蕴含中的标签变异（HLV）差异。研究发现，将文本替换为图像并未统一减少人类的分歧，且现有的视觉语言模型在视觉蕴含任务上面临更大的挑战和更高的不确定性。
AI.keywords: 人类标签变异, 视觉蕴含, 自然语言推理, 视觉语言模型, 多模态理解
AI.comments: 该论文首次将人类标签变异（HLV）的研究从文本蕴含（NLI）拓展到视觉蕴含（VE），通过成对的数据集 VariNLI-VE 揭示了文本与视觉模态下人类理解和分歧的异同，并对当前视觉语言模型（VLM）的对齐能力提出了新的挑战和基准。

title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
summary: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 at 62.3%, followed by OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro at 60.7%. The strongest GenericAgent configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro omni and Gemma4 31B, both achieve 30.3%. Among reproducible, human-curated web agent benchmarks, WebArena-Pro provides the broadest application coverage and the most comprehensive multimodal support to date. The benchmark treats audio and video as core observations alongside text and vision, with dedicated actions for extracting information from each. WebArena-Pro runs each task in isolation and supports reproducible, parallel evaluation. Tasks are authored through a dedicated annotator interface, filtered by LLM-assisted triage, and finally validated by humans before release. Project page: https://webarena-pro.github.io

AI.title_translation: WebArena-Pro：一个面向网页智能体的异构、多模态、可复现基准测试
AI.tldr: WebArena-Pro是一个全新的异构多模态网页智能体可复现基准测试，首次全面评估了智能体对网页中音视频等复杂多模态内容的处理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的可复现Web智能体基准测试应用覆盖面窄且模态受限（仅限文本和视觉），而实时基准虽然覆盖广但缺乏可复现性，且现有基准均未评估智能体处理网页中内嵌音视频内容的能力。
AI.method: 构建包含20个自托管Web应用、300个任务的基准测试，支持文本、视觉、音频和视频的多模态观察及专用交互动作，并通过独立隔离的环境运行、并行评估及LLM辅助加人工验证来确保可复现性。
AI.result: 在评估的智能体中，Codex（带GPT 6.1 Sol）和Claude Code（带Claude Opus 5.5）表现最好，准确率达62.3%，其次是OpenCode（带Kimi 3.1 Pro）的60.7%，最强的GenericAgent配置准确率为30.3%。
AI.conclusion: WebArena-Pro作为目前覆盖最广、多模态支持最全面的可复现Web智能体基准，有效推动了具备音视频处理能力的复杂浏览器智能体的发展。
