title: Games with $ω$-Automatic Preference Relations
comments: Extended version of a MFCS 2025 paper
summary: This paper investigates Nash equilibria (NEs) in multi-player turn-based games on graphs, where player preferences are modeled as $ω$-automatic relations via deterministic parity automata. Unlike much of the existing literature, which focuses on specific reward functions, our results apply to any preference relation definable by an $ω$-automatic relation. We analyze the computational complexity of determining the existence of an NE (possibly under some constraints), verifying whether a given strategy profile forms an NE, and checking whether a specific outcome can be realized by an NE. When a (constrained) NE exists, we show that there always exists one with finite-memory strategies. Finally, we explore fundamental properties of $ω$-automatic relations and their implications for the existence of equilibria.
comment: Extended version of a MFCS 2025 paper

AI.title_translation: 具有$\\omega$-自动机偏好关系的博弈
AI.tldr: 本文研究了利用$\\omega$-自动机关系建模偏好的图博弈中的纳什均衡，分析了其计算复杂性并证明了有限记忆策略的存在性。
AI.motivation: 现有的图上多玩家博弈文献多集中于特定的奖励函数，缺乏对更广泛、更具表达力的偏好关系（如$\\omega$-自动机关系）下纳什均衡及相关计算复杂度的系统研究。
AI.method: 利用确定性奇偶自动机（deterministic parity automata）将玩家偏好建模为$\\omega$-自动机关系，并分析相关博弈问题的计算复杂度及策略属性。
AI.result: 分析了确定纳什均衡（及受限纳什均衡）存在性、验证给定策略配置是否为纳什均衡以及检查特定结果是否可由纳什均衡实现的计算复杂度；证明了当（受限）纳什均衡存在时，必定存在具有有限记忆策略的纳什均衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入$\\omega$-自动机关系建模偏好，本文建立了一套关于图上多玩家回合制博弈中纳什均衡判定、验证及策略复杂度的完备理论。
AI.translation: 本文研究了图上多玩家回合制博弈中的纳什均衡（NE），其中玩家偏好通过确定性奇偶自动机建模为$\\omega$-自动机关系。与以往大多关注特定奖励文献不同，我们的结果适用于任何由$\\omega$-自动机关系可定义的偏好关系。我们分析了确定NE（可能在某些约束下）存在性、验证给定策略配置是否为NE以及检查特定结果是否可由NE实现的计算复杂度。当（受限）NE存在时，我们证明了总存在一个具有有限记忆策略的NE。最后，我们探讨了$\\omega$-自动机关系的基本性质及其对均衡存在性的影响。
AI.summary: 本文研究了图上多玩家回合制博弈中的纳什均衡，其中玩家偏好由确定性奇偶自动机定义的$\\omega$-自动机制定。作者分析了纳什均衡存在性、验证和结果实现的计算复杂度，并证明了存在有限记忆策略的纳什均衡。
AI.keywords: 纳什均衡, $\\omega$-自动机, 图博弈, 计算复杂度, 有限记忆策略
AI.comments: 该论文将自动机理论与博弈论结合，利用$\\omega$-自动机来建模玩家偏好，极大地扩展了图博弈中纳什均衡研究的通用性。研究不仅涵盖了计算复杂度分析，还证明了有限记忆策略的存在性，具有很高的理论价值。

title: Identifying and Mitigating API Misuse in Large Language Models
comments: Accepted at IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering (TSE)
summary: API misuse in code generated by large language models (LLMs) presents a serious and growing challenge in software development, as although LLMs demonstrate impressive code generation capabilities, their interactions with complex library APIs are often error-prone and can lead to software failures and vulnerabilities. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale study of API misuse patterns in LLM-generated code by analyzing both method selection and parameter usage across Python and Java, using three representative LLMs: StarCoder-7B, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, and GitHub Copilot. Based on extensive manual annotation of 3,209 method-level and 3,492 parameter-level misuses, we identify and categorize four recurring misuse types by building on and refining prior API misuse taxonomies. Our evaluation of the three LLMs reveals persistent challenges in API usage, particularly hallucination and intent misalignment. To address these issues, we propose Dr.Fix, an LLM-based automatic repair approach guided by our taxonomy, which improves repair accuracy compared to baseline prompting and existing repair methods, achieving gains of up to 38.4 BLEU and up to 72 more exact matches on benchmark datasets. This work offers important insights into the current limitations of LLMs in API usage and points to directions for improving automated misuse repair in code generation systems.
comment: Accepted at IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering (TSE)

AI.title_translation: 识别与缓解大语言模型中的API误用
AI.tldr: 本文研究了大模型代码生成中的API误用问题，揭示了常见误用模式，并提出了名为Dr.Fix的自动修复方法，显著提升了修复准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然代码生成能力强大，但在与复杂的库API交互时容易出错，导致软件故障和漏洞，因此需要识别并缓解LLM生成代码中的API误用问题。
AI.method: 对三种代表性LLM（StarCoder-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B、GitHub Copilot）生成的Python和Java代码进行大规模研究，人工标注了3,209个方法级和3,492个参数级误用，构建并提炼了API误用分类学，并提出了基于该分类学的LLM自动修复方法Dr.Fix。
AI.result: 研究识别并分类了四种经常出现的误用类型，揭示了幻觉和意图不对齐等持续存在的挑战；提出的Dr.Fix方法在基准数据集上相比基线提示词和现有修复方法，取得了高达38.4 BLEU的提升和多达72个精确匹配的成果。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了大模型在API使用上的局限性（如幻觉和意图不对齐），并通过提出的Dr.Fix方法有效提高了API误用的修复准确率。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）生成的代码中存在的API误用给软件开发带来了严重且日益严峻的挑战，因为尽管LLM展示了令人印象深刻的代码生成能力，但它们与复杂库API的交互往往容易出错，并可能导致软件故障和漏洞。在本文中，我们使用三个代表性的LLM（StarCoder-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B和GitHub Copilot），通过分析Python和Java中的方法选择和参数用法，对LLM生成代码中的API误用模式进行了大规模研究。基于对3,209个方法级和3,492个参数级误用的广泛人工标注，我们在借鉴和完善先前API误用分类法的基础上，识别并归纳了四种经常出现的误用类型。我们对这三个LLM的评估揭示了它们在API使用方面持续存在的挑战，特别是幻觉和意图不对齐。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Dr.Fix，这是一种受我们的分类法指导的基于LLM的自动修复方法，与基线提示和现有修复方法相比，它提高了修复准确率，在基准数据集上实现了高达38.4 BLEU的提升和多达72个额外的精确匹配。这项工作为LLM在API使用方面的当前局限性提供了重要见解，并指明了改进代码生成系统中自动误用修复的方向。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型在代码生成中容易产生API误用的问题，通过对多种LLM生成的Python和Java代码进行大规模研究与人工标注，总结出四种主要的误用类型，并提出了基于该分类学的自动修复方法Dr.Fix，显著提升了误用修复的准确率。
AI.keywords: API Misuse, Large Language Models, Code Generation, Automated Repair, Taxonomy
AI.comments: 该论文针对大语言模型生成代码中的API误用问题进行了大规模研究，创新性地提出了基于分类学的自动修复方法Dr.Fix，对提升大模型代码生成安全性和可靠性具有重要意义。

title: Evaluating the Generalizability and Explainability of Firn Image Classification with Topological Features
comments: Extended version with additional experiments on generalizability and explainability
summary: In this paper we evaluate the performance of topological features for generalizable and explainable classification of firn image data, with the broader goal of understanding the advantages, pitfalls, and trade-offs in topological featurization. Firn refers to layers of granular snow within glaciers that haven't yet been compressed into ice. This compaction process imposes distinct topological and geometric structure on firn that varies with depth within the firn column. However, the limited and highly correlated training data available results in naive classifiers (such as convolutional neural networks) overfitting to orientation-dependent features. This motivates us to evaluate topological data analysis (TDA) as a way to design features which capture the shape of the firn data while retaining a large degree of invariance. We evaluate two classes of topological features, sublevel set features and distance transform features, together with persistence curves, to predict sample depth from firn images. A range of challenging training-test scenarios reveals that no one choice of method dominates in all categories. In particular, we see a tradeoff between accuracy on the one hand, and generalizability and explainability (via feature importance) on the other.
comment: Extended version with additional experiments on generalizability and explainability

AI.title_translation: 利用拓扑特征评估雪层图像分类的泛化性与可解释性
AI.tldr: 论文评估了利用拓扑数据分析（TDA）进行雪层图像分类的效果，发现拓扑特征能增强泛化与可解释性，但与准确性之间存在权衡。
AI.motivation: 由于有限且高度相关的训练数据，朴素分类器（如卷积神经网络）容易对方向相关特征过拟合，因此需要利用拓扑数据分析（TDA）来设计既能捕捉数据形状又具有高度不变性的特征。
AI.method: 评估了两类拓扑特征（子水平集特征和距离变换特征）以及持久性曲线，用于从雪层图像中预测样本深度，并测试了多种具有挑战性的训练-测试场景。
AI.result: 没有一种单一的方法在所有类别中都占绝对优势，实验揭示了准确性与泛化性、可解释性之间存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑特征在雪层图像分类中展现出了良好的泛化和可解释性潜力，但准确性与泛化性/可解释性之间存在明显的权衡。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们评估了拓扑特征在雪层图像数据通用且可解释分类中的性能，其更广泛的目标是理解拓扑特征化中的优势、缺陷和权衡。雪层（Firn）是指冰川内尚未被压缩成冰的颗粒状雪层。这种压实过程对雪层施加了独特的拓扑和几何结构，该结构随雪层深度的变化而变化。然而，可用训练数据有限且高度相关，导致朴素分类器（如卷积神经网络）对方向相关特征过拟合。这促使我们评估拓扑数据分析（TDA）作为一种设计特征的方法，这些特征既能捕捉雪层数据的形状，又能保持高度的不变性。我们评估了两类拓扑特征（子水平集特征和距离变换特征）以及持久性曲线，以根据雪层图像预测样本深度。一系列具有挑战性的训练-测试场景表明，没有一种单一的方法能在所有类别中占据主导地位。特别是，我们看到了准确性一方面，与泛化性和可解释性（通过特征重要性）另一方面之间的权衡。
AI.summary: 该论文评估了拓扑特征在雪层图像分类中的表现，旨在通过拓扑数据分析（TDA）克服传统分类器易过拟合的缺点，研究结果揭示了准确性与模型泛化性和可解释性之间的权衡。
AI.keywords: 拓扑数据分析, 积雪图像分类, 泛化能力, 可解释性, 持久同调
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了拓扑数据分析（TDA）在雪层（firn）图像分类中的应用，深入分析了其在泛化能力和可解释性方面的优势与局限，对于理解深度学习在特定科学图像上的过拟合问题具有重要价值。

title: Bidirectional Information Flow (BIF) - A Sample Efficient Hierarchical Gaussian Process for Bayesian Optimization
summary: Hierarchical Gaussian Process (H-GP) models divide problems into different subtasks, allowing for different components to address each part, making them well-suited for problems with inherent compositional structure. However, existing H-GP frameworks typically employ one-way information sharing - either top-down or bottom-up - which limits sample efficiency and slows convergence. We propose Bidirectional Information Flow (BIF), which establishes continuous two-way communication. BIF retains the modular structure of hierarchical models - the parent conditions its own posterior on child summaries, treating them as structured priors - while introducing top-down feedback to softly decompose environment observations from the parent into sub-responses. This mutual exchange improves sample efficiency, enables robust training, and allows modular reuse of learned subtask models. We prove analytically the regret of a GP with a learned kernel scales linearly with the mismatch to the true kernel, tightening in the hierarchical case to the sum of child-level errors. Ablation shows removing the downward pathway collapses child $R^2$ by up to 58%. Across synthetic, neurostimulation, and HPO benchmarks, BIF achieves up to $4\times$ higher parent $R^2$ and roughly 100% AUC improvement over vanilla GPBO, and outperforms or is the runner-up in 38/40 tests compared to the state-of-the-art baselines while supporting modular child transfer to novel composite tasks.

AI.title_translation: 双向信息流（BIF）——用于贝yez优化的高样本效率分层高斯过程
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于贝叶斯优化的双向信息流（BIF）分层高斯过程框架，通过实现上下级双向通信，大幅提升了样本效率和预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的分层高斯过程（H-GP）框架通常采用单向信息共享（自上而下或自下而上），这限制了样本效率并减缓了收敛速度。
AI.method: 提出双向信息流（BIF），保留父对子总结的条件化处理（结构化先验），同时引入自上而下的反馈机制，将父级的环境观测软分解为子响应，实现双向通信。
AI.result: 理论证明了具有学习核的GP遗憾界，消融实验显示移除向下路径会导致子任务 $R^2$ 下降高达 58%；在多项基准测试中，BIF 相比传统 GPBO 实现了高达 4 倍的父级 $R^2$ 和约 100% 的 AUC 提升，并在 38/40 的测试中超越或持平最先进的基线。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双向信息流（BIF）机制有效克服了传统分层高斯过程的单向信息限制，在多项基准测试中实现了极高的样本效率和预测准确性，并支持子任务模型的模块化迁移。
AI.translation: 分层高斯过程（H-GP）模型将问题划分为不同的子任务，允许不同的组件处理每个部分，这使其非常适合具有内在组合结构的问题。然而，现有的 H-GP 框架通常采用单向信息共享——自上而下或自下而上——这限制了样本效率并减缓了收敛速度。我们提出了双向信息流（BIF），它建立了持续的双向通信。BIF 保留了分层模型的模块化结构——父级以子级摘要为条件来构建自身的后验，将其视为结构化先验——同时引入了自上而下的反馈，将来自父级的环境观测软这种相互交换提高了样本效率，实现了鲁棒训练，并允许对已学习的子任务模型进行模块化重用。我们从分析上证明了具有学习核的 GP 的遗憾界随与真实核的不匹配线性缩放，在分层情况下收紧为子级误差的总和。消融实验表明，移除向下路径会导致子任务 $R^2$ 下降高达 58%。在综合、神经刺激和 HPO 基准测试中，BIF 比传统的 GPBO 实现了高达 4 倍的父级 $R^2$ 和约 100% 的 AUC 提升，并且在与最先进基线的 40 个测试中有 38 个超越或成为亚军，同时支持模块化子级迁移到新的组合任务中。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了双向信息流（BIF）框架，用于改进用于贝叶斯优化的分层高斯过程。BIF 通过建立双向信息通信（结合自下而上的结构化先验与自上而下的环境观测软分解），显著提高了样本效率、收敛速度和模块化迁移能力，在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 分层高斯过程, 贝叶斯优化, 双向信息流, 样本效率, 模块化迁移
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了双向信息流（BIF）机制，解决了传统分层高斯过程（H-GP）中单向信息传递的局限性。通过上下级双向通信和软分解，显著提升了贝叶斯优化的样本效率和模型泛化能力，在多个基准测试中表现优异，具有很高的实用价值和理论支撑。

title: AbFlowNet: Optimizing Antibody-Antigen Binding Energy via Diffusion-GFlowNet Fusion
summary: Complementarity Determining Regions (CDRs) are critical segments of an antibody that facilitate binding to specific antigens. Current computational methods for CDR design utilize reconstruction losses and do not jointly optimize binding energy, a crucial metric for antibody efficacy. Rather, binding energy optimization is done through computationally expensive Online Reinforcement Learning (RL) pipelines rely heavily on unreliable binding energy estimators. In this paper, we propose AbFlowNet, a novel generative framework that integrates GFlowNet with Diffusion models. By framing each diffusion step as a state in the GFlowNet framework, AbFlowNet jointly optimizes standard diffusion losses and binding energy by directly incorporating energy signals into the training process, thereby unifying diffusion and reward optimization in a single procedure. Experimental results show that AbFlowNet outperforms the base diffusion model by 3.06% in amino acid recovery, 20.40% in geometric reconstruction (RMSD), and 3.60% in binding energy improvement ratio. ABFlowNet also decreases Top-1 total energy and binding energy errors by 24.8% and 38.1% without pseudo-labeling the test dataset or using computationally expensive online RL regimes.

AI.title_translation: AbFlowNet：通过扩散-GFlowNet融合优化抗体-抗原结合能
AI.tldr: AbFlowNet通过融合扩散模型与GFlowNet，实现了抗体CDR设计中扩散损失与结合能的联合优化，显著提高了抗体结合效能和重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的抗体互补决定区（CDR）计算设计方法主要利用重建损失，无法联合优化结合能这一决定抗体疗效的关键指标；而传统的结合能优化则依赖于计算成本高昂且估计器不可靠的在线强化学习（RL）流程。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为AbFlowNet的新型生成框架，将每个扩散步骤构建为GFlowNet框架中的一个状态，将能量信号直接纳入训练过程，从而将扩散与奖励优化统一在单一程序中，联合优化标准扩散损失和结合能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，AbFlowNet在氨基酸恢复率上优于基础扩散模型3.06%，几何重建（RMSD）提升20.40%，结合能改善率提高3.60%；同时，在不使用伪标签或昂贵在线RL的情况下，Top-1总能量和结合能误差分别降低了24.8%和38.1%。
AI.conclusion: AbFlowNet作为一种创新的生成框架，有效融合了扩散模型与GFlowNet，实现了抗体CDR设计中扩散损失与结合能的联合优化，显著提升了抗体的设计质量和结合效能。
AI.translation: 互补决定区（CDR）是抗体促进与特定抗原结合的关键片段。当前的CDR设计计算方法利用重建损失，但未联合优化结合能（抗体疗效的关键指标）。相反，结合能优化是通过依赖不可靠结合能估计器的、计算昂贵的在线强化学习（RL）流程来完成的。在本文中，我们提出了AbFlowNet，一个将GFlowNet与扩散模型集成的新型生成框架。通过将每个扩散步骤构建为GFlowNet框架中的一个状态，AbFlowNet通过直接将能量信号并入训练过程来联合优化标准扩散损失和结合能，从而在单一程序中统一了扩散和奖励优化。实验结果表明，AbFlowNet在氨基酸恢复率上比基础扩散模型高出3.06%，几何重建（RMSD）高出20.40%，结合能改善率高出3.60%。在不使用测试集伪标签或计算昂贵的在线RL机制的情况下，AbFlowNet还将Top-1总能量和结合能误差分别降低了24.8%和38.1%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AbFlowNet，一个结合了扩散模型与GFlowNet的新型生成框架，通过将每个扩散步骤视为GFlowNet的状态，实现了抗体CDR设计中扩散损失与结合能的联合优化，在避免高昂在线RL开销的同时显著提高了抗体-抗原的结合效能和结构重建质量。
AI.keywords: AbFlowNet, GFlowNet, 扩散模型, 抗体设计, 结合能优化
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将扩散模型与GFlowNet融合，提出了AbFlowNet，用于抗体-抗原结合能的联合优化。相比传统的在线强化学习方法，该方法无需高昂的计算成本和不可靠的结合能估计器，兼顾了生成质量与结合能的优化，在多项指标上取得了显著提升，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Chi-Square Wavelet Graph Neural Networks for Heterogeneous Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph Anomaly Detection (GAD) in heterogeneous networks presents unique challenges due to node and edge heterogeneity. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN) methods primarily focus on homogeneous GAD and thus fail to address three key issues: (C1) Capturing abnormal signal and rich semantics across diverse meta-paths; (C2) Retaining high-frequency content in HIN dimension alignment; and (C3) Learning effectively from difficult anomaly samples with class imbalance. To overcome these, we propose ChiGAD, a spectral GNN framework based on a novel Chi-Square filter, inspired by the wavelet effectiveness in diverse domains. Specifically, ChiGAD consists of: (1) Multi-Graph Chi-Square Filter, which captures anomalous information via applying dedicated Chi-Square filters to each meta-path graph; (2) Interactive Meta-Graph Convolution, which aligns features while preserving high-frequency information and incorporates heterogeneous messages by a unified Chi-Square Filter; and (3) Contribution-Informed Cross-Entropy Loss, which prioritizes difficult anomalies to address class imbalance. Extensive experiments on public and industrial datasets show that ChiGAD outperforms state-of-the-art models on multiple metrics. Additionally, its homogeneous variant, ChiGNN, excels on seven GAD datasets, validating the effectiveness of Chi-Square filters. Our code is available at https://github.com/HsipingLi/ChiGAD.

AI.title_translation: 用于异构图异常检测的卡方小波图神经网络
AI.tldr: 本文提出了ChiGAD框架，利用创新的卡方小波滤波器有效解决了异构图异常检测中的语义、高频保留及类别不平衡三大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有图神经网络主要聚焦于同构图异常检测，无法有效应对异构网络中节点和边异质性带来的三大挑战：捕获多样元路径下的异常信号与丰富语义、在异构信息网络维度对齐中保留高频内容、以及从存在类别不平衡的困难异常样本中进行有效学习。
AI.method: 提出ChiGAD框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)多图卡方滤波器，针对不同元路径应用专用卡方滤波器捕获异常；(2)交互式元图卷积，通过统一的卡方滤波器对齐特征并保留高频信息、融合异构消息；(3)贡献感知的交叉熵损失，优先处理困难异常样本以缓解类别不平衡。
AI.result: 在公共和工业数据集上的大量实验表明，ChiGAD在多项指标上均优于现有的先进模型；其同构变体ChiGNN也在七个图异常检测数据集上表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 提出的ChiGAD框架通过多图卡方滤波器、交互式元图卷积和贡献感知的交叉熵损失，有效解决了异构图异常检测中的语义捕获、高频保留及类别不平衡难题，实验证明了其卓越性能。
AI.translation: 异构网络中的图异常检测（GAD）由于节点和边的异质性，面临着独特的挑战。现有的图神经网络（GNN）方法主要关注同构GAD，因此未能解决三个关键问题：（C1）捕获多样元路径中的异常信号和丰富语义；（C2）在异构信息网络（HIN）维度对齐中保留高频内容；以及（C3）从具有类别不平衡的困难异常样本中进行有效学习。为了克服这些问题，受小波在各个领域有效性的启发，我们提出了ChiGAD，这是一个基于新型卡方滤波器的谱GNN框架。具体而言，ChiGAD包括：（1）多图卡方滤波器，通过将专用的卡方滤波器应用于每个元路径图来捕获异常信息；（2）交互式元图卷积，在保留高频信息的同时对齐特征，并通过统一的卡方滤波器整合异构消息；以及（3）贡献感知的交叉熵损失，优先处理困难的异常以解决类别不平衡问题。在公共和工业数据集上的大量实验表明，ChiGAD在多项指标上优于最先进的模型。此外，其同构变体ChiGNN在七个GAD数据集上表现出色，验证了卡方滤波器的有效性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/HsipingLi/ChiGAD 获取。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一个名为ChiGAD的谱图神经网络框架，用于解决异构图异常检测中的语义异质性、高频信息丢失和类别不平衡问题。该框架核心在于创新的卡方小波滤波器，并通过多图滤波、交互卷积与贡献感知损失的设计，在多个数据集上取得了优于当前SOTA的性能。
AI.keywords: Graph Anomaly Detection, Heterogeneous Information Networks, Spectral Graph Neural Networks, Chi-Square Filter, Wavelet Transform
AI.comments: 该论文针对异构图异常检测中的异质性、高频信息保留以及类别不平衡问题，创新性地提出了基于卡方小波滤波器的ChiGAD框架，不仅在异构图上表现优异，其同构变体也在多个基准数据集上验证了卡方滤波器的通用性和有效性。

title: An iterative tangential interpolation algorithm for model reduction of MIMO systems
comments: 14 pages, 4 figures Submitted to IEEE TAC. Revision 2
summary:
We consider model reduction of large-scale Multi-Input, Multi-Output (MIMO) systems using low-rank barycentric tangential interpolation on the frequency axis. Our scheme is related to the recently-developed Adaptive Antoulas--Anderson (AAA) algorithm, which is an iterative algorithm that uses concepts related to the Loewner framework.
  One feature of our algorithm is optimization of the interpolation weight matrices to minimize a proxy for the \(L_2\) system error. We use the freedom in interpolation point selection to provide multiple minimum-error-based algorithms with trade-offs between computational complexity and approximation performance. We prove that a weighted \(L_2\) norm of the proxy error system is non-increasing as interpolation points are added, and that the reduced-order system is stable whenever the original system is. Computational results are provided demonstrating the closeness of the proxy system and true system \(L_2\) errors. Comparisons with prior work demonstrate performance on par with standard model reduction methods.
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures Submitted to IEEE TAC. Revision 2

AI.title_translation: 用于MIMO系统模型降阶的迭代切向插值算法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于MIMO系统模型降阶的迭代切向插值算法，具有良好的稳定性和逼近性能。
AI.motivation: 为了实现对大规模多输入多输出（MIMO）系统的高效模型降阶，并克服现有方法在误差控制和计算复杂度之间的平衡问题。
AI.method: 利用频率轴上的低秩重心切向插值，优化插值权重矩阵以最小化L2系统误差的代理，并利用插值点选择的自由度在计算复杂度和逼近性能之间进行权衡。
AI.result: 证明了代理误差系统的加权L2范数随着插值点的增加而单调不增，且原系统稳定时降阶系统必然稳定；计算结果表明代理系统与真实系统的L2误差非常接近，性能与标准降阶方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种用于MIMO系统模型降阶的迭代切向插值算法，在保证稳定性的同时实现了与现有标准方法相当的逼近性能。
AI.translation: 我们考虑使用频率轴上的低秩重心切向插值对大规模多输入、多输出（MIMO）系统进行模型降阶。我们的方案与最近发展的自适应Antoulas--Anderson（AAA）算法相关，该算法是一个使用与Loewner框架相关概念的迭代算法。我们算法的一个特点是优化插值权重矩阵，以最小化 $L_2$ 系统误差的代理。我们利用插值点选择的自由度，提供了多种基于最小误差的算法，从而在计算复杂度和逼近性能之间进行权衡。我们证明了随着插值点的增加，代理误差系统的加权 $L_2$ 范数是非递增的，并且当原系统稳定时，降阶系统也是稳定的。计算结果表明了代理系统与真实系统 $L_2$ 误差的接近性。与先前工作的比较证明了其性能与标准模型减缩方法相当。
AI.summary: 本文针对大规模MIMO系统的模型降阶问题，提出了一种基于频率轴低秩重心切向插值的迭代算法。该算法通过优化插值权重矩阵来最小化L2系统误差的代理，并提供了权衡计算复杂度和逼近性能的多样化算法。理论上证明了其稳定性和误差单调性，实验表明其性能与标准方法相当。
AI.keywords: 模型降阶, MIMO系统, 切向插值, AAA算法, L2误差优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于迭代切向插值的MIMO系统降阶算法，通过优化插值权重矩阵最小化L2系统误差的代理，并在理论上证明了误差的非递减性及降阶系统的稳定性，数值实验验证了其有效性。

title: Beyond Gold Standards: Epistemic Ensemble of LLM Judges for Formal Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Statement autoformalization plays a crucial role in formal mathematical reasoning by enabling the automatic translation of natural language statements into formal languages. While recent advances using large language models (LLMs) have shown promising capabilities in autoformalization, methods for automatically evaluating autoformalization remain underexplored. LLM-as-a-judge presents a promising approach for automating such evaluation, however, existing methods typically employ coarse-grained and generic evaluation criteria, which limit their effectiveness for advanced formal mathematical reasoning, where quality hinges on nuanced, multi-granular dimensions. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this gap by introducing a systematic, automatic method to evaluate autoformalization tasks. The proposed method is based on an epistemically and formally grounded ensemble (EFG) of LLM judges, defined on criteria encompassing logical preservation (LP), mathematical consistency (MC), formal quality (FQ), and formal validity (FV), resulting in a transparent assessment that accounts for different contributing factors. We validate the proposed framework to serve as a proxy for autoformalization assessment within the domain of formal mathematics. Overall, our experiments demonstrate that the EFG ensemble of LLM judges is a more suitable emerging proxy for evaluation than a coarse-grained model. These findings suggest that LLM judges, especially when guided by a well-defined set of atomic properties, could offer a scalable, interpretable, and reliable support for evaluating formal mathematical reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 超越黄金标准：形式化数学推理中大语言模型裁判的认识论集成
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于认知和形式化基础的LLM裁判集成方法（EFG），用于解决形式化数学推理中自动形式化评估粒度粗糙的问题，实验证明其具有更高的可靠性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 目前的自动形式化评估方法尚不充分，现有的LLM裁判方法通常采用粗粒度和通用的评估标准，无法满足高级形式化数学推理对细粒度、多维度质量评估的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于认知和形式化基础的LLM裁判集成方法（EFG），该方法定义了包括逻辑保持（LP）、数学一致性（MC）、形式化质量（FQ）和形式化有效性（FV）在内的多粒度评估标准。
AI.result: 实验证明，与粗粒度模型相比，EFG裁判集成方法是更适合用于自动形式化评估的代理，能够提供透明、可解释和可靠的支持。
AI.conclusion: 基于认知和形式化基础的LLM裁判集成方法（EFG）能够为形式化数学推理中的自动形式化提供一个可扩展、可解释且可靠的评估代理，优于传统的粗粒度模型。
AI.translation: 陈述自动形式化通过实现自然语言语句到形式化语言的自动翻译，在形式化数学推理中发挥着关键作用。尽管利用大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展在自动形式化方面展现出了广阔的前景，但自动评估自动形式化的方法仍未得到充分探索。LLM作为裁判的方法为自动化此类评估提供了一种有前景的途径，然而，现有方法通常采用粗粒度和通用的评估标准，这限制了它们在高级形式化数学推理中的有效性，因为在高级推理中，质量取决于细微的、多粒度的维度。在这项工作中，我们朝着解决这一差距迈出了一步，引入了一种系统的、自动的方法来评估自动形式化任务。所提出的方法基于一个在认识论和形式化上有根据的LLM裁判集成（EFG），该集成定义在包含逻辑保持（LP）、数学一致性（MC）、形式化质量（FQ）和形式化有效性（FV）的标准上，从而产生一个考虑了不同贡献因素的透明评估。我们验证了所提出的框架可以作为形式数学领域内自动形式化评估的代理。总的来说，我们的实验表明，LLM裁判的EFG集成比粗粒度模型更适合作为评估的新兴代理。这些发现表明，LLM裁判在由一组明确定义的原子属性指导时，可以为评估形式化数学推理提供可扩展、可解释和可靠的支持。
AI.summary: 该论文针对数学推理中自动形式化缺乏精细化评估的问题，提出了一种基于认知与形式化基础的LLM裁判集成方法（EFG）。通过引入逻辑保持、数学一致性、形式化质量和形式化有效性等多粒度评估标准，实验证明该方法能够作为一种可扩展、可解释且可靠的自动形式化评估代理。
AI.keywords: 自动形式化, 形式化数学推理, 大语言模型裁判, 知识集成, 评估代理
AI.comments: 该论文针对形式化数学推理中自动形式化（autoformalization）评估不足的问题，提出了一种基于认知和形式化基础的LLM裁判集成方法（EFG），具有很高的创新性和实用价值。它通过多粒度的维度弥补了传统粗粒度评估的缺陷，为数学推理的自动化评估提供了透明且可靠的解决方案。

title: Two Tiling is Undecidable
summary:
We show that the following problem is undecidable: given two polygonal prototiles, determine whether the plane can be tiled with rotated and translated copies of them. This improves a result of Demaine and Langerman [SoCG 2025], who showed undecidability for three tiles.
  Along the way, we show that tiling with one prototile is undecidable if there can be edge-to-edge matching rules. This is the first result to show undecidability for monotiling with only local matching constraints.

AI.title_translation: 两种瓦片平铺是不可判定的
AI.tldr: 本文证明了仅用两个多边形原型判定是否能平铺平面的问题是不可判定的，并将单瓦片带匹配规则的平铺判定首次证明为不可判定。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索平面平铺问题的计算复杂性极限，探究仅使用最少数量的多边形原型（如两个或一个带局部规则）能否判定其平铺平面的能力。
AI.method: 通过逻辑归约与证明，改进了Demaine和Langerman的研究成果，将三瓦片平铺不可判定性缩减至两瓦片，并分析了带局部边缘匹配规则的单瓦片平铺问题。
AI.result: 证明了使用两个多边形原型进行平铺判定是不可判定的；同时证明了在存在边对边匹配规则的情况下，使用一个原型进行平铺也是不可判定的。
AI.conclusion: 通过将平铺问题归约，证明了给定两个多边形原型判定平面是否可被平铺是不可判定的，同时证明了带边缘匹配规则的单瓦片平铺也是不可判定的。
AI.translation:
我们证明了以下问题是不可判定的：给定两个多边形原型，确定是否可以用它们的旋转和翻译副本来平铺平面。这改进了Demaine和Langerman（SoCG 2025）的结果，他们证明了三个瓦片的不可判定性。
在此过程中，我们证明了如果存在边对边匹配规则，使用一个原型的平铺是不可判定的。这是第一个证明仅具有局部匹配约束的单瓦片平铺具有不可判定性的结果。
AI.summary: 该论文证明了使用两个多边形原型判定平面能否被平铺的问题是不可判定的，从而将前人关于三个瓦片的结果推进了一步；此外，论文还首次证明了在包含局部边缘匹配规则的情况下，单瓦片平铺判定同样是不可判定的。
AI.keywords: 平铺问题, 不可判定性, 多边形瓦片, 匹配规则, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 该论文在计算几何与平铺理论（Tiling Theory）方面取得了重大突破，成功将多边形平铺不可判定性的所需瓦片数量从三个降低至两个，并在单瓦片带局部匹配规则的情况下首次证明了不可判定性，具有极高的理论价值。

title: Integrating Planning and Predictive Control Using the Path Feasibility Governor
comments: 16 pages, 12 figures, accepted as a Full Paper in IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control
summary:
The motion planning problem of generating dynamically feasible, collision-free trajectories in non-convex environments is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. Decomposing the problem into path planning and path tracking improves tractability, but integrating these components in a theoretically sound and computationally efficient manner is challenging. We propose the Path Feasibility Governor (PathFG), a framework for integrating path planners with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC). The PathFG manipulates the reference passed to the MPC controller, guiding it along a path while ensuring constraint satisfaction, stability, and recursive feasibility. The PathFG is modular, compatible with replanning, and improves computational efficiency and reliability by reducing the need for long prediction horizons. We prove safety and asymptotic stability with a significantly expanded region of attraction, and validate its real-time performance through simulated case studies of unicycle and quadrotor navigation in cluttered environments.

AI.title_translation: 使用路径可行性调节器集成规划与预测控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 PathFG 的新型框架，它将路径规划与非线性模型预测控制（MPC）相结合，能够在保证系统安全和稳定性的同时提高计算效率，适用于复杂环境中的自主导航。
AI.motivation: 在非凸环境中生成动态可行且无碰撞的轨迹是自主系统的核心挑战。将问题分解为路径 planning 和 tracking 虽然能提高易解性，但在理论完备和计算高效地整合这两个组件方面仍存在困难。
AI.method: 提出 Path Feasibility Governor (PathFG) 框架，通过操控传递给 MPC 控制器的参考轨迹来引导其沿路径移动，同时保证约束满足、稳定性和递归可行性。
AI.result: 证明了系统的安全性和渐近稳定性，并扩展了吸引域；通过单车和四旋翼在复杂环境中的导航仿真案例，验证了其具有良好的实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的 PathFG 框架有效解决了路径规划与追踪集成中的理论完备性与计算效率问题，并通过理论证明与仿真实验验证了其在复杂环境中的卓越性能。
AI.translation: 在非凸环境中生成动态可行、无碰撞轨迹的运动规划问题是自主系统面临的一项基本挑战。将该问题分解为路径规划和路径跟踪可以提高易解性，但以理论健全且计算高效的方式集成这些组件是具有挑战性的。我们提出了路径可行性调节器（PathFG），这是一个将路径规划器与非线性模型预测控制（MPC）相集成的框架。PathFG 操纵传递给 MPC 控制器的参考，引导其沿路径运动，同时确保满足约束条件、稳定性和递归可行性。PathFG 具有模块化、兼容重规划的特点，并通过减少对长预测视界的需求，提高了计算效率和可靠性。我们证明了具有显著扩大吸引域的安全性和渐近稳定性，并通过单车和四旋翼在杂乱环境中导航的模拟案例研究验证了其实时性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Path Feasibility Governor (PathFG) 框架，用于将路径规划器与非线性模型预测控制（MPC）进行集成。该框架通过调节输入到 MPC 的参考轨迹，在确保系统约束满足、稳定性和递归可行性的同时，减小了对长预测视界的需求，提升了计算效率和可靠性。
AI.keywords: 路径规划, 模型预测控制, 轨迹跟踪, 递归可行性, 自主系统
AI.comments: 该论文提出的 Path Feasibility Governor (PathFG) 框架巧妙地结合了路径规划与非线性模型预测控制（MPC），在保证系统安全性和鲁棒稳定性的同时，显著降低了对长预测视界的需求，从而提高了计算效率。这对于复杂非凸环境下的自主系统实时导航具有重要意义。

title: Foundation Model Driven Robotics: A Comprehensive Review
summary: The rapid emergence of foundation models, particularly large language models and vision-language models, has introduced a transformative paradigm in robotics. The models offer powerful capabilities in semantic understanding, high-level reasoning, and cross-modal generalization, enabling significant advances in perception, planning, control, and human-robot interaction. This critical review provides a structured synthesis of recent developments and organizes applications into four directions: simulation-driven robotics, open-world operation, sim-to-real transfer, and adaptable robotic systems. Unlike existing surveys that emphasize isolated capabilities, this work highlights integrated, system-level strategies and evaluates their practical feasibility in real-world environments. Key enabling trends such as procedural scene generation, policy generalization, and multimodal reasoning are discussed alongside core bottlenecks, including limited embodiment, lack of multimodal data, safety risks, and computational constraints. Through this lens, this paper identifies both the architectural strengths and critical limitations of foundation model-based robotics, highlighting open challenges in real-time operation, grounding, resilience, and trust. The review concludes with a roadmap of proposed future research directions for bridging semantic reasoning and physical intelligence through more robust, interpretable, and embodied models.

AI.title_translation: 基础模型驱动的机器人技术：全面综述
AI.tldr: 本文综述了基础模型在机器人领域的应用，分析了其系统级整合策略、核心优势、面临的挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 为了应对大语言模型和视觉语言模型在机器人领域带来的范式变革，克服现有综述多强调孤立能力的局限，本工作旨在系统整合并评估基础模型在机器人感知、规划、控制和人机交互中的系统级应用。
AI.method: 提供了一个结构化的综合评述，将应用归纳为四个方向（模拟驱动机器人、开放世界操作、仿真到真实迁移、自适应机器人系统），并评估了其在真实世界环境中的实用可行性。
AI.result: 识别了基础模型在机器人学中的架构优势与关键局限，重点指出了实时操作、具身接地（grounding）、系统韧性以及信任度方面面临的公开挑战，并规划了未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 论文总结了基础模型驱动机器人的最新进展与核心瓶颈，并提出了未来研究路线图，旨在通过更具鲁棒性、可解释性和具身性的模型，弥合语义推理与物理智能之间的鸿沟。
AI.translation: 基础模型的迅速崛起，特别是大语言模型和视觉语言模型的出现，为机器人技术引入了一种变革性的范式。这些模型在语义理解、高层推理和跨模态泛化方面展现出强大能力，推动了感知、规划、控制以及人机交互的显著进步。这篇批判性综述对近期发展进行了结构化综合，并将应用组织为四个方向：模拟驱动的机器人、开放世界操作、仿真到真实迁移以及自适应机器人系统。不同于强调孤立能力的现有综述，本工作突出系统级的整合策略，并评估了它们在真实世界环境中的实用可行性。文中讨论了程序化场景生成、策略泛化和多模态推理等关键使能趋势，以及具身性有限、缺乏多模态数据、安全风险和计算约束等核心瓶颈。通过这一视角，本文识别了基于基础模型的机器人学的架构优势与关键局限，强调了实时操作、基础接地、韧性和信任方面的未解挑战。综述最后提出了未来研究方向的路线图，旨在通过更鲁棒、可解释和具身化的模型来弥合语义推理与物理智能之间的鸿沟。
AI.summary: 本文全面综述了基础模型在机器人技术中的应用与发展，探讨了其在语义理解和跨模态泛化方面的强大能力，系统归纳了四大应用方向，分析了关键瓶颈与挑战，并展望了未来研究路线图。
AI.keywords: 基础模型, 机器人学, 大语言模型, 视觉语言模型, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该综述论文切入点新颖，从系统级整合的角度审视了基础模型在机器人技术中的应用，不仅总结了四大核心方向和前沿趋势，还深入探讨了具身性限制、安全风险及计算瓶颈等关键痛点，为未来将语义推理与物理智能相结合的研究指明了方向。

title: BusterX++: Towards Unified Cross-Modal AI-Generated Content Detection and Explanation with MLLM
summary: The rapid advancement of generative AI has substantially improved image and video synthesis, amplifying the risk of multimodal visual misinformation. Recent MLLMs have shown promise for transparent AI-generated content detection through reasoning and explanation, yet existing approaches largely treat image and video forensics as isolated tasks, leaving cross-modal synergies underexplored. To address this, we present \textbf{BusterX++}, a unified MLLM for joint image and video detection with interpretable reasoning. We also introduce \textbf{GenBuster-Bench++}, a curated benchmark containing balanced image and video samples spanning recent generation models and diverse real-world scenarios, with synthetic images and videos screened using the same human difficulty criterion. Using this controlled setting, we revisit the widely adopted SFT+RL post-training paradigm. Notably, in the unified image-video setting, our results demonstrate that a single-stage pure RL strategy driven primarily by sparse outcome rewards outperforms a strong SFT+RL baseline. We observe that single-stage pure RL maintains higher policy entropy than SFT-initialized RL throughout training. This observation suggests a possible role for exploration in the performance gains observed under unified image-video training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BusterX++ achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the powerful potential of RL for unified cross-modal visual reasoning.

AI.title_translation: BusterX++：利用 MLLM 实现统一的跨模态 AI 生成内容检测与解释
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 BusterX++，一个利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）实现统一图像与视频生成内容检测及可解释推理的框架，并证明了纯强化学习策略在该任务中的卓越性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的多模态大语言模型虽然在透明的AI生成内容检测方面展现出潜力，但通常将图像和视频取证视为孤立的任务，忽视了跨模态之间的协同作用。为此，需要开发一个能够同时处理图像和视频检测并提供可解释推理的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出 BusterX++ 统一 MLLM 框架进行联合图视频检测与可解释推理；构建 GenBuster-Bench++ 基准测试；采用由稀疏结果奖励驱动的单阶段纯强化学习策略进行模型训练。
AI.result: 在统一的图视频设置下，单阶段纯强化学习策略（主要由稀疏结果奖励驱动）优于强大的 SFT+RL 基线，且训练过程中保持了更高的策略熵，最终 BusterX++ 取得了 SOTA 的性能。
AI.conclusion: BusterX++ 实现了统一的图像和视频生成内容检测与解释，并通过纯强化学习策略取得了最先进的性能，展示了强化学习在跨模态视觉推理中的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 生成式人工智能的快速发展显著改善了图像和视频合成，加剧了多模态视觉虚假信息的风险。近期的 MLLM 通过推理和解释为透明的 AI 生成内容检测展示了前景，然而现有方法大都将图像和视频取证视为孤立的任务，跨模态协同作用尚未得到充分探索。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 BusterX++，一个用于联合图像和视频检测及可解释推理的统一 MLLM。我们还引入了 GenBuster-Bench++，这是一个精心策划的基准测试，包含平衡的图像和视频样本，涵盖了最近的生成模型和多样化的真实场景，其中合成图视频使用相同的人类难度标准进行筛选。利用这种受控环境，我们重新审视了广泛采用的 SFT+RL 后训练范式。值得注意的是，在统一的图视频设置下，我们的结果表明，主要由稀疏结果奖励驱动的单阶段纯强化学习策略优于强大的 SFT+RL 基线。我们观察到，在整个训练过程中，单阶段纯强化学习比 SFT 初始化的强化学习保持了更高的策略熵。这一观察结果表明，探索在统一图视频训练中观察到的性能提升可能起到了作用。大量实验表明，BusterX++ 实现了 SOTA 的性能，突显了强化学习在统一跨模态视觉推理方面的强大潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 BusterX++，一个基于 MLLM 的统一框架，用于联合检测图像和视频中的 AI 生成内容并提供可解释的推理。作者还构建了 GenBuster-Bench++ 基准测试，并通过实验证明了由稀疏奖励驱动的单阶段纯强化学习策略在统一跨模态视觉推理中的卓越性能。
AI.keywords: AI生成内容检测, 多模态大语言模型, 跨模态推理, 强化学习, 图像与视频取证
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将图像和视频伪造检测任务统一在一个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）框架中，并提出了首个平衡的图像-视频基准测试。此外，论文探讨了纯强化学习策略在统一跨模态视觉推理中的有效性，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: Cyber-Zero: Training Cybersecurity Agents without Runtime
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in software engineering tasks when trained with executable runtime environments, particularly in resolving GitHub issues. However, such runtime environments are often unavailable in other domains, especially cybersecurity, where challenge configurations and execution contexts are ephemeral or restricted. We present Cyber-Zero, the first runtime-free framework for synthesizing high-quality agent trajectories to train cybersecurity LLMs. Cyber-Zero leverages publicly available CTF writeups and employs persona-driven LLM simulation to reverse-engineer runtime behaviors and generate realistic, long-horizon interaction sequences without actual environments. Using trajectories synthesized by Cyber-Zero, we train LLM-based agents that achieve up to 11.4% absolute performance gains over baseline models on three prominent CTF benchmarks: InterCode-CTF, NYU CTF Bench, and Cybench. Our best model, Cyber-Zero-32B, establishes new state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models, matching the capabilities of proprietary systems like DeepSeek-V3-0324 and Claude-3.5-Sonnet while offering superior cost-effectiveness, and demonstrating that runtime-free trajectory synthesis can effectively democratize the development of state-of-the-art cybersecurity agents.

AI.title_translation: Cyber-Zero：在没有运行时的条件下训练网络安全智能体
AI.tldr: Cyber-Zero 是首个无需运行时的网络安全智能体训练框架，它通过利用公开的 CTF 解题报告和 LLM 仿真生成高质量轨迹，使开源模型在网络安全任务上的性能达到顶尖专有系统的水平。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在软件工程等任务中借助可执行运行环境取得了巨大成功，但在网络安全领域，挑战配置和执行上下文往往是短暂的或受限的（即缺乏可执行的运行时环境），这限制了网络安全智能体的训练。
AI.method: 利用公开的 CTF writeups（解题报告），采用基于角色（persona-driven）的 LLM 仿真来逆向工程运行时行为，在没有实际环境的情况下生成逼真的、长视野的交互序列。
AI.result: 使用 Cyber-Zero 合成的轨迹训练出的 LLM 智能体在 InterCode-CTF、NYU CTF Bench 和 Cybench 三个突出的 CTF 基准测试中，绝对性能比基线模型提升了高达 11.4%；最佳模型 Cyber-Zero-32B 在开源模型中创下了新的 SOTA，性能媲美 DeepSeek-V3-0324 和 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等专有系统。
AI.conclusion: Cyber-Zero 证明了无需运行时的轨迹合成可以有效且低成本地训练出最先进的网络安全大语言模型智能体，为其在缺乏运行时的敏感或受限领域的应用开辟了新途径。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）在通过可执行运行环境（特别是解决 GitHub 问题）训练时，在软件工程任务中取得了显著成功。然而，此类运行环境在其他领域往往不可用，特别是网络安全领域，其中的挑战配置和执行上下文是短暂的或受限的。我们提出了 Cyber-Zero，这是第一个用于合成高质量智能体轨迹以训练网络安全 LLM 的无运行时框架。Cyber-Zero 利用公开可用的 CTF 解题报告（writeups），并采用基于角色的 LLM 仿真来逆向工程运行时行为，在没有实际环境的情况下生成逼真、长视野的交互序列。使用由 Cyber-Zero 合成的轨迹，我们训练了基于 LLM 的智能体，在三个著名的 CTF 基准测试（InterCode-CTF、NYU CTF Bench 和 Cybench）上，绝对性能比基线模型提升了高达 11.4%。我们的最佳模型 Cyber-Zero-32B 在开源模型中确立了新的最新性能，媲美 DeepSeek-V3-0324 和 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等专有系统的能力，同时提供更高的成本效益，这表明无运行时轨迹合成可以有效民主化最先进网络安全智能体的开发。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 Cyber-Zero，这是一个首创的无需运行时的框架，通过利用公开的 CTF 解题报告并采用基于角色的 LLM 仿真来生成高质量的交互轨迹，从而无需实际执行环境即可训练网络安全大语言模型，并取得了媲美顶尖专有系统的性能。
AI.keywords: 网络安全, 大语言模型, 轨迹合成, 无运行时, CTF 挑战

title: Robust Surrogate Modeling for Explainable Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable performance in a wide range of graph-related learning tasks. However, explaining their predictions remains a challenging problem, especially due to the mismatch between the graphs used during training and those encountered during explanation. Most existing methods optimize soft edge masks on weighted graphs to highlight important substructures, but these graphs differ from the unweighted graphs on which GNNs are trained. This distributional shift leads to unreliable gradients and degraded explanation quality, especially when generating small, sparse subgraphs. To address this issue, we propose explaining a robust surrogate whose explanations provide a faithful proxy for those of the original model. Specifically, we train this surrogate model through an iterative re-weighting strategy that alternates between identifying explanation subgraphs and adapting the model to the resulting weighted graph distribution, supporting stable explanation refinement while preserving the validity of the soft-mask relaxation. We evaluate our method on multiple benchmark datasets using different GNN backbones and explanation methods. Experimental results show that our method consistently improves explanation quality and can be flexibly integrated with different architectures.

AI.title_translation: 面向可解释图神经网络的鲁棒替代建模
AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过训练鲁棒替代模型来解决GNN解释中分布偏移问题的新方法，显著提高了图神经网络解释的质量和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的GNN解释方法通常通过优化加权图上的软边缘掩码来高亮重要子结构，但这与GNN训练时使用的未加权图存在不匹配。这种分布偏移会导致梯度不可靠、解释质量下降（特别是在生成小而稀疏的子图时）。
AI.method: 提出了一种通过迭代重加权策略训练鲁棒替代模型的方法，该策略在识别解释子图和适应加权图分布之间交替进行，以支持稳定的解释精炼并保持软掩码松弛的有效性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集、不同的GNN主干网络和解释方法上的实验结果表明，该方法能够一致地提升解释质量，并可灵活集成到不同的架构中。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过训练鲁棒的替代模型，有效解决了GNN解释中的分布偏移问题，提升了生成稀疏子图时的解释质量，且能够灵活集成到各种架构中。
AI.translation: 图神经网络（GNNs）在广泛的图相关学习任务中取得了显著的性能。然而，解释它们的预测仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，主要是由于训练期间使用的图与解释期间遇到的图之间存在不匹配。大多数现有方法在加权图上优化软边缘掩码以突出重要的子结构，但这些图与GNN训练所基于的未加权图不同。这种分布偏移会导致不可靠的梯度和退化的解释质量，特别是当生成小的、稀疏的子图时。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了解释一个鲁棒的替代模型，其解释为原始模型的解释提供了忠实的代理。具体来说，我们通过迭代重新加权策略训练这个替代模型，该策略在识别解释子图和将模型适应于由此产生的加权图分布之间交替，在保持软掩码松弛的有效性的同时支持稳定的解释精炼。我们在使用不同GNN主干和解释方法的多个基准数据集上评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明，我们的方法持续提高了解释质量，并且可以与不同的架构灵活集成。
AI.summary: 本文研究了图神经网络（GNN）的可解释性问题，针对加权解释图与未加权训练图之间的分布偏移导致的解释质量下降问题，提出了一种基于鲁棒替代模型的解释框架。通过迭代重加权策略，该方法实现了稳定且高质量的子图解释，实验证明其具有优异的性能和通用性。
AI.keywords: Graph Neural Networks, Explainable AI, Surrogate Modeling, Distribution Shift, Graph Substructures
AI.comments: 该论文针对图神经网络（GNN）可解释性中由于图结构不匹配（加权软掩码与未加权原图）导致的分布偏移问题，提出了一种基于鲁棒替代模型的新颖解释框架。其核心创新在于通过迭代重加权策略在保持软掩码松弛有效性的同时稳定了解释精炼过程，具有很强的通用性和鲁棒性。

title: Fully implicit timestepping methods for the rotating shallow water equations
summary: Fully implicit timestepping methods have had limited application in geophysical fluid dynamics due to challenges of finding suitable iterative solvers, since the coupled treatment of advection prevents the standard elimination techniques. However, overlapping Additive Schwarz methods provide a robust, scalable iterative approach for solving the monolithic coupled system for all fields and Runge-Kutta stages. In this study we investigate this approach applied to the rotating shallow water equations, facilitated by the Irksome package which provides automated code generation for implicit Runge-Kutta methods. We compare various schemes in terms of accuracy and efficiency using an implicit/explicit splitting method, namely the ARK2 scheme of Giraldo et al (2013), as a benchmark. This provides an initial look at whether implicit Runge-Kutta methods can be viable for atmosphere and ocean simulation.

AI.title_translation: 旋转浅水方程的全隐式时间步进方法
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了利用重叠加性施瓦茨方法和自动代码生成技术求解旋转浅水方程的全隐式Runge-Kutta方法，评估了其作为大气和海洋模拟可行方案的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 尽管全隐式时间步进方法由于对流的耦合处理限制了其在地球物理流体动力学中的应用，但重叠加性施瓦茨方法为求解整体耦合系统提供了稳健且可扩展的迭代方法，因此本研究旨在探讨其在旋转浅水方程中的应用潜力，以评估隐式Runge-Kutta方法用于大气和海洋模拟的可行性。
AI.method: 使用重叠加性施瓦茨方法（Additive Schwarz methods）作为求解全耦合系统的迭代求解器，并借助Irksome包进行隐式Runge-Kutta方法的自动化代码生成，将其应用于旋转浅水方程，同时与ARK2显隐式分裂格式进行精度和效率的对比。
AI.result: 通过与ARK2隐式/显式分裂方法的对比，评估了各种全隐式格式在精度和效率上的表现，验证了该方法作为大气和海洋模拟可行方案的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明全隐式Runge-Kutta方法在求解旋转浅水方程时是可行的，借助先进的迭代求解器和自动化工具，有望为大气和海洋模拟提供高效准确的替代方案。
AI.translation: 由于在寻找合适的迭代求解器方面面临挑战，且对流的耦合处理阻碍了标准的消元技术，全隐式时间步进方法在地球物理流体动力学中的应用一直有限。然而，重叠加性施瓦茨方法为求解针对所有场和Runge-Kutta阶段的整体耦合系统提供了一种稳健、可扩展的迭代方法。在本研究中，我们借助提供隐式Runge-Kutta方法自动代码生成的Irksome包，研究了该方法在旋转浅水方程中的应用。我们以Giraldo等人（2013）的ARK2显隐式分裂方法作为基准，从精度和效率方面对各种格式进行了比较。这为隐式Runge-Kutta方法是否可用于大气和海洋模拟提供了初步的评估。
AI.summary: 论文研究了将全隐式时间步进方法（特别是隐式Runge-Kutta方法）应用于旋转浅水方程的可行性。通过采用重叠加性施瓦茨方法和Irksome自动代码生成工具克服了解耦难题，并与基准隐显分裂格式进行了精度与效率的对比。
AI.keywords: 全隐式时间步进, 旋转浅水方程, 加性施瓦茨方法, 隐式Runge-Kutta方法, 地球物理流体动力学
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了全隐式时间步进方法在地球物理流体动力学（特别是旋转浅水方程）中的应用潜力，通过重叠加性施瓦茨方法和Irksome自动代码生成包克服了传统求解瓶颈，为大气和海洋模拟提供了新的数值求解思路。

title: On the Parameterized Complexity of Grundy Domination and Zero Forcing Problems
comments: version published in the Journal of Computer and System Sciences
summary:
We consider two different problem families that deal with domination in graphs. On the one hand, we focus on dominating sequences. In such a sequence, every vertex dominates some vertex of the graph that was not dominated by any earlier vertex in the sequence. The problem of finding the longest dominating sequence is known as $\mathsf{Grundy~Domination}$. Depending on whether the closed or the open neighborhoods are used for domination, there are three other versions of this problem: $\mathsf{Grundy~Total~Domination}$, $\mathsf{L\text{-}Grundy~Domination}$, and $\mathsf{Z\text{-}Grundy~Domination}$. We show that all four problem variants are $\mathsf{W[1]}$-complete when parameterized by the solution size.
  On the other hand, we consider the family of zero forcing problems which form the parametric duals of the Grundy domination problems. In these problems, one looks for the smallest set of vertices initially colored blue such that certain color change rules are able to color all other vertices blue. It has been shown that the dual of $\mathsf{Z\text{-}Grundy~Domination}$, known as $\mathsf{Zero~Forcing~Set}$, is in $\mathsf{FPT}$ when parameterized by the treewidth or the solution size. We extend the treewidth result to the other three variants of zero forcing and their respective Grundy domination problems. Our algorithm also implies an $\mathsf{FPT}$ algorithm for $\mathsf{Grundy~Domination}$ when parameterized by the number of vertices that are not in the dominating sequence. In contrast, we show that $\mathsf{L\text{-}Grundy~Domination}$ is $\mathsf{W[1]}$-hard for that parameter.

AI.title_translation: 关于Grundy控制与零强迫问题的参数化复杂度研究
AI.tldr: 本文研究了Grundy控制及零强迫问题族的参数化复杂度，证明了其在解大小参数下的W[1]-完全性，并将树宽的FPT算法结果推广到了相关变体。
AI.motivation: 探究关于图控制的两类不同问题族（Grundy控制问题与零强迫问题）在不同参数化（如解的大小、树宽、补集大小）下的参数化复杂度，以完善其理论分类。
AI.method: 通过参数化复杂性理论分析，利用树宽和解的大小作为参数，设计了相应的FPT算法并证明了W[1]-困难性与完全性。
AI.result: 所有四个Grundy控制变体在解的大小参数下是W[1]-complete；将零强迫问题的FPT结果扩展到了其所有四个变体；证明了L-Grundy控制问题在未包含在控制序列中的顶点数参数下是W[1]-hard，而Grundy控制问题在此参数下是FPT。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了四个Grundy控制问题变体在解的大小参数下是W[1]-完全的，并将零强迫问题的FPT结果扩展到了其他三个变体，同时指出了不同参数下的复杂性差异。
AI.translation:
我们考虑了图论中处理控制问题的两个不同问题族。一方面，我们聚焦于控制序列。在这类序列中，每个顶点都控制图中的某个在此序列之前未被任何顶点控制的顶点。寻找最长控制序列的问题被称为Grundy控制（Grundy Domination）。根据控制使用的是闭邻域还是开邻域，该问题还有另外三个版本：Grundy全控制、L-Grundy控制和Z-Grundy控制。我们证明了当以解的大小为参数时，这四个问题变体都是W[1]-完全的。
另一方面，我们考虑了零强迫问题族，它们构成了Grundy控制问题的参数对偶。在这些问题中，人们寻找最初涂为蓝色的最小顶点集，使得某些颜色改变规则能够将所有其他顶点涂成蓝色。研究表明，Z-Grundy控制的对偶（被称为零强迫集）在以树宽或解的大小为参数时属于FPT。我们将树宽的结果扩展到了零强迫的其他三个变体及其各自的Grundy控制问题。我们的算法还暗示了一个针对Grundy控制的FPT算法，当以不在控制序列中的顶点数为参数时。相比之下，我们证明了L-Grundy控制对于该参数是W[1]-硬的。
AI.summary: 论文研究了Grundy控制问题及其零强迫对偶问题族的参数化复杂度。作者证明了四大Grundy控制问题在解的大小下是W[1]-完全的，将零强迫的FPT结果扩展到了所有变体，并探讨了不同参数下的算法表现与复杂度界限。
AI.keywords: Grundy Domination, Zero Forcing, Parameterized Complexity, Treewidth, W[1]-completeness
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地研究了Grundy控制问题及其参数对偶零强迫问题的参数化复杂度，填补了该领域在不同变体和参数化途径下的理论空白，创新性强。

title: Training Language Model Agents to Find Vulnerabilities with CTF-Dojo
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities when trained within executable runtime environments, notably excelling at software engineering tasks through verified feedback loops. Yet, scalable and generalizable execution-grounded environments remain scarce, limiting progress in training more capable ML agents. We introduce CTF-Dojo, the first large-scale executable runtime tailored for training LLMs with verifiable feedback, featuring 658 fully functional Capture-The-Flag (CTF)-style challenges containerized in Docker with guaranteed reproducibility. To enable rapid scaling without manual intervention, we develop CTF-Forge, an automated pipeline that transforms publicly available artifacts into ready-to-use execution environments in minutes, eliminating weeks of expert configuration traditionally required. We trained LLM-based agents on just 486 high-quality, execution-verified trajectories from CTF-Dojo, achieving up to 9.9% absolute gains over strong baselines across three competitive benchmarks: InterCode-CTF, NYU CTF Bench, and Cybench. Our best-performing 32B model reaches 31.9% Pass@1, establishing a new open-weight state-of-the-art that rivals frontier models like DeepSeek-V3-0324 and Gemini-2.5-Flash. By framing CTF-style tasks as a benchmark for executable-agent learning, CTF-Dojo demonstrates that execution-grounded training signals are not only effective but pivotal in advancing high-performance ML agents without dependence on costly proprietary systems.

AI.title_translation: 使用 CTF-Dojo 训练语言模型智能体以发现漏洞
AI.tldr: 本文提出了CTF-Dojo和CTF-Forge，为训练LLM漏洞挖掘智能体提供大规模、可自动生成的容器化可执行环境，显著提升了开源模型的漏洞利用与对抗能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管大模型在可执行运行环境中表现出色，但可扩展且可泛化的基于执行的环境仍然稀缺，这限制了训练更强大机器学习智能体的进展。
AI.method: 开发了大规模可执行运行时环境CTF-Dojo（包含658个Docker容器化CTF挑战），并设计了自动化管道CTF-Forge将公共工件转化为执行环境；在此基础上利用486条高质量、经验证的轨迹训练LLM智能体。
AI.result: 在三个竞争激烈的基准测试（InterCode-CTF、NYU CTF Bench、Cybench）中，使用CTF-Dojo训练的智能体比强基线绝对提升高达9.9%，其中32B模型达到了31.9%的Pass@1，创下了开源模型的最新SOTA，并能媲美DeepSeek-V3-0324和Gemini-2.5-Flash等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: CTF-Dojo和CTF-Forge为训练基于LLM的安全智能体提供了一个可扩展、可复现的高效平台，证明了基于执行基础的训练信号对提升智能体性能至关重要。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在可执行运行时环境中训练时表现出非凡的能力，尤其擅长通过验证反馈循环完成软件工程任务。然而，可扩展且可泛化的基于执行的环境仍然稀缺，限制了训练更强机器学习智能体的进展。我们介绍了CTF-Dojo，这是第一个专为使用可验证反馈训练LLM而定制的大规模可执行运行时，具有658个完全功能的夺旗（CTF）风格挑战，这些挑战已在Docker中容器化并保证可复现性。为了在无需人工干预的情况下实现快速扩展，我们开发了CTF-Forge，这是一个自动化管道，可在几分钟内将公开可用的工件转换为立即可用的执行环境，消除了传统上需要数周专家配置的繁琐过程。我们在CTF-Dojo仅486条高质量、经执行验证的轨迹上训练了基于LLM的智能体，在三个竞争基准测试（InterCode-CTF、NYU CTF Bench和Cybench）中取得了高达9.9%的绝对增益，超越了强大的基线。我们表现最好的32B模型达到了31.9%的Pass@1，确立了新的开源权重最新技术水平，足以媲美DeepSeek-V3-0324和Gemini-2.5-Flash等前沿模型。通过将CTF风格的任务构筑为可执行智能体学习的基准，CTF-Dojo证明了基于执行的训练信号不仅有效，而且在不依赖昂贵专有系统的情况下推进高性能机器学习智能体的发展中起着关键作用。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了CTF-Dojo，这是一个用于训练大模型智能体寻找漏洞的大规模可执行运行时环境，并配合自动化管道CTF-Forge快速生成挑战。实验证明，利用该环境进行基于执行的反馈训练，能显著提升开源LLM在漏洞挖掘任务上的性能。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 漏洞挖掘, 软件工程智能体, Capture-The-Flag, 可执行运行时环境
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入CTF-Dojo和CTF-Forge，解决了大模型在可执行环境中缺乏规模化训练数据的痛点。其创新之处在于自动化生成容器化挑战并利用经验证的反馈循环，显著提升了开源大模型的漏洞挖掘和软件工程能力，性价比极高。

title: Structured Basis Function Networks: Loss-Centric Multi-Hypothesis Ensembles with Controllable Diversity
summary: Ensemble learning and multi-hypothesis prediction are two complementary paradigms for improving predictive performance and robustness. This work introduces the Structured Basis Function Network (s-BFN), a loss-aware ensemble framework that unifies these paradigms through a supervised aggregation mechanism motivated by the loss-induced Bregman-centroid geometry of prediction space. The approach constructs a structured dataset of base predictions and trains a parametric combiner directly against the observed labels, with the centroidal formulation serving as a geometric reference rather than an exact centroid solver, while a diversity-control parameter regulates specialization among predictors. The proposed framework is evaluated across regression and classification tasks, including tabular data, image recognition, and large-scale temporally structured video classification. Empirical results show that s-BFN provides strong performance across the evaluated regimes and is competitive with the aggregation baselines considered in the study. The strongest gains are observed in higher-dimensional and temporally structured settings, where aggregation capacity and controlled diversity are jointly beneficial, while simpler tabular regimes exhibit earlier saturation. These results highlight a capacity-complexity-diversity trade-off rather than a strictly monotonic relationship between diversity, ensemble size, and accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 结构化基函数网络：具有可控多样性的损失中心多假设集成
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 s-BFN 的新型损失感知集成框架，它利用 Bregman 质心几何和可控多样性参数，在复杂高维预测任务中实现了强大的集成性能。
AI.motivation: 为了结合集成学习和多假设预测这两个互补范式以提升预测性能与鲁棒性，并通过损失诱导的 Bregman 质心几何学提供统一的监督聚合机制。
AI.method: 提出结构化基函数网络（s-BFN），构建基础预测的结构化数据集，并使用参数化组合器直接针对观测标签进行训练，同时引入多样性控制参数来调节预测器专业化。
AI.result: 在表格数据、图像识别和大规模时序视频分类等回归与分类任务中表现出强大的性能，与现有聚合基线相比极具竞争力，尤其在高维和时序结构化设置中增益最明显。
AI.conclusion: s-BFN 框架通过结合损失导向的监督聚合与可控的多样性，在复杂和高维任务中表现出优异的性能，同时揭示了集成规模、多样性与准确性之间复杂的权衡关系。
AI.translation: 集成学习和多假设预测是提高预测性能和鲁棒性的两个互补范式。本工作引入了结构化基函数网络（s-BFN），这是一种损失感知的集成框架，它通过受预测空间损失诱导的 Bregman 质心几何所启发的监督聚合机制，将这些范式统一起来。该方法构建了基础预测的结构化数据集，并直接针对观测标签训练参数化的组合器，其中质心公式作为几何参考而不是精确的质心求解器，同时多样性控制参数调节预测器之间的专业化。所提出的框架在回归和分类任务进行了评估，包括表格数据、图像识别和大规模时序结构化视频分类。实验结果表明，s-BFN 在评估的各种情况下均表现出强大的性能，并且与研究中考虑的聚合基线相比具有竞争力。最显著的增益在高维和时序结构化环境中观察到，在这些环境中，聚合能力和受控多样性共同发挥作用，而较简单的表格数据则表现出较早的饱和。这些结果突出了容量-复杂度-多样性的权衡，而不是多样性、集成规模和准确性之间的严格单调关系。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了结构化基函数网络（s-BFN），这是一个结合了集成学习与多假设预测的损失感知集成框架。该方法基于 Bregman 质心几何学，采用受监督的聚合机制和可控的多样性参数，在多项回归与分类任务（包括表格、图像和视频数据）中取得了出色的性能，并展示了容量-复杂度-多样性的权衡关系。
AI.keywords: 集成学习, 多假设预测, Bregman质心几何, 多样性控制, 结构化基函数网络
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种结构化基函数网络（s-BFN），通过将集成学习和多假设预测统一在Bregman质心几何框架下，实现了损失导向的监督聚合。其创新之处在于利用多样性控制参数来调节预测器之间的专业化，并揭示了容量-复杂度-多样性之间的权衡关系，这为集成学习的设计提供了新的几何视角和理论启发。

title: Bayesian Transfer Operators in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
summary: Transfer operators provide a linear description of nonlinear dynamical systems by propagating observables or probability distributions. In reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, these operators are represented through conditional mean embeddings, whose regularized estimator coincides with the posterior mean of Gaussian process regression. Building on this correspondence, we formulate Gaussian Process Dynamic Mode Decomposition, a Bayesian transfer-operator method that combines sparse variational Gaussian processes with kernel-based Koopman and Perron--Frobenius operator approximation. The resulting framework provides a principled route to uncertainty quantification, scalable sparse approximations, and data-adaptive dictionary learning for prediction and spectral analysis. Additionally, the model-selection formulation naturally gives rise to a forward--backward operator structure, which establishes a connection between Bayesian transfer-operator learning and time-lagged canonical correlation analysis.

AI.title_translation: 再生核希尔伯特空间中的贝叶斯转移算子
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于高斯过程的贝叶斯转移算子方法，用于非线性动力系统的建模、预测和不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 为了克服传统转移算子方法缺乏系统性不确定性量化、可扩展性不足等问题，利用高斯过程回归与再生核希尔伯特空间中条件均值嵌入的对应关系，建立一种具有贝叶斯特性的转移算子学习方法。
AI.method: 构建了高斯过程动态模态分解（GPDMD）方法，结合了稀疏变分高斯过程与基于核的Koopman和Perron-Frobenius算子近似。
AI.result: 所提出的框架能够提供有原则的不确定性量化、可扩展的稀疏近似以及数据自适应的字典学习，模型选择公式还自然导出了前向-后向算子结构，并联系了时滞典型相关分析。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于再生核希尔伯特空间和高斯过程的贝叶斯转移算子方法，实现了动力系统的不确定性量化、可扩展稀疏近似及谱分析。
AI.translation: 转移算子通过传播可观测对象或概率分布，为非线性动力系统提供了线性描述。在再生核希尔伯特空间中，这些算子通过条件均值嵌入进行表示，其正则化估计器与高斯过程回归的后验均值相吻合。基于这种对应关系，我们提出了高斯过程动态模态分解（Gaussian Process Dynamic Mode Decomposition），这是一种结合了稀疏变分高斯过程与基于核的Koopman和Perron-Frobenius算子近似的贝叶斯转移算子方法。由此产生的框架为预测和谱分析的不确定性量化、可扩展的稀疏近似以及数据自适应的字典学习提供了有原则的途径。此外，模型选择公式自然地产生了前向-后向算子结构，建立了贝叶斯转移算子学习与时滞典型相关分析之间的联系。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为高斯过程动态模态分解（GPDMD）的贝叶斯转移算子方法。通过结合稀疏变分高斯过程与核基Koopman和Perron-Frobenius算子近似，该方法在再生核希尔伯特空间中实现了非线性动力系统的高效预测、谱分析以及系统的不确定性量化。
AI.keywords: 转移算子, 再生核希尔伯特空间, 高斯过程, 动力系统, 不确定性量化
AI.comments: 该论文将贝叶斯非参数统计与算子理论（Koopman与Perron-Frobenius算子）相结合，通过高斯过程回归建立了转移算子估计的概率框架，在动力系统的不确定性量化和可扩展性上具有重要创新意义。

title: Graph Your Own Prompt
comments: NeurIPS 2025 (Author-corrected version: Revised by the original authors, October 2026)
summary: We propose Graph Consistency Regularization (GCR), a novel framework that injects relational graph structures, derived from model predictions, into the learning process to promote class-aware, semantically meaningful feature representations. Functioning as a form of self-prompting, GCR enables the model to refine its internal structure using its own outputs. While deep networks learn rich representations, these often capture noisy inter-class similarities that contradict the model's predicted semantics. GCR addresses this issue by introducing parameter-free Graph Consistency Layers (GCLs) at arbitrary depths. Each GCL builds a batch-level feature similarity graph and aligns it with a global, class-aware masked prediction graph, derived by modulating softmax prediction similarities with intra-class indicators. This alignment enforces that feature-level relationships reflect class-consistent prediction behavior, acting as a semantic regularizer throughout the network. Unlike prior work, GCR introduces a multi-layer, cross-space graph alignment mechanism with adaptive weighting, where layer importance is learned from graph discrepancy magnitudes. This allows the model to prioritize semantically reliable layers and suppress noisy ones, enhancing feature quality without modifying the architecture or training procedure. GCR is model-agnostic, lightweight, and improves semantic structure across various networks and datasets. Experiments show that GCR promotes cleaner feature structure, stronger intra-class cohesion, and improved generalization, offering a new perspective on learning from prediction structure. [Project website](https://darcyddx.github.io/gcr/) [Code](https://github.com/Darcyddx/graph-prompt)

AI.title_translation: 图解你的提示词
AI.tldr: 本文提出图一致性正则化（GCR）框架，通过将模型自身的预测结构转化为图并进行多层对齐，优化特征表示并提高模型的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 深度网络在学习丰富表示时，往往会捕捉到与模型预测语义相矛盾的噪声类间相似度，为此需要一种能够利用模型自身输出优化内部结构并促进类感知、语义有意义的特征表示的方法。
AI.method: 提出图一致性正则化（GCR）框架，并在任意深度引入参数化的图一致性层（GCL）。GCL构建批处理级别的特征相似度图，并将其与通过softmax预测相似度与类内指示器调制得到的全局类感知掩码预测图进行对齐，同时引入基于图差异幅度的自适应加权机制。
AI.result: 实验表明，GCR能够促进更干净的特征结构、更强的类内凝聚力并提高泛化能力，适用于各种网络和数据集。
AI.conclusion: GCR框架通过多层跨空间图对齐机制成功优化了深度网络的特征表示，促进了更干净的特征结构、更强的类内凝聚力以及更好的泛化能力，且无需修改基础架构或训练流程。
AI.translation: 我们提出了图一致性正则化（GCR）框架，该框架将源自模型预测的关系图结构注入到学习过程中，以促进具有类感知、语义上有意义的特征表示。作为一种自我提示的形式，GCR使模型能够使用其自身的输出精炼其内部结构。虽然深层网络学习到了丰富的表示，但这些表示通常捕获了与模型预测的语义相矛盾的噪声类间相似度。GCR通过在任意深度引入无参数的图一致性层（GCLs）来解决这个问题。每个GCL构建一个批次级别的特征相似度图，并将其与全局的、类感知的掩码预测图进行对齐，后者是通过用类内指示器调制softmax预测相似度得到的。这种对齐强制特征级别的关系反映类一致的预测行为，在整个网络中充当语义正则化器。与以往的工作不同，GCR引入了一种具有自适应加权的、多层的、跨空间的图对齐机制，其中层的重要性是从图差异幅度中学习得出的。这使得模型能够优先处理语义可靠的层并抑制噪声层，在不修改架构或训练过程的情况下增强特征质量。GCR是模型无关的、轻量级的，并且改善了各种网络和数据集的语义结构。实验表明，GCR促进了更干净的特征结构、更强的类内凝聚力以及改进的泛化能力，为从预测结构中学习提供了一个新的视角。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了图一致性正则化（GCR）框架，通过自提示机制将模型预测导出的关系图结构注入学习过程。GCR利用参数化的图一致性层在不同深度对齐特征相似度图与全局类感知预测图，并采用自适应加权机制优先处理语义可靠的层，从而在不修改网络架构的情况下提升特征质量和模型泛化能力。
AI.keywords: Graph Consistency Regularization, Self-Prompting, Feature Representation, Graph Alignment
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的图一致性正则化（GCR）框架，通过引入自提示机制，将模型预测的图结构注入学习过程中，从而增强特征表示的语义一致性和类内凝聚力。这种方法模型无关且轻量级，为利用预测结构进行深度学习优化提供了一个有前景的新视角。

title: A Stochastic Framework for Continuous-Time State Estimation of Continuum Robots
comments: 20 pages, 15 figures. Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics. Notable changes from v1 include switching to a GTSAM back-end, adjusting the spatial factor definition, and the inclusion of a sensitivity study
summary: State estimation techniques for continuum robots (CRs) typically involve using computationally complex dynamic models, simplistic shape approximations, or are limited to quasi-static methods. These approaches can be sensitive to unmodeled disturbances acting on the robot. Inspired by a factor-graph optimization paradigm, this work introduces a continuous-time stochastic state estimation framework for continuum robots. We introduce factors based on continuous-time kinematics that are corrupted by a white noise Gaussian process (GP). By using a simple robot model paired with high-rate sensing, we show adaptability to unmodeled external forces and data dropout. The result contains an estimate of the mean and covariance for the robot's pose, velocity, and strain, each of which can be interpolated continuously in both space and time. This same interpolation scheme can be used during estimation, allowing for inclusion of measurements that are asynchronous to the estimated states. Our method's inherent sparsity leads to a linear solve complexity with respect to time and interpolation queries in constant time. We demonstrate our method on a CR with gyroscope and pose sensors, highlighting its versatility in real-world systems.

AI.title_translation: 连续体机器人连续时间状态估计的随机框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因子图优化的连续体机器人连续时间随机状态估计框架，通过高斯过程建模实现高效、鲁棒的时空连续状态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有的连续体机器人状态估计技术通常依赖计算复杂的动态模型、过于简化的形状近似，或局限于准静态方法，对机器人受到的未建模扰动较为敏感。为了克服这些局限，需要一种更具鲁棒性、适应性和计算效率的连续时间估计框架。
AI.method: 引入基于因子图优化的连续时间随机状态估计框架，结合受白噪声高斯过程（GP）影响的连续时间运动学因子，采用简单机器人模型配合高频传感，支持时空连续插值与异步测量。
AI.result: 实现了对机器人位姿、速度和应变的均值与协方差估计，且支持在空间和时间上的连续插值；能够适应未建模的外力及数据丢失；由于方法固有的稀疏性，时间求解复杂度呈线性，插值查询为常数时间，并在配备陀螺仪和位姿传感器的真实连续体机器人上验证了其通用性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功开发并验证了一个用于连续体机器人的连续时间随机状态估计框架，通过因子图优化和高斯过程噪声建模，实现了对机器人位姿、速度和应变的高效、鲁棒估计，并支持时空连续插值和异步测量。
AI.translation: 连续体机器人的状态估计技术通常涉及使用计算复杂的动态模型、简化的形状近似，或者局限于准静态方法。这些方法对作用于机器人的未建模扰动非常敏感。受因子图优化范式的启发，本工作为连续体机器人引入了一种连续时间随机状态估计框架。我们引入了基于连续时间运动学的因子，这些运动学受到白噪声高斯过程（GP）的污染。通过将简单的机器人模型与高速率传感配对，我们展示了对未建模外力和数据丢失的适应性。结果包含了对机器人位姿、速度和应变的均值和协方差的估计，其中每一个都可以在空间和时间上连续插值。相同的插值方案可以在估计过程中使用，从而允许包含与估计状态异步的测量。我们方法固有的稀疏性导致了关于时间的线性求解复杂度和常数时间的插值查询。我们在配备了陀螺仪和位姿传感器的连续体机器人上展示了我们的方法，突出了其在真实世界系统中的多功能性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对连续体机器人的连续时间随机状态估计框架，灵感源于因子图优化。通过引入受高斯过程噪声影响的连续时间运动学因子，并结合简单模型与高频传感，该方法能够估计位姿、速度和应变的均值与协方差，支持时空连续插值及异步测量融合，具有线性时间求解复杂度和对未建模外力的适应性。
AI.keywords: 连续体机器人, 状态估计, 连续时间, 因子图优化, 高斯过程
AI.comments: 本文创新性地引入了基于因子图优化的连续时间随机状态估计框架，结合连续时间运动学、高频传感和高斯过程，解决了传统连续时间连续体机器人状态估计中计算复杂度高、对未建模扰动敏感的问题。其最大的亮点在于实现了时空连续插值、异步测量融合以及随时间呈线性的计算复杂度，对真实世界的连续体机器人系统具有很高的实用价值。

title: Simultaneous Learning and Optimization via Misspecified Saddle Point Problems
comments: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Computational Optimization and Algorithms
summary: We study a class of misspecified saddle point (SP) problems, where the optimization objective depends on an unknown parameter that must be learned concurrently from data. Unlike existing studies that assume parameters are fully known or pre-estimated, our framework integrates optimization and learning into a unified formulation, enabling a more flexible problem class. To address this setting, we propose two algorithms based on the accelerated primal-dual (APD) by Hamedani & Aybat 2021. In particular, we first analyze the naive extension of the APD method by directly substituting the evolving parameter estimates into the primal-dual updates; then, we design a new learning-aware variant of the APD method that explicitly accounts for parameter dynamics by adjusting the momentum updates. Both methods achieve a provable convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(\log K / K)$, while the learning-aware approach attains a tighter $\mathcal{O}(1)$ constant and further benefits from an adaptive step-size selection enabled by a backtracking strategy. Furthermore, we extend the framework to problems where the learning problem admits multiple optimal solutions, showing that our modified algorithm for a structured setting achieves an $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{K})$ rate. To demonstrate practical impact, we evaluate our methods on a misspecified portfolio optimization problem and show superior empirical performance compared to state-of-the-art algorithms.
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Computational Optimization and Algorithms

AI.title_translation: 通过错误设定的鞍点问题实现同时学习与优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一学习与优化的错误设定鞍点问题框架，并设计了新型加速原始-对偶算法，实现了有理论保证的收敛率和优秀的实证表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的研究通常假设参数是完全已知或预先估计的，无法适应许多优化目标依赖于必须从数据中并发学习的未知参数的实际场景，因此需要一个将优化和学习统一起来的框架。
AI.method: 提出了两种基于加速原始-对偶（APD）方法的算法：一种是直接替换参数估计的朴素扩展，另一种是考虑参数动态调整动量更新的学习感知型APD变体；并针对多最优解情况设计了修正算法。
AI.result: 两种方法都实现了 $\mathcal{O}(\log K / K)$ 的可证明收敛率，其中学习感知方法达到了更紧密的 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 常数，并支持回溯策略下的自适应步长选择；在多最优解的结构化设置中实现了 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{K})$ 的收敛率；在错误设定的投资组合优化问题中表现出优于现有最先进算法的经验性能。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功提出了一种集成学习与优化的错误设定鞍点问题框架及相应算法，理论上证明了收敛速率，并通过投资组合优化实验验证了其优越性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一类错误设定的鞍点（SP）问题，其中优化目标依赖于必须从数据中并发学习的未知参数。与现有假设参数完全已知或预先估计的研究不同，我们的框架将优化和学习集成到一个统一的公式中，从而实现了更灵活的问题类别。为了解决这一设定，我们提出了两种基于 Hamedani & Aybat 2021 的加速原始-对偶（APD）算法。具体而言，我们首先分析了通过将不断演变的参数估计直接代入原始-对偶更新中对 APD 方法的朴素扩展；然后，我们设计了一种新的学习感知的 APD 方法变体，通过调整动量更新显式地考虑参数动态。这两种方法都实现了 $\mathcal{O}(\log K / K)$ 的可证明收敛率，而学习感知方法获得了更紧密的 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 常数，并进一步受益于由回溯策略实现的自适应步长选择。此外，我们将该框架扩展到学习问题承认多个最优解的问题，表明我们针对结构化设置修改后的算法实现了 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{K})$ 的收敛率。为了证明实际影响，我们在一个错误设定的投资组合优化问题上评估了我们的方法，并展示了相比于最先进算法更优的经验性能。
AI.summary: 本文研究了一类错误设定的鞍点问题，其中优化目标依赖于从数据中并发学习的未知参数。作者提出了两种基于加速原始-对偶（APD）的算法，实现了理论上的收敛率保证，并在投资组合优化问题上验证了其卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 鞍点问题, 机器学习, 优化, 加速原始-对偶算法, 动态参数估计

title: BigCodeArena: Unveiling More Reliable Human Preferences in Code Generation via Execution
comments: Built with love by the BigCode community :)
summary: Crowdsourced model evaluation platforms, such as Chatbot Arena, enable real-time evaluation from human perspectives to assess the quality of model responses. In the coding domain, manually examining the quality of LLM-generated content is extremely challenging, as it requires understanding long chunks of raw code and deliberately simulating code execution. To this end, we introduce BigCodeArena, an open human evaluation platform for code generation backed by a comprehensive and on-the-fly execution environment. Built on top of Chatbot Arena, BigCodeArena enables the execution of LLM-generated code and allows humans to interact with the execution process and outcomes. We collected over 14,000 raw code-centric conversation sessions across 10 widely used LLMs, spanning 10 languages and 8 types of execution environments. Among these conversations, we identified more than 4,700 multi-turn samples with pairwise human preferences. Further analysis uncovers underexplored preferences of LLMs in fine-grained domains characterized by tasks, languages, and frameworks. To systematically examine code understanding and generation capabilities of frontier LLMs, we curated two benchmarks based on the collected data, namely BigCodeReward and AutoCodeArena. For BigCodeReward, we post-processed the 4,700 conversations and evaluated the consistency between reward models and human preferences. The evaluation shows that most LLMs have superior performance in judging coding preferences when the execution results are available. Inspired by these findings, we propose AutoCodeArena, an automatic Elo rating benchmark designed to assess the coding quality of LLMs without human involvement. We find that proprietary LLMs like GPT-5, Claude-Sonnet-4, and Claude-Opus-4 still lead in code generation performance among recent emerging models.

title: Adversarial Attacks on Downstream Weather Forecasting Models: Application to Tropical Cyclone Trajectory Prediction
comments: Compared with the previous version, we (a) extend the downstream attack to an end-to-end attack; (b) further analyze physical feasibility and attack difficulty; and (c) develop a defense mechanism
summary: Deep learning-based weather forecasting (DLWF) models leverage past weather observations to generate future forecasts, supporting a wide range of downstream applications, including tropical cyclone (TC) prediction. In this paper, we investigate the vulnerability of these models to adversarial attacks, where subtle perturbations to upstream forecasts can alter downstream TC trajectory predictions. Crafting perturbed inputs to steer downstream outputs toward attacker-specified trajectories is a challenging problem for several reasons. First, conventional TC detection systems are opaque, non-differentiable black boxes, making standard gradient-based attacks infeasible. Second, the extreme rarity of TC events leads to a severe class imbalance problem, making it difficult to develop attack methods that produce realistic-looking cyclone paths aligned with target trajectories. To overcome these limitations, we propose Cyc-Attack, a novel method for perturbing the forecasts of DLWF models to generate adversarial trajectories. The proposed method uses a differentiable surrogate model to approximate the TC detector's output, enabling the application of gradient-based attacks. Cyc-Attack also employs a skewness-aware loss function with a kernel dilation strategy to address the severe class imbalance problem. Distance-based gradient weighting and regularization strategies are also introduced to constrain perturbations to eliminate unrealistic-looking TC paths. Our experiments show that Cyc-Attack achieves a higher true positive rate in matching the target trajectories, along with lower false alarm rates and stealthier perturbations than conventional attack methods. We further demonstrate that the adversarial upstream forecasts generated by Cyc-Attack can be leveraged as initial guidance to train an end-to-end model for learning adversarial input samples that would induce target trajectories.

title: HackWorld: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Exploiting Web Application Vulnerabilities
summary: Web applications are prime targets for cyberattacks as gateways to critical services and sensitive data. Traditional penetration testing is costly and expertise-intensive, making it difficult to scale with the growing web ecosystem. While language model agents show promise in cybersecurity, modern web applications demand visual understanding, dynamic content handling, and multi-step interactions that only computer-use agents (CUAs) can perform. Yet, their ability to discover and exploit vulnerabilities through graphical interfaces remains largely unexplored. We present HackWorld, the first framework for systematically evaluating CUAs' capabilities to exploit web application vulnerabilities via visual interaction. Unlike sanitized benchmarks, HackWorld includes 36 real-world applications across 11 frameworks and 7 languages, featuring realistic flaws such as injection vulnerabilities, authentication bypasses, and unsafe input handling. Using a Capture-the-Flag (CTF) setup, it tests CUAs' capacity to identify and exploit these weaknesses while navigating complex web interfaces. Evaluation of state-of-the-art CUAs reveals concerning trends: exploitation rates below 12% and low cybersecurity awareness. CUAs often fail at multi-step attack planning and misuse security tools. These results expose the current limitations of CUAs in web security contexts and highlight opportunities for developing more security-aware agents capable of effective vulnerability detection and exploitation.

title: STITCHER: Constrained Trajectory Planning in Complex Environments with Real-Time Motion Primitive Search
summary: Autonomous high-speed navigation through large, complex environments requires real-time generation of agile trajectories that are dynamically feasible, collision-free, and satisfy state or actuator constraints. Modern trajectory planning techniques primarily use numerical optimization, as they enable the systematic computation of high-quality, expressive trajectories that satisfy various constraints. However, stringent requirements on computation time and the risk of numerical instability can limit the use of optimization-based planners in safety-critical scenarios. This work presents an optimization-free planning framework called STITCHER that stitches short trajectory segments together with graph search to compute long-range, expressive, and near-optimal trajectories in real-time. STITCHER outperforms modern optimization-based planners through our innovative planning architecture and several algorithmic developments that make real-time planning possible. Extensive simulation testing is performed to analyze the algorithmic components that make up STITCHER, along with a thorough comparison with three state-of-the-art optimization planners. Simulation tests show that safe trajectories can be created within a few milliseconds for paths that span the entirety of two 50 m x 50 m environments. Hardware tests with a custom quadrotor verify that STITCHER can produce trackable paths in real-time while respecting nonconvex constraints, such as limits on tilt angle and motor forces, with flight speeds up to 63 km/h.

title: Click, Predict, Trust: Clinician-Guided and Clinician-Evaluated AI Segmentation for Lung Cancer CT-Based Prognosis within the Knowledge-to-Action Framework
summary: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer mortality, with CT imaging central to screening, prognosis, and treatment. Manual segmentation is variable and time-intensive, while deep learning (DL) offers automation but faces barriers to clinical adoption. Guided by the Knowledge-to-Action framework, this study develops a clinician-in-the-loop DL pipeline to enhance reproducibility, prognostic accuracy, and clinical trust. Multi-center CT data from 999 patients across 12 public datasets were analyzed using five DL models (3D Attention U-Net, ResUNet, VNet, ReconNet, SAM-Med3D), benchmarked against expert contours on whole and click-point cropped images. Segmentation reproducibility was assessed using 497 PySERA-extracted radiomic features via Spearman correlation, ICC, Wilcoxon tests, and MANOVA, while prognostic modeling compared supervised (SL) and semi-supervised learning (SSL) across 38 dimensionality reduction strategies and 24 classifiers. Six physicians qualitatively evaluated masks across seven domains, including clinical meaningfulness, boundary quality, prognostic value, trust, and workflow integration. VNet achieved the best performance (Dice = 0.83, IoU = 0.71), radiomic stability (mean correlation = 0.76, ICC = 0.65), and predictive accuracy under SSL (accuracy = 0.88, F1 = 0.83). SSL consistently outperformed SL across models. Radiologists favored VNet for peritumoral representation and smoother boundaries, preferring AI-generated initial masks for refinement rather than replacement. These results demonstrate that integrating VNet with SSL yields accurate, reproducible, and clinically trusted CT-based lung cancer prognosis, highlighting a feasible path toward physician-centered AI translation.

title: Investigating LLM Capabilities on Long Context Comprehension for Clinical Question Answering
summary: Despite the impressive reported performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on medical Question-Answering (QA), evaluation still overrelies on multiple-choice and extractive settings primarily assessing textbook knowledge, with limited work on open-ended QA over patient records. We present a comprehensive study investigating LLM long-context (LC) comprehension on longitudinal, patient-centric Electronic Health Records (EHRs) across multiple datasets, models and metrics, covering extractive, multiple-choice, and open-ended generative QA under different context formulation and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) settings. We show that medically fine-tuned models offer no measurable benefit over base counterparts, smaller models exhibit stronger memorization, and longitudinal supplementary notes aid generative QA. Reasoning models gain on complex multi-note QA under LLM Correctness but not stricter reference-aligned metrics, while hybrid RAG with reranking outperforms Full-Context (FC) prompting. A question-category analysis and multi-faceted metric evaluation further reveal where RAG and FC excel and struggle, with RAG falling behind in longitudinal reasoning, thus uncovering systematic failures pointing to the need for reasoning-appropriate metrics.

title: Interpret Policies in Deep Reinforcement Learning using SILVER with RL-Guided Labeling: A Model-level Approach to High-dimensional and Multi-action Environments
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) achieves remarkable performance but lacks interpretability, limiting trust in policy behavior. The existing SILVER framework (Li, Siddique, and Cao 2025) explains RL policy via Shapley-based regression but remains restricted to low-dimensional, binary-action domains. We propose SILVER with RL-guided labeling, an enhanced variant that extends SILVER to multi-action and high-dimensional environments by incorporating the RL policy's own action outputs into the boundary points identification. Our method first extracts compact feature representations from image observations, performs SHAP-based feature attribution, and then employs RL-guided labeling to generate behaviorally consistent boundary datasets. Surrogate models, such as decision trees and regression-based functions, are subsequently trained to interpret RL policy's decision structure. We evaluate the proposed framework on two Atari environments using three deep RL algorithms and conduct human-subject study to assess the clarity and trustworthiness of the derived interpretable policy. Results show that our approach maintains competitive task performance while substantially improving transparency and human understanding of agent behavior. This work advances explainable RL by transforming SILVER into a scalable and behavior-aware framework for interpreting deep RL agents in high-dimensional, multi-action settings.

title: CS-54k: A Paper-Grounded Corpus and Benchmark for AI Research QA
comments: Code at https://github.com/wph6/ResearchGPT and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wph6/CS-54k
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to support computer science research. To contribute reliably, these systems must be able to work with information distributed across research papers and across different aspects of the research process. However, large-scale resources that systematically organize such information into structured supervision for both model evaluation and post-training remain limited. To address this gap, we propose a systematic paper-to-QA construction pipeline that organizes information from AI research papers into structured QA pairs supported by source evidence. Using this pipeline, we construct CS-54k, a 54k-pair corpus derived from 14,474 openly licensed AI research papers. The corpus covers eight recurring paper components, including research domain, prior work, existing challenges, motivation, findings and assumptions, methods, experimental settings, and experimental results. We further derive two complementary subsets: CS-4k, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on paper-derived research QA, and CS-50k, a companion corpus for post-training. Extensive evaluations on CS-4k reveal substantial performance differences across existing LLMs and paper components, with experimental settings and results remaining particularly challenging. Moreover, post-training on CS-50k substantially improves Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on CS-4k, demonstrating the practical utility of structured, paper-derived supervision. Together, CS-4k and CS-50k provide a unified and scalable resource for benchmarking and improving LLMs on research paper question answering.

title: Manifold Approximation leads to Robust Kernel Alignment
summary: Centered kernel alignment (CKA) is a popular metric for comparing representations, determining equivalence of networks, and conducting neuroscience research. However, CKA does not account for the underlying manifold and relies on numerous heuristics that cause it to behave differently at different scales of data. In this work, we propose Manifold-approximated Kernel Alignment (MKA), which incorporates manifold geometry (i.e., local neighborhood) into the alignment task. We derive a theoretical framework for MKA. Our construction removes representation-dependent degree weighting, yields a closed-form alignment score, and gives each row a probabilistic interpretation as a local Markov transition distribution. We further establish kernel- and score-level stability with respect to the neighborhood size. We perform empirical evaluations on synthetic datasets and real-world examples to characterize and compare MKA to its contemporaries. In controlled synthetic experiments, MKA is consistently less sensitive to hyperparameters and captures the selected topology-preserving relationships. On the large-scale benchmark, MKA achieves its strongest aggregate performance in vision, is competitive on graphs, and is weaker than CKA in several NLP evaluations. Our findings suggest that manifold-aware kernel alignment provides a robust foundation for measuring representations and is potentially useful when local neighborhood geometry is important, with possible applications in representation learning.

title: Expert-Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for Stable and Sample-Efficient Control of Dynamical Systems
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) often requires extensive interactions with the environment, which makes the training costly. Additionally, exploration can destabilise the dynamical system, which may be unsafe. On the other hand, offline learning from expert demonstrations avoids unsafe exploration but is limited by the quality and coverage of the offline dataset. In this paper, we propose a model-free RL approach that combines expert demonstrations with limited online interactions. Specifically, we optimise a policy objective consisting of an online performance term and a behavioural cloning regulariser computed from offline expert demonstrations. The regulariser encourages the learned policy to stay close to expert behaviour, reducing the need to explore unfamiliar actions. Expert demonstrations guide policy learning and reduce the need for many online interactions and exploration. For stochastic linear time-invariant (LTI) systems, we establish conditions for linear convergence of exact policy gradient updates and for all intermediate policies to remain stabilising. Although our theoretical analysis focuses on linear systems, we also evaluate the proposed approach on nonlinear systems to demonstrate its effectiveness beyond the linear setting. \rev{Numerical results show that the proposed method reaches comparable performance in fewer gradient steps and with less number of samples than a purely online RL baseline.

title: A GNN-Based Approach for Code Smell Detection and Refactoring Opportunity Identification
comments: We would like to withdraw our manuscript to make further revisions and improvements to its content and experimental analysis. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding
summary: Code smells indicate latent design or implementation problems that may negatively affect software maintainability. Over the past decades, numerous approaches have been proposed for code smell refactoring, including those based on software metrics, predefined rules, machine learning/deep learning (ML/DL), and, more recently, large language models (LLMs). However, traditional metric- and rule-based approaches rely heavily on manually defined criteria, while ML/DL approaches are often constrained by the availability of training data and the design of model architectures. Although LLMs provide advanced code understanding capabilities, they typically incur substantial computational and time costs, particularly when applied to large-scale software systems. In this study, we propose a graph-based deep learning approach for code smell refactoring. Specifically, we construct code graphs at both the class and method levels and employ graph- and node-level classification to detect code smells and identify corresponding refactoring opportunities for three representative code smells: Long Method, Large Class, and Feature Envy. The proposed approach is trained and evaluated using SACS, a large-scale open-source dataset constructed through a semi-automated process. In the experiments, we implement the proposed approach using three representative GNN architectures: GCN, GraphSAGE, and GAT. We further compare its performance with traditional refactoring approaches, an existing deep learning-based approach, and four representative lightweight LLMs. Experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms the compared approaches across all evaluated code smell refactoring tasks, demonstrating that it provides both superior performance and greater efficiency.

title: E0: Expressive Fine-Grained Discrete Action Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models via Tweedie Discrete Diffusion
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a unified framework for robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and control generation. However, existing VLA systems still struggle to generalize across diverse tasks, scenes, and camera viewpoints, and often produce coarse or unstable actions. We argue that these limitations are closely tied to the structural properties of actions in VLA settings, including the inherent multi-peaked nature of action distributions, the token-based symbolic reasoning of pretrained VLM/VLA backbones, and the effective finite resolution imposed by real-world robotic control. Motivated by these properties, we introduce E0, a tweedie discrete diffusion framework that formulates action generation as iterative denoising over quantized action tokens. By operating in a discrete action space with a principled diffusion process, E0 naturally aligns with token-based reasoning, supports fine-grained yet executable action control, and avoids the distributional mismatch of masking-based discrete diffusion. Experiments on LIBERO, VLABench, ManiSkill, and a real-world Franka arm demonstrate that E0 achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse environments, outperforming strong baselines by 8.1% on average.
