title: BBOWP-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Black-Box Optimization Word Problems
summary: Formulating an optimization problem strongly affects final solution quality, yet good formulations usually require substantial expertise. Recent studies have explored automatically deriving optimization problems from natural-language descriptions, but existing benchmarks focus on settings where objectives and constraints can be written explicitly as mathematical expressions. Many practically important problems are naturally treated as black-box optimization (BBO) problems, in which only objective values are observable, and the functional form is unavailable. In BBO, search space design (as part of problem formulation) and optimization algorithm selection are crucial for problem-solving. Automating these processes with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. We introduce Black-Box Optimization Word Problems (BBOWP), a novel problem setting in which a system must infer both a search space and an optimization algorithm from a natural-language description of a black-box optimization task. To support research on this setting, we establish the BBOWP Benchmark Suite (BBOWP-Bench), a dataset and evaluation framework for BBOWP. Each instance combines a natural-language problem description, an executable evaluation environment, and a human-designed reference formulation, allowing evaluation of both search-space design and algorithm selection. Using this benchmark, we evaluate LLMs on the joint formulation of search spaces and optimizers from natural-language descriptions across multiple BBO domains. We show that current LLMs vary their optimizer choice with the evaluation budget, though they sometimes struggle with search space design, particularly in identifying important variables and balancing their ranges when the problem description is less informative or the search space is highly problem-specific. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/shiralab/bbowp-bench.

AI.title_translation: BBOWP-Bench：评估大语言模型在黑盒优化应用题上的表现
AI.tldr: 本文提出了BBOWP-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型从自然语言描述中同时推导黑盒优化搜索空间与选择优化算法的能力。
AI.motivation: 优化问题的形式化（设计）严重依赖专家经验，现存的大模型自动建模基准主要集中在目标函数和约束可明确写为数学表达式的白盒场景。而现实中大量关键问题属于黑盒优化，无法获取解析形式，必须通过设计搜索空间和挑选优化算法来求解，目前尚缺乏评估LLM在此类黑盒优化问题自动化处理能力的基准。
AI.method: 提出了“黑盒优化应用题”（BBOWP）新任务设定，并构建了基准测试套件BBOWP-Bench。每个实例均包含自然语言问题描述、可执行评估环境以及人类专家设计的参考方案，用于跨多个BBO领域系统评估LLM联合推导搜索空间和选择优化算法的能力。
AI.result: 评测结果显示，当前的LLM能够根据给定的评估预算动态调整优化算法的选择；但它们在搜索空间设计上经常遇到困难，特别是在问题描述信息较少或搜索空间高度依赖具体领域时，难以准确识别重要变量并平衡其取值范围。
AI.conclusion: BBOWP-Bench为评估LLM在黑盒优化应用题中的建模能力提供了首个基准。研究表明，尽管当前LLM能够根据评估预算调整优化器选择，但在精确设计搜索空间（尤其是识别关键变量和设定合理范围）方面仍面临显著挑战。
AI.translation: 构建优化问题对最终解的质量有重大影响，但良好的问题形式化通常需要深厚的专业知识。近期的研究探索了如何从自然语言描述中自动推导优化问题，但现有基准主要侧重于目标和约束可以明确写为数学表达式的场景。在实际中，许多重要问题更自然地被视为黑盒优化（BBO）问题，在这类问题中只能观测到目标值，函数表达式不可知。在BBO中，搜索空间设计（作为问题形式化的一部分）和优化算法选择对于问题求解至关重要，利用大语言模型（LLM）实现这些过程的自动化仍极具挑战。我们引入了黑盒优化应用题（BBOWP）这一新设定，要求系统从黑盒优化任务的自然语言描述中同时推断出搜索空间和优化算法。为支持该设定的研究，我们建立了BBOWP基准测试套件（BBOWP-Bench），包括相应的数据集和评估框架。每个实例均结合了自然语言问题描述、可执行评估环境和人类设计的参考形式，可同时评估搜索空间设计与算法选择。利用该基准，我们在多个BBO领域中评估了LLM从自然语言描述中联合构建搜索空间和优化器的能力。结果表明，当前LLM会随评估预算改变其优化器选择，但在搜索空间设计上常常表现不佳，特别是在问题描述信息较少或搜索空间高度针对特定问题时，难以有效识别重要变量并权衡其范围。我们的代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/shiralab/bbowp-bench 获取。
AI.summary: 本研究针对实际中普遍存在的黑盒优化问题，提出了BBOWP任务及相应的评估基准BBOWP-Bench，用于测试大语言模型能否仅通过自然语言描述来设计搜索空间并选择合适的优化器。实验发现，LLM虽具备一定的算法选择适应性，但在特定或低信息量问题中进行搜索空间设计仍存在明显短板。
AI.keywords: 黑盒优化, 大语言模型, 搜索空间设计, 基准测试, 算法选择
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型在优化问题上的应用从传统的显式数学建模（白盒优化）拓展到了实际应用更广泛的黑盒优化（BBO）领域，构建了首个涵盖自然语言描述、可执行评估环境及人类参考基准的数据集。其重要意义在于指出了LLM在面对复杂实际工程问题时不仅要选算法，更核心的难点在于搜索空间设计的定义与平衡。局限性在于当前评估主要依赖问题描述的信息量，对于高度专业化或信息匮乏场景下的LLM表现仍有较大局限。

title: A constrained Onsager variational framework for parametric approximations of Willmore and Helfrich flows
summary: We develop a constrained Onsager variational framework for parametric finite element approximations of Willmore and Helfrich flows. The weak curvature relation is used as a PDE constraint to express the first variation of the bending energy in curvature-vector form. Onsager's principle then combines this variation with dissipation based on the normal velocity, while an independent relaxed minimal-deformation-rate (relaxed-MDR) constraint selects the tangential velocity. The resulting mixed formulation admits a semidiscretization by continuous piecewise linear elements that satisfies an exact energy-dissipation law and exactly preserves area and volume when the corresponding constraints are imposed. The framework accommodates constant spontaneous curvature and applies to both closed surfaces and open surfaces with fixed boundaries under Navier or clamped conditions. We also propose a linearly implicit fully discrete scheme, prove its unique solvability, and present numerical experiments demonstrating convergence, energy decay, constraint preservation, and effective mesh redistribution.

AI.title_translation: Willmore 流和 Helfrich 流参数化逼近的约束 Onsager 变分框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于 Willmore 和 Helfrich 流的约束 Onsager 变分有限元框架，可严格保持能量耗散和几何守恒，并通过切向速度控制实现优良的网格重分布。
AI.motivation: 为带有或不带有自发曲率的 Willmore 和 Helfrich 流构建一种既能保证几何守恒（面积、体积）与能量耗散，又能有效控制网格质量的参数有限元近似方法。
AI.method: 利用弱曲率关系作为 PDE 约束将弯曲能一阶变分表示为曲率向量形式；基于 Onsager 原理结合法向速度耗散，并引入独立的松弛最小变形率（relaxed-MDR）约束以确定切向速度；采用连续分段线性元进行半离散，并构造线性隐式全离散格式。
AI.result: 半离散格式满足精确能量耗散并在施加约束时严格守恒面积和体积；理论证明了线性隐式全离散格式的唯一可解性；数值实验证实了算法的收敛性、能量衰减性质、约束保持能力以及网格的有效重分布。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不仅适用于闭曲面和带 Navier 或夹紧边界条件的开曲面，还能处理常自发曲率情形，为 Willmore 和 Helfrich 流提供了一种保结构且网格性质优良的高效参数有限元逼近手段。
AI.translation: 我们开发了一个约束 Onsager 变分框架，用于 Willmore 流和 Helfrich 流的参数有限元逼近。弱曲率关系被用作 PDE 约束，从而将弯曲能量的一阶变分表示为曲率向量形式。随后，Onsager 原理将该变分与基于法向速度的耗散相结合，同时通过一个独立的松弛最小变形率（relaxed-MDR）约束来选取切向速度。由此得到的混合形式允许使用连续分段线性单元进行半离散化，该离散化满足精确的能量耗散律，并在施加相应约束时精确保持面积和体积。该框架适用于常自发曲率，且可应用于闭曲面以及在 Navier 或夹紧条件下具有固定边界的开曲面。我们还提出了一种线性隐式全离散格式，证明了其唯一可解性，并给出了数值实验以展示收敛性、能量衰减、约束保持以及有效的网格重分布效果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于 Willmore 和 Helfrich 流参数有限元近似的约束 Onsager 变分框架。该方法利用弱曲率 PDE 约束表达能量变分，通过 Onsager 原理与松弛最小变形率约束协同确定法向与切向速度，实现了严格的能量耗散与面积、体积守恒，并提供了一种唯一可解的线性隐式全离散格式。
AI.keywords: Onsager 变分框架, Willmore 流, Helfrich 流, 参数有限元, 能量耗散
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将 Onsager 变分原理与切向速度的松弛最小变形率（relaxed-MDR）约束相结合，既在离散层面保证了精确的能量耗散与几何守恒性，又通过切向速度有效控制了网格质量，避免了几何网格畸变这一经典难题。此外，全离散格式为线性隐式且具备唯一可解性，具有很高的数值计算价值。

title: Hallucination-Free GUI Grounding via Regression-Free Layout-Aware Matching
summary: GUI agents are shifting from metadata-dependent large language models to purely visual multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that operate directly on screenshots. The core task, GUI grounding, requires translating abstract user instructions into precise element coordinates. This task faces a persistent dual obstacle: conventional grounding models lack the semantic richness to interpret abstract instructions, while end-to-end MLLMs suffer from coordinate hallucinations caused by deficient fine-grained perception. We propose a regression-free framework where a frozen MLLM performs instruction parsing and a dedicated grounding model handles precise localization without learning any coordinate regression. A frozen MLLM first elaborates the abstract instruction into a structured visual description rich in layout cues. These descriptions are then fed to a novel Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model, which performs regression-free localization by matching against layout-prior candidates, inherently suppressing hallucinations and avoiding expensive fine-tuning. The grounding model is trained with only Text/Icon binary labels, requiring no coordinate regression parameters. On ScreenSpot-Pro, our method achieves over 20% improvement in grounding accuracy over end-to-end systems; on Mind2Web, it raises success rate and element selection rate by more than 15%. These results demonstrate that decoupling instruction understanding from layout-aware localization effectively resolves the core challenges of GUI interaction.

AI.title_translation: 基于无回归布局感知匹配的无幻觉GUI定位
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解耦的GUI定位框架，利用冻结MLLM解析指令并结合无坐标回归的布局匹配模型，有效消除了坐标幻觉并显著提升了定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的纯视觉GUI定位面临双重困境：传统定位模型语义理解能力有限，难以解析抽象指令；而端到端多模态大语言模型（MLLM）因细粒度空间感知能力不足，极易产生严重的坐标幻觉。
AI.method: 提出一种无回归解耦框架：利用冻结的MLLM将抽象用户指令解析为包含丰富布局线索的结构化视觉描述；随后由专用的布局感知GUI定位模型将描述与布局先验候选进行匹配实现精确定位。该定位模型仅使用文本/图标二元标签训练，完全无需学习坐标回归参数。
AI.result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro基准上，该方法相比端到端系统的定位准确率提升了20%以上；在Mind2Web基准上，成功率和元素选择率均提升了15%以上。
AI.conclusion: 将指令理解与布局感知定位解耦，并采用无回归的匹配机制，能够有效抑制坐标幻觉，显著提升GUI交互定位任务的性能。
AI.translation: GUI智能体正从依赖元数据的大语言模型转向直接在屏幕截图上操作的纯视觉多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。其核心任务GUI定位需要将抽象的用户指令转化为精确的元素坐标。该任务面临双重障碍：传统定位模型缺乏解释抽象指令的语义丰富性，而端到端MLLM由于细粒度感知能力不足而存在坐标幻觉问题。我们提出了一个无回归框架，由冻结的MLLM执行指令解析，专用的定位模型在无需学习坐标回归的情况下进行精确定位。冻结的MLLM首先将抽象指令细化为富含布局线索的结构化视觉描述；随后将这些描述输入到一个新颖的布局感知GUI定位模型中，该模型通过与布局先验候选进行匹配来执行无回归定位，从而内在地抑制幻觉并避免高昂的微调成本。该定位模型仅使用文本/图标二元标签进行训练，无需坐标回归参数。在ScreenSpot-Pro上，我们的方法比端到端系统的定位准确率提升了20%以上；在Mind2Web上，成功率和元素选择率提升了15%以上。这些结果表明，将指令理解与布局感知定位解耦可以有效解决GUI交互的核心挑战。
AI.summary: 本文针对纯视觉GUI定位中的指令理解与坐标幻觉难题，提出了一种无需坐标回归的布局感知匹配框架。通过冻结的MLLM生成富含布局线索的视觉描述，并结合仅用二元标签训练的匹配模型完成精准定位，在多个基准测试中大幅超越了传统的端到端系统。
AI.keywords: GUI定位, 多模态大语言模型, 幻觉抑制, 布局感知匹配, 无回归框架
AI.comments: 该研究的核心创新在于将端到端MLLM的“坐标回归生成”范式转变为“指令解析+候选匹配”的解耦架构，从根本上规避了MLLM生成连续坐标时的空间幻觉问题；此外，仅需二元标签训练大幅降低了标注与训练成本。潜在的局限性在于该方法可能依赖于高质量的布局候选生成。

title: ReForge: Keeping ABR Algorithms Never Finished with Verified Large Language Model Revisions
summary: Designing an ABR algorithm for a network scenario takes an engineer months, and large language models (LLMs) now do this work in hours. But either way, the algorithm is fixed once it is deployed. It fits the networks seen during its design and falls behind on the networks that arrive afterwards. We ask whether an ABR algorithm can keep being designed after deployment, revised as each new network arrives, without becoming worse on any network it already serves. We propose ReForge, which keeps a pool of existing ABR policies unchanged and lets an LLM revise only the rules that decide which policy chooses the next bitrate. When a new network arrives, the LLM reads how the current rules and every policy perform on the networks served so far and rewrites the rules. The rewrite is deployed only if a replay in simulation shows that it improves the served networks as a whole and makes none of them worse. A fast GPU simulator that replays every episode exactly makes this acceptance test cheap enough to run for every revision. We evaluate ReForge on nine real-world network datasets, with new networks arriving one at a time. The revisions raise the mean QoE from 1.43 to 1.79, past the best single policy at 1.66 and close to the 1.86 of selecting the best policy for each dataset, while the QoE on the networks served first does not drop. The gain also holds in a real video player. All code, data, and records will be available.

AI.title_translation: ReForge：通过经形式化验证的大语言模型修订让ABR算法持续演进
AI.tldr: ReForge利用LLM在部署后持续重写ABR策略选择规则，并借助快速GPU回放验证确保零性能回退，实现了ABR算法的持续演进。
AI.motivation: 传统ABR算法部署后即固定，仅适应设计时见过的网络，在面对未知的新网络时性能落后；需要探究如何在算法部署后持续修订以适应新网络，同时避免在已知网络上发生性能回退（灾难性遗忘）。
AI.method: 提出ReForge框架：保持底层ABR策略池不变，仅由LLM根据新旧网络下的性能反馈重写决定策略选择的顶层规则；利用高速GPU仿真器对历史轨迹进行精确回放作为验收测试，仅当新规则提升整体性能且不使任何已知网络变差时才允许部署。
AI.result: 在9个真实网络数据集的逐个引入评估中，平均QoE从1.43提升至1.79，优于最佳单一策略（1.66），逼近理论选择上限（1.86）；早期服务的网络性能零下降，且增益在真实播放器中依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM动态重写策略选择规则并辅以快速严格的仿真回放验收测试，ABR算法可以在部署后持续安全演进，适应不断变化的网络环境且不产生性能倒退。
AI.translation: 为特定网络场景设计自适应比特率（ABR）算法通常需要工程师数月的时间，而大语言模型（LLM）如今可以在数小时内完成该工作。然而无论采用何种方式，算法一旦部署就固定不变。它仅拟合设计期间见过的网络，而在随后出现的新网络上表现落后。我们探讨ABR算法是否可以在部署后持续被设计，随着每个新网络的到来而修订，且不会降低其已服务过的任何网络上的性能。为此，我们提出了ReForge：它保持现有ABR策略池不变，仅允许LLM修订决定由哪个策略选择下一个比特率的规则。当新网络到来时，LLM读取当前规则和各策略在迄今为止所服务网络上的表现，并重写规则。只有在仿真重放表明该重写能提升整体已服务网络的性能且不使其中任何一个变差时，才会被部署。一个能够精确重放每个回合的高速GPU仿真器，使得这种验收测试足够廉价以支持针对每次修订运行。我们在九个真实网络数据集上对ReForge进行了评估，新网络逐个输入。修订使平均QoE从1.43提升至1.79，超过了最佳单一策略的1.66，接近为每个数据集选择最佳策略的1.86，同时最先服务的网络上的QoE并未下降。这种收益在真实视频播放器中同样保持。所有代码、数据和记录都将开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ReForge，通过固定底层ABR策略池并利用LLM持续重写策略选择规则，结合低开销的GPU仿真精确回放验证，实现了部署后ABR算法在确保无性能回退前提下的持续自适应演进。
AI.keywords: 自适应比特率 (ABR), 大语言模型 (LLM), 体验质量 (QoE), 持续演化, GPU仿真
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地将LLM的代码重写能力与严格的仿真回放验证（GPU仿真）相结合，不仅克服了传统ABR算法部署后静态固化的缺陷，而且通过“整体提升且无单项回退”的硬性验收门槛，有效避免了LLM生成代码带来的不可靠性及灾难性遗忘风险，为网络协议与控制算法的持续演进提供了全新范式。

title: Programmable Distributions of Semantics-Preserving Variants for Evaluating Code Agents
summary: Code agents are increasingly deployed to resolve real software issues, yet their reliability under superficial code variations remains poorly understood. We evaluate whether coding agents that repair repository-level issues remain reliable when the surrounding codebase is rewritten into a semantically equivalent form. We sample semantically equivalent variants of a repository from an explicitly defined distribution and compare the agent's resolve rate on them with that on the original. Different distributions reveal different aspects of an agent, such as its sensitivity to routine refactoring or to misleading code near the location of a fix. We develop VDL, a probabilistic programming language for expressing such distributions, whose programs randomly apply semantics-preserving transformations (SPTs) to a repository. For our evaluation, we use it to define a generic distribution that is not targeted at any particular failure mode. We evaluate two agentic scaffolds (mini-SWE agent and OpenCode), each backed by one of four frontier models (Claude Opus 4.5, Kimi K2.5, MiniMax M2.5, and Qwen 3.6-27B), on instances from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro. Resolve rates drop by up to 6.7 percentage points, significantly in 6 of 16 configurations. No ranking of models by robustness holds across scaffolds, revealing a jagged robustness frontier.

AI.title_translation: 面向评估代码智能体的保持语义不变变体的可编程分布
AI.tldr: 本文提出了概率编程语言VDL用于生成语义等价的代码变体以评估代码智能体，发现表面代码变动可使解决率最高下降6.7个百分点且存在参差不齐的鲁棒性前沿。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体被广泛应用于解决真实软件问题，但其在代码表层发生变异时的可靠性尚不明确，需要评估当周围代码库被重写为语义等价形式时，智能体能否保持修复仓库级问题的可靠性。
AI.method: 开发了名为VDL的概率编程语言，用于表达从代码库随机应用语义保持变换（SPTs）的分布；利用VDL定义不针对特定失效模式的通用分布生成等价代码变体；并在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro基准上，跨2种脚手架和4种前沿模型评估智能体在变体与原代码上的解决率差异。
AI.result: 在语义等价变体上，智能体的解决率最高下降了6.7个百分点，且在16种配置中有6种出现了显著下降；不同脚手架下模型的鲁棒性排名并不一致，展现出参差不齐的鲁棒性前沿。
AI.conclusion: 代码智能体在面临表面语义等价变异时可靠性明显受损，且各模型的鲁棒性表现强依赖于所搭配的智能体脚手架，呈现出不统一的参差鲁棒性前沿。
AI.translation: 代码智能体正越来越多地被部署用于解决现实软件问题，然而它们在表面代码变异下的可靠性仍不为人所熟知。我们评估了修复仓库级问题的编程智能体在周围代码库被重写为语义等价形式时是否依然可靠。我们从显式定义的分布中采样代码库的语义等价变体，并比较智能体在这些变体上的解决率与在原始代码上的解决率。不同的分布揭示了智能体的不同方面，例如其对常规重构或修复位置附近误导性代码的敏感性。我们开发了VDL，一种用于表达此类分布的概率编程语言，其程序可向代码库随机应用保持语义的转换（SPT）。在评估中，我们使用它定义了一个不针对任何特定失效模式的通用分布。我们在来自SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro的实例上，评估了由四种前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.5、Kimi K2.5、MiniMax M2.5和Qwen 3.6-27B）之一支持的两种智能体脚手架（mini-SWE agent和OpenCode）。解决率最高下降了6.7个百分点，在16种配置中有6种出现显著下降。在不同脚手架之间没有始终成立的模型鲁棒性排名，揭示出参差不齐的鲁棒性前沿。
AI.summary: 本文旨在评估代码智能体在代码库被语义等价重写时的可靠性。作者提出了概率编程语言VDL以编程方式对代码库施加语义保持变换，并在SWE-bench系列基准上测试了由不同前沿模型支持的mini-SWE agent和OpenCode脚手架。结果表明表面变体可导致解决率显著降低高达6.7个百分点，且不同脚手架间缺乏一致的模型鲁棒性排名。
AI.keywords: 代码智能体, 语义保持变换, 概率编程语言, 鲁棒性评估, SWE-bench
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了概率编程语言VDL，将语义等价的代码重构转变为可编程、可采样的显式分布，为系统化评估代码智能体在真实仓库级任务下的鲁棒性提供了新方法；同时实验揭示了模型鲁棒性排名随智能体脚手架变化的复杂现象。局限在于摘要中主要展示了一个通用分布的测试结果，更多针对性分布的深入分析未在摘要中展开。

title: Monroe: A Molecular Foundation Model for In-Context Probabilistic Inference
comments: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Bioassay activity prediction is often data-limited because drug-discovery datasets rely on time-consuming and expensive wet-lab experiments for data generation and evaluation. This challenge has inspired recent research into molecular foundation models (MFMs), which aim to encode general-purpose chemical knowledge into molecular representations that generalize well in data-constrained scenarios. This paper presents Monroe, a new MFM with several innovations over the existing state of the art: increased scale allowing pre-training on over 81 million molecules from the PM6 quantum chemistry dataset; improved graph representation of stereochemistry; improved training losses including conformer denoising and embedding decorrelation; improved multi-task learning; and the use of a prior-data-fitted model (TabPFNv3) for downstream in-context prediction. Our evaluations use a principled pairwise comparison framework that measures statistically significant performance differences. Across established Polaris benchmarks, Monroe matches or exceeds existing MFMs, while on activity cliff benchmarks, designed to assess utility for molecular discovery, it achieves significant improvements over prior methods. Finally, ablation and transfer experiments show that PFN-based downstream predictors also substantially improve two leading existing models, MiniMol and CheMeleon, yielding new state-of-the-art variants we call MiniMol_PFN and CheMeleon_PFN, suggesting that our downstream adaptation strategy generalizes beyond Monroe. Source code is at github.com/blazejba/Monroe
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

AI.title_translation: Monroe：用于上下文概率推断的分子基础模型
AI.tldr: Monroe通过超大规模预训练、立体化学表征优化及引入TabPFNv3进行上下文推断，显著提升了数据受限场景与活性悬崖下的分子活性预测性能。
AI.motivation: 药物发现领域的生物测定数据往往严重受限且湿实验成本高昂，亟需能在小样本或数据受限场景下具有高泛化能力的分子基础模型（MFM）。
AI.method: 在包含超8100万分子的PM6量子化学数据集上进行超大规模预训练；改进了立体化学的图表示；优化了包括构象去噪和嵌入去相关在内的训练损失；改进多任务学习机制；并引入TabPFNv3先验数据拟合模型用于下游上下文概率推断。
AI.result: 在Polaris基准上达到或超越现有先进模型；在活性悬崖评估中取得显著突破；基于PFN的下游策略显著增强了MiniMol与CheMeleon，分别打造了新的SOTA变体MiniMol_PFN与CheMeleon_PFN。
AI.conclusion: Monroe在标准基准及具有挑战性的活性悬崖任务中均展现出卓越的泛化能力，且所提出的PFN上下文推断策略具备良好的通用性与迁移性。
AI.translation: 由于药物发现数据集依赖耗时且昂贵的湿实验进行数据生成和评估，生物测定活性预测往往面临数据受限的问题。这一挑战激发了近期对分子基础模型（MFMs）的研究，这类模型旨在将通用化学知识编码成分子表征，以便在数据受限的场景下实现良好的泛化。本文提出了Monroe，一种相比现有最先进技术具有多项创新的新型MFM：更大的规模，支持在来自PM6量子化学数据集的超过8100万个分子上进行预训练；改进的立体化学图表征；改进的训练损失（包括构象去噪和嵌入去相关）；改进的多任务学习；以及使用拟合先验数据的模型（TabPFNv3）进行下游上下文预测。我们的评估采用了原则性的成对比较框架，用于衡量具有统计显著性的性能差异。在已建立的Polaris基准上，Monroe达到或超过了现有的MFM；而在旨在评估分子发现效用的活性悬崖基准上，它比现有方法取得了显著改进。最后，消融和迁移实验表明，基于PFN的下游预测器还大幅提升了两个领先的现有模型MiniMol和CheMeleon，产生了名为MiniMol_PFN和CheMeleon_PFN的全新先进变体，这表明我们的下游适配策略不仅限于Monroe，还具有广泛的泛化性。源代码见 github.com/blazejba/Monroe。
AI.summary: 本文提出了新型分子基础模型Monroe，通过8100万分子规模的量子化学预训练、立体化学图表征改进、去噪损失优化以及引入TabPFNv3进行上下文推断，在常规及活性悬崖分子活性预测基准上均达到了最先进性能，并展现了出色的跨模型下游迁移能力。
AI.keywords: 分子基础模型, 上下文推断, 活性悬崖, 立体化学, 药物发现
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于不仅在规模和构象/立体化学图表征、训练损失函数上对分子基础模型进行了系统升级，更开创性地将基于先验拟合的概率推断模型（TabPFNv3）引入下游上下文学习中。该策略展现了出色的通用性（能赋能其他MFM）。其局限性在于缺乏对模型计算资源消耗和生成式药物设计场景的探讨。

title: The Missing Touch: Sensing and Displaying Localized Contact Geometry Brings Teleoperation Closer to Human Dexterity
summary: A fundamental challenge in robotic teleoperation is enabling an operator to control a remote robot as effortlessly and intuitively as their own hands. Despite the growing use of teleoperation to collect demonstrations for training autonomous robot policies, teleoperated performance still falls significantly short of human dexterity, even for basic tasks. Here, we present evidence that a key factor contributing to this performance gap is the absence of localized tactile feedback. We equip a two-degree-of-freedom (DoF) bilateral force-feedback telemanipulator with a vision-based tactile sensor and a 32-pixel tactile display, allowing us to capture spatial contact patterns on the robot finger and render them on the operator's fingertip. In teleoperated button-discrimination and peg-rolling tasks, we demonstrate that reproducing spatially distributed contact information brings teleoperated movements closer to natural human behavior through fewer unnecessary motions and task completion steps, significantly reducing task completion time and producing more consistent demonstrations across trials and operators. We further show that these improvements in human demonstrations can propagate to autonomous policies: policies trained on tactile-enhanced demonstrations exhibited similar reductions in both task completion time and deviation from natural human behavior. Together, these results establish spatially distributed tactile feedback as an important component of dexterous robotic teleoperation and demonstrate its potential to improve safety-critical teleoperation and enable more humanlike demonstrations for training autonomous robot policies.

AI.title_translation: 缺失的触觉：感知并呈现局部接触几何使遥操作更接近人类的灵巧性
AI.tldr: 通过触觉传感器采集并向操作员指尖显示局部接触几何信息，不仅显著提升了遥操作的速度与灵巧度，还增强了下游自主机器人策略的学习效果。
AI.motivation: 机器人遥操作的表现仍显著落后于人类手的灵巧度，导致用于训练自主机器人策略的示教数据质量受限，其核心缺陷之一是缺乏局部的空间触觉几何反馈。
AI.method: 为双自由度（2-DoF）双边力反馈遥操作系统配备了基于视觉的触觉传感器和32像素的触觉显示器，从而捕获机器人手指上的空间接触形貌并实时渲染在操作员的指尖上。
AI.result: 在按键辨识和滚插销任务中，触觉反馈减少了不必要的动作和操作步骤，显著缩短了任务完成时间，提高了示教一致性；基于增强示教训练的自主策略同样展现出更短的完成时间和更贴近人类自然行为的特性。
AI.conclusion: 空间分布式的触觉反馈是实现灵巧机器人遥操作的关键要素，在提升安全关键型遥操作性能的同时，能为训练自主机器人策略提供更接近人类灵巧水平的高质量示教数据。
AI.translation: 机器人遥操作中的一个核心挑战，是使操作员能够像控制自己的双手一样轻松且直观地控制远程机器人。尽管遥操作已被广泛用于收集示教数据以训练自主机器人策略，但即便是在基础任务中，遥操作的表现依然明显落后于人类的灵巧度。在本文中，我们提出证据表明，导致这一性能差距的关键因素是局部触觉反馈的缺失。我们为一台两自由度（2-DoF）双边力反馈遥操作系统配备了基于视觉的触觉传感器和32像素的触觉显示器，从而能够捕获机器人手指上的空间接触模式，并将其呈现在操作员的指尖上。在遥控按键辨识和滚插销任务中，我们证明了重现空间分布的接触信息能减少不必要的动作和任务完成步骤，使遥操作动作更接近人类自然行为，显著缩短了任务完成时间，并在不同试验和操作员之间产生了更一致的示教数据。我们进一步表明，人类示教中的这些改进可以传递至自主策略：在触觉增强的示教上训练的策略同样表现出任务完成时间的缩短，以及与人类自然行为偏差的减少。综合而言，这些结果确立了空间分布式触觉反馈作为灵巧机器人遥操作的重要组成部分，并展示了其在改进安全关键型遥操作以及为训练自主机器人策略提供更拟人化示教方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文针对机器人遥操作中缺乏局部触觉导致灵巧度不足的问题，构建了集成视觉触觉传感与32像素指尖触觉显示的双边遥操作系统。实验证明，重现局部接触几何信息能显著提高遥操作效率与示教一致性，并使下游训练的自主机器人策略更具人类灵巧性。
AI.keywords: 机器人遥操作 (Robotic Teleoperation), 触觉传感 (Tactile Sensing), 触觉反馈 (Tactile Display), 灵巧操作 (Dexterous Manipulation), 策略学习 (Policy Learning)
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地通过视觉触觉传感器与触觉显示阵列，将空间局部接触几何信息引入双边遥操作中，不仅证明了高分辨率触觉反馈对人类操作灵巧度和效率的显著提升，还进一步验证了高质量遥操作示教对下游自主策略学习的正向迁移效果，对具身智能的数据采集与遥操作领域具有重要价值。

title: From Survey Histories to Interpretable Digital Twins: Auto-Discovering Task-Specific Personas and Behavioral Mechanisms
comments: 13 pages. Accepted at SocialAgent: Second Workshop on Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation, NeurIPS 2026. Camera-ready version. Substantially revised title, abstract, methodology, and experiments
summary: LLM-based "digital twins" aim to simulate how an individual would behave in new environments or respond to novel questions, given some representation of that individual's prior responses. We ask whether long survey histories can be transformed into compact, task-specific personas that remain predictive for unseen respondents and products within the same task while making simulated decisions more interpretable. We introduce an iterative auto-discovery pipeline that constructs persona representations and learns how persona evidence influences simulated responses. We evaluate the procedure on the 40-item Product Preferences--Pricing task of Twin-2K-500 (Toubia et al., 2025), learning from 20 respondents and 20 products and evaluating the frozen representation and mechanism on 30 unseen respondents and 20 unseen products. The holdout answers come from two survey waves, and every prediction is scored against each wave separately. For gpt-5.4-nano, replacing the full survey transcript with the learned channel representation and mechanism improves exact accuracy from 0.573 to 0.623 and from 0.558 to 0.626 in the two waves. Larger and cross-provider simulators (gpt-5.4, gpt-5-mini, qwen3-8b) using the full transcript do not achieve statistically significant improvements over the baseline in both waves, and none significantly outperforms the learned representation in either wave. This pattern shows that the learned representation produces consistent gains against human responses collected in both waves while retaining an explicit mapping from respondent evidence to predicted decisions.
comment: 13 pages. Accepted at SocialAgent: Second Workshop on Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation, NeurIPS 2026. Camera-ready version. Substantially revised title, abstract, methodology, and experiments

AI.title_translation: 从调查历史到可解释的数字孪生：自动发现任务特定角色和行为机制
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种迭代自动发现管道，将长调查历史转化为紧凑、可解释的任务特定角色，从而提高LLM数字孪生在预测人类行为方面的准确性。
AI.motivation: LLM数字孪生旨在模拟个体行为，但长调查历史难以管理且缺乏可解释性。本研究旨在将这些历史转化为紧凑、任务特定的角色，以保持预测性并提高模拟决策的可解释性。
AI.method: 引入了一个迭代的自动发现管道，该管道构建角色表示并学习角色证据如何影响模拟响应。在Twin-2K-500的40项产品偏好-定价任务上进行评估，从20名受访者和20种产品中学习，并在30名未见受访者和20种未见产品上评估冻结的表示和机制。
AI.result: 对于gpt-5.4-nano，用学习到的通道表示和机制替换完整的调查记录，在两个调查波中将精确准确率分别从0.573提高到0.623和从0.558提高到0.626。使用完整记录的更大和跨提供商模拟器（gpt-5.4, gpt-5-mini, qwen3-8b）在两个波中均未实现统计学上的显著改进，也未显著优于学习到的表示。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的表示在两个波中均对人类响应产生了持续的增益，同时保留了从受访者证据到预测决策的显式映射，提高了数字孪生的准确性和可解释性。
AI.translation: 基于LLM的“数字孪生”旨在模拟个体在新的环境中如何行为或如何回应新颖的问题，给定该个体先前响应的一些表示。我们询问，长的调查历史是否可以转化为紧凑的、任务特定的角色，这些角色在同一任务中对未见的受访者和产品保持预测性，同时使模拟决策更具可解释性。我们引入了一个迭代的自动发现管道，该管道构建角色表示并学习角色证据如何影响模拟响应。我们在Twin-2K-500（Toubia et al., 2025）的40项产品偏好-定价任务上评估了该程序，从20名受访者和20种产品中学习，并在30名未见受访者和20种未见产品上评估了冻结的表示和机制。保留的答案来自两个调查波，每个预测都针对每个波单独评分。对于gpt-5.4-nano，用学习到的通道表示和机制替换完整的调查记录，在两个波中将精确准确率分别从0.573提高到0.623和从0.558提高到0.626。使用完整记录的更大和跨提供商模拟器（gpt-5.4, gpt-5-mini, qwen3-8b）在两个波中均未实现统计学上的显著改进，也未显著优于学习到的表示。这种模式表明，学习到的表示对两个波中收集的人类响应产生了持续的增益，同时保留了从受访者证据到预测决策的显式映射。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种迭代自动发现管道，旨在将长调查历史转化为紧凑且可解释的任务特定角色，以改进基于LLM的数字孪生。通过构建角色表示并学习其对模拟响应的影响，该方法在产品偏好-定价任务上进行了评估。结果显示，对于gpt-5.4-nano，使用学习到的角色表示和机制显著提高了预测准确率，而直接使用完整调查记录的更大模型并未实现统计学上的显著改进。这表明所提出的方法能产生持续的增益，并保持决策的可解释性。
AI.keywords: 数字孪生, 角色, 行为机制, 自动发现, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个自动发现管道，能够将冗长且复杂的调查历史压缩成紧凑、任务特定的“角色”，同时显著提高了LLM数字孪生在预测人类行为方面的准确性和可解释性。它解决了传统数字孪生中数据量大、难以解释的问题。实验结果表明，这种学习到的紧凑表示比直接使用完整记录甚至更大的模型表现更好，这对于构建更高效、更透明的AI模拟系统具有重要意义。

title: From Regulation to Implementation: A Critical Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Regulatory Compliance in Industry
summary: The European Union (EU) has emerged as a leading regulatory body in the development of sustainability and privacy regulations. While new regulation requirements vary, many include a documentation artifact to ensure compliance. Notably, the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) introduces Digital Product Passports (DPPs) for life cycle transparency, while the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) mandates Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) to mitigate privacy risks. Creating these compliance artifacts, however, is challenging. Industrial data, which often exists in heterogeneous formats and is scattered across company and supplier systems, is required for DPPs and can be difficult to extract into compliant DPP formatting. Furthermore, DPIA documents require interdisciplinary expertise and follow no standardized format, making development difficult for novel systems. To address the particular complexity of compliance artifact creation for both regulations, researchers have proposed the use of LLMs in the generation process; however, the impact of the aforementioned problems on the output of these systems is largely unaddressed. This work investigates the existing research gap by exploring how data extraction instructions and regulatory vagueness impact the quality and consistency of LLM-produced compliance artifacts. The resulting artifacts are evaluated by benchmarking different models against manually created ground-truth schemas. The results reveal that less strict guidelines, such as DPIA formatting, require higher context prompts to maintain consistency and completeness. Stricter guidelines, such as formatting for Digital Battery Passports (DBP), result in consistent results regardless of prompt context, but may lead to more hallucinations in the output

AI.title_translation: 从法规到实施：LLM辅助行业监管合规性的批判性评估
AI.tldr: 本文评估了LLM在创建合规文档中的效果，发现提示语和法规模糊性会影响其质量，特别是在较宽松的指导下。
AI.motivation: 欧盟法规（如ESPR和GDPR）要求创建合规文档（如DPP和DPIA），但这些文档的创建过程复杂且具有挑战性。尽管研究人员提出了使用LLM来辅助生成这些文档，但LLM在此过程中受到的影响（如数据提取指令和法规模糊性）尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.method: 本文通过探索数据提取指令和法规模糊性如何影响LLM生成的合规文档的质量和一致性来调查现有研究空白。通过将不同模型生成的文档与手动创建的真实模式进行基准测试来评估结果。
AI.result: 较宽松的指导方针（如DPIA格式）需要更高上下文的提示才能保持一致性和完整性。较严格的指导方针（如数字电池护照DBP的格式）无论提示上下文如何都能产生一致的结果，但可能会导致输出中出现更多的幻觉。
AI.conclusion: LLM在生成合规文档时，其性能受到数据提取指令和法规模糊性的显著影响。较严格的规范有助于一致性，但可能增加幻觉，而较宽松的规范则需要更详细的提示。
AI.translation: 欧盟已成为制定可持续发展和隐私法规的领先监管机构。虽然新的法规要求各不相同，但许多都包含文档工件以确保合规性。值得注意的是，《生态设计可持续产品法规》（ESPR）引入了数字产品护照（DPP）以实现生命周期透明度，而《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）则强制要求进行数据保护影响评估（DPIA）以减轻隐私风险。然而，创建这些合规工件具有挑战性。DPP需要工业数据，这些数据通常以异构格式存在并分散在公司和供应商系统中，并且可能难以提取为符合DPP格式的数据。此外，DPIA文档需要跨学科专业知识，并且没有标准化格式，这使得为新系统开发变得困难。为了解决这两种法规中合规工件创建的特殊复杂性，研究人员提出了在生成过程中使用大型语言模型（LLM）；然而，上述问题对这些系统输出的影响在很大程度上尚未得到解决。这项工作通过探索数据提取指令和法规模糊性如何影响LLM生成的合规工件的质量和一致性来调查现有的研究空白。通过将不同模型生成的工件与手动创建的真实模式进行基准测试来评估结果。结果表明，较宽松的指导方针，如DPIA格式，需要更高上下文的提示才能保持一致性和完整性。较严格的指导方针，如数字电池护照（DBP）的格式，无论提示上下文如何都能产生一致的结果，但可能会导致输出中出现更多的幻觉。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了大型语言模型（LLM）在生成欧盟法规（如ESPR和GDPR）所需的合规文档（如DPP和DPIA）中的有效性。鉴于工业数据复杂性和法规格式缺乏标准化带来的挑战，该工作探讨了数据提取指令和法规模糊性如何影响LLM生成文档的质量和一致性。通过对不同LLM模型与手动创建的基准进行比较，研究发现，在较宽松的法规指导下（如DPIA），LLM需要更详细的上下文提示才能确保输出的一致性和完整性；而在较严格的指导下（如DBP），LLM能够保持一致性，但可能产生更多的幻觉。
AI.keywords: LLM, 监管合规, 数字产品护照, 数据保护影响评估, 幻觉
AI.comments: 本文创新性地探讨了LLM在生成复杂且高度规范的合规文档中的实际应用及其局限性。它揭示了提示工程和法规明确性对LLM输出质量的关键影响，为未来LLM在法律和合规领域的应用提供了重要的实践指导和研究方向。特别是在严格规范下幻觉增加的发现，对LLM在需要高精度和事实准确性的场景中的应用提出了警示。

title: Prompt-Based Abstention Fails Under Misleading Context: A Controlled Study of Small Frozen RAG Models
comments: 19 pages. Published in AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code and data: https://github.com/andre44s/grab-rag
summary: Missing and misleading evidence are not the same problem in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but prompt-based abstention treats them alike. Small frozen models abstain when context is absent, not when it is misleading. We introduce GRAB-RAG (Graded Abstention Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a paired benchmark that tests the same questions across four context conditions (supportive, degraded, missing, and misleading) in Natural Questions and HotpotQA. In the misleading condition, we edit a gold passage to support a wrong answer and place it among other retrieved passages. We test five abstention policies on three small frozen models (3.8B-8B) across two English QA benchmarks. Models abstain reliably when evidence is missing, but under explicit abstention prompting still answer 41.6% of misleading questions, with 63% of those answers echoing the planted wrong entity. Chain-of-thought provides little additional benefit. A generator-side conflict check cuts the rate to 13.3% but discards many correct answers, while a natural language inference (NLI) verifier recovers that coverage but fails when parametric memory and the misleading passage agree on the same wrong answer. Prompt-based abstention asks whether context is sufficient, not whether it is correct. The two-pass checks are diagnostic baselines, not deployable mitigations.
comment: 19 pages. Published in AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code and data: https://github.com/andre44s/grab-rag

AI.title_translation: 基于提示的弃权在误导性语境下失效：小型冻结RAG模型的对照研究
AI.tldr: 小型冻结RAG模型在提示下能识别缺失证据并弃权，但在误导性证据下仍会回答错误问题，且现有两阶段检查方法并非可靠缓解方案。
AI.motivation: RAG中缺失证据和误导性证据是不同问题，但当前的基于提示的弃权机制未能区分，导致模型在误导性语境下仍给出错误答案。
AI.method: 本文引入了GRAB-RAG（检索增强生成分级弃权基准）用于评估模型在不同上下文条件下的弃权表现。该基准在Natural Questions和HotpotQA数据集上，设计了支持性、降级、缺失和误导性四种上下文条件，其中误导性条件通过编辑黄金段落来支持错误答案。研究测试了五种弃权策略和三种小型冻结RAG模型（3.8B-8B）。
AI.result: 模型在证据缺失时能可靠弃权，但在明确的弃权提示下，仍回答41.6%的误导性问题，其中63%的答案重复了植入的错误实体。思维链（Chain-of-thought）几乎没有额外益处。生成器侧冲突检查将错误率降至13.3%，但丢弃了许多正确答案。自然语言推理（NLI）验证器恢复了覆盖率，但在参数记忆和误导性段落都同意同一错误答案时失效。
AI.conclusion: 基于提示的弃权机制只关注上下文是否充分，而非是否正确。现有的两阶段检查方法是诊断性基线，而非可部署的缓解措施。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）中，缺失证据和误导性证据并非同一问题，但基于提示的弃权机制将它们等同对待。小型冻结模型在上下文缺失时会弃权，但在上下文具有误导性时则不会。我们引入了GRAB-RAG（检索增强生成分级弃权基准），这是一个配对基准，用于在Natural Questions和HotpotQA中测试相同问题在四种上下文条件（支持性、降级、缺失、误导性）下的表现。在误导性条件下，我们编辑了一个黄金段落以支持一个错误的答案，并将其置于其他检索到的段落之中。我们测试了五种弃权策略在三种小型冻结模型（3.8B-8B）上，跨越两个英文问答基准。当证据缺失时，模型能可靠地弃权，但在明确的弃权提示下，仍会回答41.6%的误导性问题，其中63%的答案重复了植入的错误实体。思维链（Chain-of-thought）几乎没有额外益处。生成器侧冲突检查将错误率降至13.3%，但丢弃了许多正确答案，而自然语言推理（NLI）验证器恢复了覆盖率，但在参数记忆和误导性段落都同意同一错误答案时失效。基于提示的弃权机制询问上下文是否充分，而非是否正确。两阶段检查是诊断性基线，而非可部署的缓解措施。
AI.summary: 本文研究了小型冻结RAG模型在面对缺失和误导性上下文时的弃权行为。研究发现，基于提示的弃权机制在证据缺失时有效，但在误导性上下文下，模型仍会高比例地给出错误答案，且这些答案常与误导信息一致。通过引入GRAB-RAG基准，作者评估了多种弃权策略和两阶段检查方法，结果表明这些方法未能有效解决误导性上下文问题，并指出当前弃权机制的根本缺陷在于未能区分上下文的充分性与正确性。
AI.keywords: RAG, 弃权, 误导性上下文, 小型模型, GRAB-RAG
AI.comments: 本文揭示了RAG模型在处理误导性信息时的核心脆弱性，强调了区分上下文充分性与正确性的重要性。GRAB-RAG基准的引入对于未来研究RAG模型的鲁棒性和弃权机制提供了宝贵的评估工具。研究结果表明，简单的提示工程和现有两阶段检查方法不足以解决这一问题，为开发更复杂的语义验证和冲突解决机制指明了方向，具有重要的实践指导意义。

title: AnaDiffusion: Anatomically Compositional Latent Diffusion for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation
summary: 3D brain MRI generation has made significant advances in medical imaging, simulation, and controllable anatomical analysis. However, existing generative models typically synthesize 3D volumes monolithically, often overlooking regional anatomical structures and limiting local controllability. To address these limitations, we introduce AnaDiffusion, an anatomically compositional latent diffusion framework that factorizes the generation process into distinct, anatomically meaningful regions, followed by part-to-whole assembly and global refinement. Our approach first trains part diffusion models to capture local structural priors. We then inject an assembled anatomical composite of the parts into the whole-brain latent representation and continue denoising. This mechanism enables the model to resolve global context while preserving the injected anatomy. AnaDiffusion thus produces explicit part assets and a globally coherent volume, enabling controllable part editing without subject-specific dense segmentation maps at inference. On a subject-disjoint ADNI test split, AnaDiffusion attains the lowest mean Fréchet distance (FID) in every evaluated region. In localized editing, it achieves substantially higher target transfer (paired MS-SSIM) than a segmentation-conditioned baseline, with off-target preservation close to the baseline's.

AI.title_translation: AnaDiffusion：用于可控三维脑部MRI生成的解剖学组合潜在扩散模型
AI.tldr: AnaDiffusion是一个解剖学组合潜在扩散框架，通过分解生成过程为独立区域并进行组装和全局细化，实现了可控的三维脑部MRI生成，且无需推理时的分割图。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型通常整体性地合成三维体，忽视了区域解剖结构并限制了局部可控性。
AI.method: AnaDiffusion是一个解剖学组合潜在扩散框架，它将生成过程分解为不同的、具有解剖学意义的区域，然后进行部分到整体的组装和全局细化。该方法首先训练部分扩散模型以捕获局部结构先验。然后，将组装好的部分解剖学复合体注入到全脑潜在表示中并继续去噪，从而在保留注入解剖结构的同时解决全局上下文问题。
AI.result: 在受试者不重叠的ADNI测试集上，AnaDiffusion在每个评估区域都获得了最低的平均Fréchet距离（FID）。在局部编辑中，它实现了比基于分割的基线模型显着更高的目标传输（配对MS-SSIM），并且脱靶保存接近基线模型。
AI.conclusion: AnaDiffusion通过解剖学组合潜在扩散框架，实现了无需推理时主题特定密集分割图的可控部分编辑，生成了明确的部分资产和全局连贯的体积。
AI.translation: 三维脑部MRI生成在医学成像、模拟和可控解剖分析方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有生成模型通常整体性地合成三维体，往往忽视区域解剖结构并限制了局部可控性。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了AnaDiffusion，一个解剖学组合潜在扩散框架，它将生成过程分解为不同的、具有解剖学意义的区域，然后进行部分到整体的组装和全局细化。我们的方法首先训练部分扩散模型以捕获局部结构先验。然后，我们将组装好的部分解剖学复合体注入到全脑潜在表示中并继续去噪。这种机制使得模型能够在保留注入解剖结构的同时解决全局上下文问题。因此，AnaDiffusion生成了明确的部分资产和全局连贯的体积，实现了无需推理时主题特定密集分割图的可控部分编辑。在受试者不重叠的ADNI测试集上，AnaDiffusion在每个评估区域都获得了最低的平均Fréchet距离（FID）。在局部编辑中，它实现了比基于分割的基线模型显着更高的目标传输（配对MS-SSIM），并且脱靶保存接近基线模型。
AI.summary: AnaDiffusion是一个创新的解剖学组合潜在扩散模型，旨在解决现有三维脑部MRI生成模型在区域解剖结构忽视和局部可控性方面的局限。该框架通过将生成过程分解为独立的解剖区域，并进行部分到整体的组装和全局细化。它首先训练部分扩散模型学习局部先验，然后将组装后的部分注入全脑潜在表示进行去噪，从而在保持全局连贯性的同时实现对局部解剖结构的精确控制。AnaDiffusion无需推理时的密集分割图即可进行可控的部分编辑，并在ADNI测试集上取得了最低的FID和更高的局部编辑目标传输效果。
AI.keywords: 3D脑部MRI生成, 潜在扩散模型, 解剖学组合, 可控生成, 局部编辑
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的解剖学组合潜在扩散框架，通过将三维脑部MRI生成分解为区域性部分和整体组装，显著提高了生成模型对局部解剖结构的可控性，同时避免了对密集分割图的依赖，是医学图像生成领域的重要进展。

title: AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop
comments: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Position Paper Track
summary: AI agents pose significant risks as they are granted increasing autonomy. A commonly proposed solution is human oversight and keeping a ''human in the loop'', but this is not a simple solution: Not only do current approaches to AI agent design impede effective human oversight, but the cognitive capacities required for it are also themselves degraded by extended use of AI systems. This position paper argues that current approaches to the development and deployment of AI agent systems do not support effective human oversight -- they contribute to its degradation. To address this, a top priority in the advancement of AI agents should be supporting the situated goals and cognitive requirements of effective human oversight, treating the human needs of overseers at the same level of importance as AI agent capability. To put this idea into practice, we connect work on automation and human-computer interaction to AI agent processes, outlining design-level affordances and organizational protocols that (1) support overseers in exercising critical judgement and (2) counteract the skill atrophy that arises from extended use of automation. We urge developers and deployers to adopt these or similar approaches. Without explicit support for the cognitive demands of effective human-agent interaction, AI agent systems will continue to passively incentivize the degradation of the very human skills they rely on.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能代理将人类排除在外
AI.tldr: 随着AI代理获得更多自主权，它们对人类的监督能力构成风险。现有AI设计阻碍了有效的人类监督，并且长时间使用AI会削弱人类的认知能力。本论文认为，应优先支持人类监督者的认知需求，并提出设计和组织层面的解决方案，以应对技能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能代理获得越来越多的自主权，它们对人类的监督能力构成了重大风险。然而，当前的人工智能代理设计方法阻碍了有效的人类监督，并且长时间使用人工智能系统会削弱人类进行监督所需的认知能力。因此，需要一种新的方法来解决这个问题。
AI.method: 本论文提出，应将支持有效人类监督的认知需求和情境化目标置于AI代理能力同等重要的地位。通过借鉴自动化和人机交互领域的研究，论文提出了具体的设计原则和组织协议，旨在支持监督者做出批判性判断，并抵消因长期使用自动化而产生的技能退化。
AI.result: 现有的人工智能代理开发和部署方法未能有效支持人类监督，反而会促使其退化。如果不能明确支持有效人机交互的认知需求，人工智能代理系统将继续被动地促使它们所依赖的人类技能退化。
AI.conclusion: 为了有效的人工智能代理开发和部署，必须优先支持人类监督者的认知需求和情境化目标。通过整合人机交互和自动化领域的见解，可以设计出能够增强监督者判断力并抵消技能退化的系统。忽视这些需求将导致对人类技能的持续退化。
AI.translation: 人工智能代理在获得日益增长的自主权时，会带来重大的风险。一个普遍提出的解决方案是人类监督，即让“人在回路中”，但这并非一个简单的解决方案：目前人工智能代理的设计方法不仅阻碍了有效的人类监督，而且进行监督所需的认知能力本身也会因长时间使用人工智能系统而退化。本立场论文认为，目前人工智能代理系统的开发和部署方法不支持有效的人类监督——它们反而促成了人类监督能力的退化。为了解决这个问题，在人工智能代理的进步中，应将支持有效人类监督的情境化目标和认知要求作为一个首要任务，并将监督者的需求与人工智能代理能力同等重视。为了将这一理念付诸实践，我们将自动化和人机交互的研究与人工智能代理过程联系起来，概述了（1）支持监督者行使批判性判断和（2）抵消因长期使用自动化而产生的技能退化的设计层面的优势和组织协议。我们敦促开发人员和部署者采用这些或类似的方法。没有明确支持有效的人机交互的认知需求，人工智能代理系统将继续被动地激励它们所依赖的人类技能的退化。
AI.summary: 本论文探讨了人工智能代理日益增长的自主权所带来的风险，特别是对人类监督能力的潜在影响。作者认为，当前的人工智能代理设计方法和长期使用人工智能系统所导致的认知能力下降，共同阻碍了有效的人类监督。为此，论文提出应将支持人类监督者的认知需求和情境化目标作为AI代理研发的优先事项，并借鉴人机交互和自动化领域的知识，提出具体的设计原则和组织协议，以增强监督者的批判性判断能力并对抗技能退化。作者强调，若不解决这些认知需求，人工智能系统将持续削弱其所依赖的人类技能。
AI.keywords: 人工智能代理,人类监督,认知退化,人机交互,技能退化
AI.comments: 该论文强调了在人工智能代理发展中，人类监督的重要性以及当前方法的不足。它提出了一个重要且及时的观点，即需要优先考虑支持人类监督者的认知需求，而不是仅仅关注AI代理的能力。论文提出的解决方案，借鉴了人机交互和自动化领域的知识，为实际应用提供了有价值的指导。然而，论文也可能存在一些局限性，例如，它可能没有详细说明在实际部署中可能遇到的具体挑战，或者没有提供量化评估其提出方法的有效性的证据。

title: The least-squares RBF-PU method for linear elasticity in the diaphragm geometry
summary: The human diaphragm is vital for respiration and its simulation can aid in further understanding complications arising in individuals that have been subjected to mechanical ventilation. The diaphragm is very thin and hence its numerical simulation poses a challenge for most numerical methods. In this paper, we compute the deformation of real diaphragm geometries, which are modelled as linearly elastic, and are subject to realistic boundary conditions. The method used is the unfitted least-squares radial basis function partition of unity method. The patches used are cylindrical and refinement is performed along the thin direction of the diaphragm. Both the unfitted nature of the method as well as the refinement technique make this method particularly well suited to solve problems formulated in thin geometries. We derive a theoretical proof showing that the method converges with high order to the solution of a well-posed linear elasticity boundary value problem.

AI.title_translation: 线性弹性在膈肌几何中的最小二乘RBF-PU方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出并验证了一种用于模拟薄膈肌几何体线弹性变形的数值方法，该方法在处理薄几何体方面表现出色，并具有高阶收敛性。
AI.motivation: 为了更好地理解机械通气对人类膈肌功能的影响，需要对真实的膈肌几何形状进行数值模拟，但其薄的几何特性给传统数值方法带来了挑战。
AI.method: 采用非匹配最小二乘径向基函数单位分解法（least-squares RBF-PU method），并结合圆柱形贴片和沿薄层方向的网格细化技术，以适应膈肌的薄几何形状。
AI.result: 理论证明了该方法对于适定的线性弹性边值问题具有高阶收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 非匹配最小二乘径向基函数单位分解法（least-squares RBF-PU method）及其针对薄几何体的网格细化技术，能够有效地模拟具有挑战性的膈肌几何体的线弹性变形，并具有高阶收敛性。
AI.translation: 人类膈肌对呼吸至关重要，其模拟有助于进一步了解机械通气患者出现的并发症。膈肌非常薄，因此其数值模拟对大多数数值方法提出了挑战。在本文中，我们计算了真实膈肌几何形状的变形，这些几何形状被建模为线弹性，并受到现实边界条件的约束。所使用的方法是非匹配径向基函数单位分解法。所使用的贴片是圆柱形的，并且沿着膈肌的薄方向进行细化。该方法的非匹配性质和细化技术使其特别适合解决薄几何体中的问题。我们推导了理论证明，表明该方法对于适定的线性弹性边值问题具有高阶收敛性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为非匹配最小二乘径向基函数单位分解法（least-squares RBF-PU method）的数值方法，用于模拟人类膈肌的线弹性变形。该方法特别适用于模拟薄几何体，通过使用圆柱形贴片和沿薄层方向的细化技术来处理膈肌的挑战性几何形状。研究通过理论证明了该方法在处理适定的线性弹性边值问题时具有高阶收敛性，有望为理解呼吸系统并发症提供新的模拟工具。
AI.keywords: 线性弹性, 径向基函数, 单位分解法, 薄几何体, 膈肌
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的数值方法，专门用于解决薄几何体（如人类膈肌）的线弹性模拟难题。该方法结合了非匹配技术和径向基函数，并辅以特定的网格细化策略，这在处理具有复杂边界和薄特征的实际几何体时具有显著优势。理论上的高阶收敛性证明为其有效性提供了数学保证。然而，在实际应用中，其计算成本和对参数选择的敏感性可能需要进一步评估。

title: Drive the Thoughts: Runtime Monitoring of VLA Reasoning-Trajectory Consistency
summary: While machine learning models help autonomous vehicles (AVs) navigate complex environments, their black-box nature complicates validation and verification (V&V). Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a unique opportunity: alongside trajectories, they generate an explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) explaining their decisions. We posit that this CoT can serve as a candidate specification to cross-check trajectories and expose unsafe behavior. To assess this, we curate DriveAlignBench, a dataset of 150 CoT-trajectory pairs from NVIDIA's Alpamayo 1.5 VLA, manually annotated for CoT reliability, CoT-trajectory consistency, and trajectory safety. We find that 33.3% of CoTs are unreliable, and among reliable CoTs, 26% have inconsistent trajectories. To detect these cases, we propose integrating a CoT-trajectory consistency check into a runtime monitor. This check is nontrivial because CoTs express open-vocabulary, scene-relative maneuvers, while trajectories are low-level ego-motion sequences whose semantics depend on road geometry and motion context. To bridge this gap, we develop a family of automated consistency monitors. The strongest, the lane-aware monitor, adds lane-relative evidence to the input of the judge model scoring consistency. This raises F1 across all four evaluated judges from 0.56-0.62 with raw waypoints to 0.65-0.82, showing that evidence representation improves detection across judges. Moreover, for reliable CoTs, inconsistency is associated with unsafe behavior: 27% of human-labeled inconsistent trajectories are unsafe compared to 3% of consistent ones, and the lane-aware monitor flags most of these unsafe cases. We release DriveAlignBench, the monitor implementations, and per-run results at https://github.com/less-lab-uva/drive-the-thoughts.

AI.title_translation: 驱动思维：VLA推理-轨迹一致性的运行时监控
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个运行时监控器，通过检查视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的思维链（CoT）与轨迹的一致性，来检测自动驾驶系统中的不安全行为。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在自动驾驶中存在黑盒问题，难以验证和确认。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型产生的思维链为验证轨迹和暴露不安全行为提供了机会。
AI.method: 研究者构建了DriveAlignBench数据集（150对CoT-轨迹），手动标注了CoT可靠性、CoT-轨迹一致性和轨迹安全性。在此基础上，提出了将CoT-轨迹一致性检查集成到运行时监控器中。为弥合CoT与轨迹之间的语义鸿沟，开发了一系列自动化一致性监控器，其中“车道感知监控器”表现最佳，通过将车道相关证据添加到判断模型输入中来提高检测性能。
AI.result: 研究发现33.3%的CoT不可靠，在可靠的CoT中，26%的轨迹与CoT不一致。最强的车道感知监控器将所有四种评估判断模型的F1分数从0.56-0.62提高到0.65-0.82。此外，对于可靠的CoT，27%的人工标注不一致轨迹是不安全的，而一致轨迹中只有3%不安全，且车道感知监控器能标记出大多数这些不安全案例。
AI.conclusion: 将CoT-轨迹一致性检查集成到运行时监控器中，特别是使用车道感知监控器，可以有效地检测VLA模型中的不一致和不安全行为，从而提高自动驾驶系统的验证和确认。

title: Learning Task-Specific Antibody Representations via Function-Aware Masking
summary: Antibody-specific language models pretrained via masked language modeling (MLM) learn representations that are critical for downstream sequence design and property prediction tasks. Yet, the corruption process itself is rarely leveraged as a source of inductive bias during pretraining. While preferentially masking complementarity-determining regions (CDRs) improves binding-related predictions, antibodies possess diverse biological priors over a variety of functions. Herein, we introduce function-aware masking, a family of pretraining algorithms that align mask placement with specific functional priors (e.g., from IMGT annotations or structure predictions) to shape the learned representation space. We show that these specialist masking strategies significantly improve performance on their respective objectives, yielding up to a 14% gain on structure-related tasks and up to a 5.9x improvement on CDR-related tasks. To further improve performance across multiple functional axes, we develop hybrid masking strategies that integrate multiple priors, balancing reconstruction over binding, structural, and biophysical objectives. Our results demonstrate that informed mask placement provides a parameter-free mechanism for imposing functional inductive biases in antibody language model training.

title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation through Human-Agent Interaction
summary: AI agents are trained on population-scale data to encode broad capabilities spanning those of many practitioners. Yet the artifacts they produce rarely meet the personal bar professionals need to stake their reputation on. On realistic, open-ended tasks where success criteria are heterogeneous and insufficiently documented, individual expertise lives precisely in the elevation and departure from the average. In practice, iterative human-agent interaction surfaces criteria that users cannot fully specify up front, yet apply repeatedly across tasks. We argue this cross-session interaction data is a rich, underused signal for closing the gap to individual expertise. In this work, we propose test-time adaptation through human-agent interaction (TAHI), which integrates these signals into agent context and weights, and crystallizes each user's training and evaluation criteria via an evolving rubric module. We adapt agents to 30 individuals in two high-utility domains, writing and visual creation, on a total of 600 tasks. Our agents improve solo task success by 4.5-20.9% within only tens of tasks. Meanwhile, our evolving rubric module serves as a scalable annotation tool, creating evaluation rubrics that catch 16.0-22.3% more failures than those from LMs or humans alone. While agents are adapted towards individuals, we show these personalized agents also produce improvements in success of up to 8.8% that generalize across users.

title: A Governance Methodology Layer for AI-Assisted Software Development: Defect Taxonomy, Controlled Ablation, and a Test of Process-Over-Capability
comments: v4: reports the outcome of the pre-registered test of C4 (Sec. 6.8); corrects references. 25 pages
summary: Autonomous coding agents produce output that passes syntactic checks -- compilation, type safety, CI -- at high velocity. Yet syntactic correctness does not imply semantic correctness: design boundaries, security invariants, and maintainability contracts remain structurally invisible to automated pipelines. This paper makes four contributions. First, we present a defect-class taxonomy grounded in five AI agent permission and governance modules, separating defects structurally detectable by static analysis from those requiring semantic review. Second, we describe a runtime-decoupled governance gate -- a file-based protocol that reads generator output and emits a structured verdict without API coupling, hence portable across generators. Third, we formalize methodology-as-code: expressing a verification protocol as a version-controlled, executable artifact whose two layers separate portable methodology from host automation. Fourth, we report a controlled ablation experiment (E-ablation, N=5 artifacts, 8-item independent ground truth) comparing harness-structured review against a token-matched unstructured prompt. The structured condition records 62% lenient recall against 50%, with 25% strict against 0%. A severity-grade differential reported earlier does not survive blind re-grading and is withdrawn (Sec. 6.6). An independent-session re-test with blind scoring does not replicate that contrast: the conditions differ by one strict hit in 24 (6/24 against 5/24), the structured aggregate again 25% and the unstructured 0% not recurring (Sec. 6.7). Both conditions miss document-quality defects identified by a human QA reviewer, indicating complementarity between structured AI review and human process inspection. A later pre-registered test varying model tier (184 runs) did not support process design as the dominant factor: under strict scoring the tier effect was larger (Sec. 6.8).

title: A Theory of Information Architecture for Networked Decisions: Freshness, Locality, and Coordination
comments: 32 pages, 6 figures. Manuscript source and complete reproduction materials are available at https://github.com/ANRGUSC/TINA
summary: A broader view of a network can help agents coordinate, but collecting that view takes time. When is a fresh local observation more useful than an older view of the whole network, and when should an agent look only partway across it? We study agents that repeatedly minimize a shared quadratic cost in an environment that evolves independently of their actions. An information architecture specifies what each agent observes and how old those observations are. Each agent uses a synchronized neighborhood snapshot, so extending its scope also ages the nearby readings used in the decision. We assume that the optimal action with complete information is affine in the state, and that the conditional mean of the current state equals the old state scaled by a common exponential decay factor. Using the classical Marschak--Radner decomposition, we derive the delay threshold beyond which fresh local information outperforms a complete but older global view. This comparison allows non-Gaussian states and nonlinear decision rules. We then determine how far an agent should look by balancing the benefit of additional observations against their greater age. In a Gaussian spatial model on a line, we derive the optimal observation radius: looking beyond the local node pays only when information travels more than twice the spatial correlation length in one coherence time. The preferred information architecture also depends on the decision being made. On a fixed 64-node ring, increasing only the reach of the decision weights from 0.7 to 6 hops shifts the optimal observation radius from one to five hops.

title: From Reading Code to Reading Spec: A Verified Layer for LLM-Driven Codebase Maintenance
summary: The rapid growth of LLM-generated code increases software complexity and the maintenance burden on engineers. While LLMs offer a potential automated alternative, this structural complexity hinders their ability to manage codebases directly. We introduce the Provable Representation Of Original Functionality (PROOF), which manages codebases indirectly via structured specifications. To enable full-lifecycle codebase management strictly through these specifications, PROOF abstracts codebase topology into a hierarchical natural-language representation. To establish absolute trust, the system proves semantic equivalence by reconstructing source code exclusively from this specification. This verified foundation drives maintenance requests, executing code modifications while synchronously updating itself to prevent semantic drift. Experiments on real-world repositories confirm the effectiveness of these specifications.

title: Attributing Cohen's d: Training Data Attribution for Disease-Related Effects in Normative Age Biomarkers
summary: Normative age models are trained to predict chronological age in a nominally healthy cohort. In patients, the gap between predicted and chronological age is read as disease risk. We attribute the disease-related effect size of the age gap directly to individual training samples, rather than using a prediction-level loss as the attribution target. For the Cohen's d effect size, the resulting closed-form influence functional, validated against leave-one-out retraining, ranks training samples by their effect on held-out case-control separation. Across four diseases and two biomarker modalities in UK Biobank, removing the 10% most influential training samples raises held-out disease-related effect size in every seed. It more than doubles the metabolomic-age effect for type 2 diabetes and raises the brain-age effect for multiple sclerosis by roughly a third. Random removal leaves effect size flat even at 50% removal, confirming the gain comes from which samples are removed, not how many. Flagged subjects, missed by diagnosis-based exclusion, show elevated cardiometabolic markers the model never sees, consistent with subclinical contamination of the reference cohort. For type 2 diabetes, where the method gains most, the marker recovered is HbA1c, the standard measure of blood sugar control. We release our influence-function package pyinfluence.

title: Local Spike Timing Enables Gradient-based Learning in Neural Microcircuits
comments: Version for the initial submission to Nature Computational Science, 13th Nov. 2026
summary: The brain uses discrete spikes for dynamic computation, yet in the fields of computational neuroscience and brain-inspired computing, how neural microcircuits (NMCs) solve temporal credit assignment using local spike timing remains a fundamental open question. Dominant spiking neural network (SNN) approaches circumvent this by approximating backpropagation through surrogate gradients, decoupling learning from biological spike timing. In order to integrate seemingly incompatible spike timing and continuous gradients, we reformulate temporal credit assignment as a state separation problem: extracting task-required components induced by historical perturbations directly from the current neural state. This enables an online feedback learning framework for NMCs through a gradient tunneling (GT) algorithm and the lead-lag expansion technique that derives credit assignment from local synaptic spike timing, while remaining compatible with ANN-SNN hybrid architectures. Experimentally, GT-trained NMCs excel at long-timescale evidence integration and noise-robust memory retention, and perform comparably to leading SNN online learning methods on real-world benchmarks with far fewer parameters. The proposed framework addresses the two-decade-old NMC feedback learning problem and suggests a computational theory for the brain's temporal credit assignment mechanisms.

title: Mean Square Error Analysis of Stochastic Runge-Kutta Integrators
summary: We analyze the mean square error of stochastic Runge--Kutta integrators for overdamped Langevin dynamics whose potential is strongly convex outside a bounded region. A decomposition splits the local error into a mean-zero term and a smaller remainder, and the discrete Poisson equation turns their moments into a bound on the error of a time average. We carry this out for two stochastic Runge--Kutta integrators proposed by Yang \& Wang (2026), both of strong order $\frac32$ and weak order $2$, which evaluate the gradient of the potential and no higher derivative. We show that their laws approach the law of the exact solution at second order in Wasserstein-1 distance, up to a logarithm, uniformly in the number of steps. For a test function with bounded derivatives up to third order, we prove that the mean square error over $N$ steps with step size $h$ is $\mathcal O ( \frac{1}{Nh} + h^4 )$, which is the optimal order in the discretization. Experiments measure the strong and weak orders and the sampling bias on a nonconvex potential in $\mathbb R^2$, and compare the integrators on a diffusion model of CIFAR-10.

title: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
comments: We have fixed all issues, and submitted to IEEE TPAMI
summary: Amid the rapid advancement of physical-world intelligence, cloud-edge collaborative large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising roadmap for practical LLM deployment. However, existing cloud-edge paradigms struggle to balance global consensus with local personalization, which fails to satisfy the need for a unified knowledge foundation on the cloud and domain-specific adaptation at the edge. To address this, we propose a personalized bilevel optimization framework that formalizes cloud-edge LLM collaboration as a dual structure: the upper level optimizes edge-side personalization, while the lower level governs cloud-side knowledge transfer, reaching cloud-edge evolving in coordination. We then propose CIDERS: while the cloud performs knowledge transfer to the learnable backbone, the key lies in embedding global trajectories into each local personalization step via consensus-variate correction to reconcile personalization with consensus. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis, including a geometric characterization of the local trajectory and a full convergence guarantee, revealing an explicit trade-off structure between personalization and global convergence. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2-1.5B show CIDERS high performance and can significantly improve the accuracy (as much as 200\%+). Control-state diagnostics further show strong preservation of the local orthogonal component, while a separate cross-domain evaluation finds only a small matched-domain response advantage.

title: Beyond Embedding Transfer: Architectural Interfaces, Iso-Parameter Scaling, and Preconditioner-Governed Consolidation in Grokking
summary: Grokking, or delayed generalization after memorization, incurs substantial training steps across algebraic tasks. Cross-operator transfer from a grokked donor accelerates target acquisition, yet post-grokking AdamW continuation triggers test-accuracy relapse as unannealed updates drift across residual interfaces and decaying second moments amplify late gradients. Across depths one to three on modular arithmetic ($\mathbb{Z}_{113}$), non-Abelian $S_5$ conjugation, and real-sensory MNIST modular arithmetic, we separate representational transfer from preconditioner-governed consolidation across thirteen experimental batteries. First, co-transferring internal blocks accelerates one-layer and two-layer modular takeoff beyond boundary interfaces, while graded prefix pinning bounds depth-three drift under unannealed continuation. Second, an iso-parameter $S_5$ scaling grid separates attention head dimension from MLP width: widening two-head attention to dimension $64$ reaches $98.54\%$ cold accuracy at $427\mathrm{k}$ parameters and $85.95\%$ boundary-only transfer, while final-slot representations refine conjugation directly across blocks without an intermediate binary-product bottleneck. Third, Plateau-Gated Leaky Consolidation pairs validation-envelope step damping with leaky second-moment decay, reaching $84.85\%$ zero-leakage validation-gated risk-constrained accuracy across five pre-saturation two-layer $S_5$ suites while cutting step budget relative to hard anchoring. Fourth, transferring a grokked visual trunk and blocks to image-disjoint MNIST targets reaches $92.27\%$ and $90.76\%$ accuracy, prunes odd centroid harmonics, and reaches $90.42\%$ risk-constrained accuracy across $60/60$ branches without hyperparameter retuning.

title: ResGraph: Cross-Model Graph-based Index Migration via Residual Reachability in ANN Search
summary: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) underpins large-scale vector retrieval in search, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation. Graph-based indexes have demonstrated state-of-the-art search performance for ANNS: they connect each corpus vector to a small set of nearby or navigationally useful vertices and answer queries by traversing the resulting graph. Because these edges are selected using construction-time distances, the graph index is tied to the embedding model; re-encoding a corpus with a new model may change distances and neighborhoods of the vectors, and reconstructing the graph for the new embedding vectors incurs substantial construction cost and delays deployment. When the embedding model changes, we observe a phenomenon in the old graph index that we call residual reachability: although derived from different models, the vectors describe the same underlying objects and often retain part of their similarity structure, which the old graph reflects as connectivity, leaving many exact new-model neighbors reachable within a few hops. Motivated by this observation, we develop ResGraph, an index-migration framework that exploits the residual reachability of the old graph index to construct the new graph index faster. ResGraph provides two migration paths. Res-Local performs parallel shallow expansion over the inherited graph index and screens second-hop candidates with packed position sign codes before exact evaluation. Res-Search uses hop-bounded beam traversal to explore beyond shallow expansion. Across eight text and image migrations, ResGraph attains up to 17.43 times speedup on constructing the new graph index than the fastest degree-matched reconstruction method while keeping competitive recalls.

title: Contract-Based Decomposition of Temporal Logic Specifications for Networked Systems under Arbitrary Partitions
summary: Computational complexity is an inherent limitation of formal synthesis for networked systems, and decomposing the global specification into local ones relaxes this limitation at the cost of conservatism. Since the granularity of the partition governs this trade-off, it is reasonable to treat the partition as a design variable, which calls for local specifications that remain correct for every partition. To this end, this paper gives each agent a local specification, written as an assume-guarantee contract that the agent can establish from local information. We first derive a necessary and sufficient condition for these contracts to decompose the global specification under a given partition. Building on this, we then present a condition under which the decomposition is correct for every partition, so that the partition becomes a free design variable. For linear dynamics and signal temporal logic formulas with affine predicates, we further synthesize a controller for each coalition by a tube-based approach. Finally, simulations on a network of input-coupled tanks show how the choice of partition trades computational cost against conservatism.

title: Hidden not Deleted: How Networks Suppress Entangled Features
summary: When a neural network stops reporting a feature, has it forgotten the feature or merely hidden it? Shared representations complicate the answer: removing one feature's direction can also damage another feature. We study this problem in a small autoencoder that compresses and reconstructs inputs, allowing individual feature contributions to be traced directly. With the representation fixed, restoring a single bias partially recovers target detection by exposing a signal hidden behind the output's activation threshold. Tests on target-absent inputs distinguish this recovery from interventions that simply increase output. The same bias intervention becomes less effective when the representation is allowed to change. We find that training only the other outputs can weaken the target's contribution, even without a loss on its own output. A conditional theoretical analysis explains how interference with retained predictions creates this pressure. Yet more flexible predictors still detect residual target information. These findings show how recovery depends on feature geometry and on which parameters are trained, and why a silent output is insufficient evidence of forgetting.

title: UltraBench 2: Towards Robust Evaluation of Vision Foundation Models on Ultrasound
comments: Accepted to Proceedings of the 6th Machine Learning for Health Symposium (ML4H 2026), PMLR Volume 346
summary: Benchmarking is an increasingly critical part of research in machine learning and the domains where it is applied, including healthcare. Yet, despite the steady development of new ultrasound foundation models in recent years, the development of well-designed benchmarks to evaluate them has lagged behind. This deficiency has led to fragmented and inconsistent evaluations of competing models, making it difficult to measure progress. To address this issue, we introduce UltraBench 2, a comprehensive benchmark with wide anatomical and task coverage, and a focus on standardization, reproducibility, and ease-of-use. Using this benchmark, we compare existing vision foundation models for ultrasound image analysis. Our analyses demonstrate that ultrasound-specific pretraining still leads on classification, but that state-of-the-art general-purpose models have drawn level on segmentation.

title: The Alignment Illusion in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Layer-wise visual-text similarity in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is widely interpreted as evidence that the language model progressively integrates visual content into a shared representation space. This reading rests on the assumption that scalar alignment scores reflect content-level cross-modal interaction. To test this assumption, we apply controlled interventions to the visual stream. Across 13 MLLMs from five families spanning 0.5B to 72B parameters, replacing projector-output visual tokens with Gaussian noise sharply reduces task accuracy, yet four standard scalar measures (CKA, SVCCA, MIR, and the leading principal-angle cosine) fail to consistently separate the corrupted stream from the original. We call this failure the alignment illusion and trace it to the shared language-model pathway: anisotropic MLP down-projections pull visual and text tokens toward common output directions, producing weight-induced alignment. We introduce the principal-angle gap (PA gap), defined as the difference between the top two principal-angle cosines, to distinguish leading-direction dominance from the broader overlap observed with structured visual content. Under graded visual corruption, the PA gap tracks task accuracy more consistently than the scalar scores we consider; under a structured but irrelevant image, it further exposes regimes in which internal geometry and task accuracy come apart. Internal visual-text alignment in MLLMs is therefore best read as a geometric diagnostic of the visual stream inside the language model rather than a direct proxy for content-level cross-modal interaction, and is most informative when calibrated by controlled task evidence.

title: ReCo: When to Relocate Sensor Kits under Deployment Constraints -- A NILM Case Study
comments: 9 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the CONSTRAINT Workshop at IEEE BigData 2026. Updated manuscript and author affiliation
summary: Many sensing tasks obtain training labels only by deploying instruments in the field. With a limited number of sensor kits, a collection deadline, and measurement downtime at every move, the collector must repeatedly decide whether to stay at the current site or relocate. We study this decision in non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM), which estimates the power drawn by individual appliances from a home's main meter and is trained on data from homes temporarily fitted with appliance-level sub-meters. In NILM, appliance usage varies with the appliance, season and climate, and the value of new data depends on how diverse the combinations of target operation and background load are. To address this, we propose a constraint-based relocation framework and instantiate it for NILM as ReCo (Relocation by Coverage gain). ReCo counts new operating regimes in a joint target--background feature space, forecasts each home's future gain from the data collected so far, and each night weighs the gain of staying against the gain of moving elsewhere after the downtime. In replayed deployments on the Plegma dataset under two kit counts and two downtime costs, ReCo outperforms fixed-dwell and count-based schedules and a threshold rule using the same metric in every setting. Its advantage is not explained by collecting more days alone and is consistent with allocating the days to more valuable homes and periods.

title: From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data
summary: Estimating probability densities from a finite set of samples typically requires dataset-specific model fitting. We introduce PRODiGI, a pretrained data-to-program model that infers an explicit, executable generative program in a single forward pass. Pretrained on synthetic datasets paired with their ground-truth programs, PRODiGI accommodates diverse generative families and data dimensionalities through template prediction and non-autoregressive program parameter decoding. Its inferred programs support direct sampling, density and score evaluation, and inspection independently of the pretrained model. We further introduce program-space fine-tuning, which refines differentiable program parameters by maximizing the likelihood of empirical data while keeping model parameters intact. Experiments show that PRODiGI-FT achieves better density and score metrics than existing pretrained models, while offering multi-fold speedups over its closest competitors. Program-space fine-tuning further reduces generation MMD by 90%. By turning empirical data into explicit, reusable programs, PRODiGI introduces a new direction for fast, interpretable tabular generative modeling.

title: Mind the RefGAP: Correcting Reference Attention in Diffusion-Based Visual Editing
summary: Reference-guided diffusion editors struggle to faithfully reproduce user-provided references. We observe that many diffusion editors allocate limited attention to the reference. For example, in LoomVideo, edit-region queries assign less than 1% of their attention mass to the reference. We introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction that determines logit-offset magnitudes online at each layer from the reference-attention mass measured during the forward pass. Positive offsets to reference logits strengthen reference usage by edit-region queries, while negative offsets for keep-region queries limit reference-induced changes outside the edit. Two global coefficients control the correction; they are selected once on validation data from four development diffusion editors and held fixed. Across seven diffusion-based image/video editors, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head swapping and face swapping, where identity takes priority; on some editors this raises pose error, which delaying the correction reduces. RefGAP achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to separately tuned constant edit-side biases, without per-approach strength sweeps. Additional experiments on virtual try-on and background replacement evaluate transfer beyond identity editing.

title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
summary: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.

title: When a Flatness Proxy Is Not a Function: Robustness Certificates and Training Interventions
summary: A valid curvature upper bound need not justify either a robustness certificate or an intervention on an intrinsic predictor property. We demonstrate this distinction for a last-layer relative-flatness proxy used in both settings. First, empirical-risk stationarity does not eliminate pointwise first-order loss terms: at a finite global empirical-risk minimum, the retained certificate expression underestimates a loss increase by over $210\times$. We derive a globally valid, gauge-invariant feature-space repair. Second, common-row softmax shifts preserve predictions and the exact contraction while making the proxy unbounded. Even standard reference-class choices double it on average relative to the centered representation. For a single fixed-feature example with at least three classes, scalar retuning generically cannot align the induced probability updates. Row centering gives the orbit-minimized bound and restores value and full-model gradient invariance under this symmetry. Across 45 paired one-step tests on algorithmic and image models, amplified shifts separate raw-regularized predictors while quotient-regularized predictors remain aligned. Long-horizon CIFAR-10 experiments show substantial, reversible suppression of generalization, while evidence for selective delay after memorization is less consistent. Together, these results show that validity as a curvature upper bound does not by itself justify either inversion into a robustness certificate or differentiation into an intrinsic training intervention.

title: Parameterization method of reservoir properties for ensemble-based data assimilation using intermediate latent space of StyleGAN
summary: Ensemble smoothers are the most successful and efficient techniques currently available for history matching. However, because these methods rely on Gaussian assumptions, their performance is severely degraded when the prior geology is described in terms of complex facies distributions (non-Gaussian). In this way, for these methods, we need to apply efficient parameterization techniques. Currently, the most efficient methods for performing parameterization are deep learning models. However, given the variety of existing deep learning models, studies have not identified which is most suitable for use with ensemble-based methods, although some important models had already been evaluated. Based on a recent literature review, the most promising models selected were VAE-GAN, Latent Diffusion, and StyleGAN models. As a novel aspect of this work, data assimilation with the second generation of StyleGAN (StyleGAN2) model was performed using the latent z-space and intermediate w-space, separately. They were applied in two 2D case studies: one categorical (three facies) and the other continuous. The results demonstrated that all three models are highly efficient, with the StyleGAN2 model standing out for generating samples with geological realism and achieving excellent data matching in the cases studied. Our findings show that performing data assimilation with StyleGAN2 using the intermediate space (w-space) yielded better results than the traditional application in the latent space (z-space). This is due to the fact that ESMDA uses linear updates and the w-space is much more linear and disentangled than the highly entangled z-space, thereby ensuring that the updated vectors remain close to realistic geological patterns. These results were validated using main geostatistical and history matching metrics.

title: A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Conversational Home Energy Management Systems
comments: 25 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Re-set in the HUBS Lab paper layout (HUBS Lab Paper No. 2026-006); content unchanged
summary: The growing complexity in home energy management (HEM) demands advanced systems that guide occupants toward informed energy decisions reflecting their background, preferences, and context. Large language model (LLM)-integrated HEM systems (HEMS) have demonstrated promise, but previous studies relied on single-turn or single-task evaluations with response accuracy as the primary metric. Whether such systems deliver effective interactions across the extended multi-turn dialogues typical of real-world use remains an open question. This study introduces a comprehensive evaluation framework of LLM-integrated HEMS derived from the Goal-Question-Metric methodology, organized across five categories: task performance, factual accuracy, interaction quality, control capability, and system efficiency. A total of 23 metrics across multi-turn conversations are proposed and an LLM-as-judge pipeline is employed to enable scalable automated scoring. Its reliability is validated against three trained human coders: after iterative rubric calibration, twelve of the fifteen LLM-scored metrics reached strong agreement (ICC >= 0.73), three of them perfect, while the remaining three exhibited near-zero variance in human scores and are instead reported via mean absolute error (0.04-0.28). To demonstrate the framework's effectiveness, 970 dialogues -- 16 scenarios and five personas -- were generated and evaluated across four conversational HEMS configurations spanning a sophistication gradient, from a vanilla LLM with raw energy data to a multi-agent HEMS. The framework distinguished the four configurations across multiple evaluation dimensions, revealing their respective strengths and weaknesses. This study contributes to conversational HEMS by providing a reproducible, multi-dimensional evaluation methodology that comprehensively assesses sustained, context-aware system performance.

title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
comments: 15 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ARRSI 2026, a workshop at AACL-IJCNLP 2026; also accepted as a non-archival paper at R2A-FM 2026
summary: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.
